review_text: Christy was super helpful as issues arose, very clean and great location

We had a wonderful stay! The guest house was just as described and had everything we needed. The backyard is beautiful, the perfect place to enjoy coffee in the morning or an evening meal. We had the pleasure of meeting the dogs, adorable and very friendly. The neighborhood was peaceful and we felt safe to walk to the park, the botanical gardens, near by restaurants, and a great little ice cream shop just a block away. If we are back in the area, we would happily stay again. Niko and Kristin are great hosts.

Eric and Elizabeth were super helpful and extremely nice! we had a bit of a medical emergency and they really helped us out during it, grateful for them! also super responsive when needed things even at night (last minute, realizinglow on TP!). Definitely be back!
Very great stay!! Super clean and perfect for a nice little getaway. I highly recommend this place and look forward to booking again in the future !!

Beautiful and quiet neighborhood! Everything is walkable and the host did a wonderful job suggesting recommendations around the area! Instructions were detailed and clear which made our stay and travel less stressful and more enjoyable!
The location, the host, and the house were all awesome!
Cindy was responsive and helpful. The room was just what we hoped it would be.
Home was cozy and conveniently located to many restaurants/coffee shops. Loved the free parking and in unit washer/dryer. Overall, had a great stay!
Nice clean place.
The place was great. The bed was super comfy and check in was simple. Would definitely recommend .
Great location - walked to many coffee houses and restaurants!
Cute little casita.

The check in was smooth and host is very responsive. The location is very close to the airport as other reviews mentioned. The house is super clean and the private room and bathroom are perfect. I felt very safe as a solo traveller. I highly recommend if you're looking for an affordable place to stay close to the airport.

We had a nice stay at Bri’s place! The home looked exactly as pictured—clean, cozy, and just what we expected. We did run into two minor issues during our stay, but Bri was able to resolve them quickly, which we really appreciated. It was also great having a spot just down the street where we could take our dog for walks. Overall, a pleasant and comfortable stay!
Beautiful place right next to downtown Denver. Lots of bars and restaurants in easy walking distance.

House is located in quiet neighborhood, was somewhat easy to find out. Check in instructions were easy to understand and follow. House was welcoming. We ran into some minor hiccups which we were able to correct ourselves. Kitchen has sufficient utensils. One room had some visible damages which we then notified the owners who acknowledged it quickly. To that fact, the owner was very responsive. We were thinking to use backyard which had furnitures in there but since everything was not dusted (dirt etc), we refrained using it. Laundry room is located in basement so it took us two rounds of home before we figured it out 😀. May be a sign would have been helpful. House is located about 20+ minutes of drive from Denver downtown area. Overall a decent place.

The location of Philip's Marion St. listing was outstanding for day excursions. It really is just a short walk to 38th and Blake light rail station, which is just one station away from Union Station, the hub for anywhere you might want to visit in the region -- from Colorado Springs to Boulder. (Walk in Marion Street to the stoplight. After you cross the street, take sidewalk to the right which will bring you up to the station.)

We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful Victorian home in Denver! The location was perfect, peaceful and safe, yet just a short walk to all the fun downtown spots and the vibrant RiNo District. The home itself was artsy and full of character, with a super cozy and comfortable bed that made it hard to leave in the mornings. Rob was a great host, quick to respond and very kind. A perfect blend of charm, comfort, and convenience. Highly recommend!

We stayed here while scouting for places to prep for a move to Denver. Perfectly equipped and efficient, clean, and perfectly located to explore the city. If you’re looking for a place close to downtown Denver, this is the place to book!
Dallas’ place was perfect for us! Close to downtown and in a walkable neighborhood so there was not a shortage of things to do.
We had a wonderful time. Location was perfect and condo was beautiful and had everything we needed.

Chris & his home were wonderful! Exactly the safe place we needed to rest during some wild work weeks. Cozy, charming, quiet and so close to everything in the city! Would absolutely recommend staying here!!
Great place to stay! Very neat house! Dana was a great host! Highly recommend!

We had a great stay in this basement apt. We were happy to return here to relax and recuperate after a day of museums, sightseeing, or hiking. Great location for access to Denver. It was clean and comfortable. Parking was super convenient. The bedrooms are a great size, living, kitchenette, and bathroom spaces are tight; especially in the bathroom. Outlets are in short supply- this was a hardship for a family of three with all requisite devices! We didn’t find noise from above to be a problem. Everything was in working order- great spot, good value.

We had a wonderful stay at Christopher’s cozy AirBnB near the Denver Botanic Garden. The location was perfect—just a short walk to the gardens and Cheesman Park. The space itself was clean, quiet, and nicely appointed with thoughtful touches throughout. The kitchen had everything needed to put together my concert dinner picnic. Christopher was a responsive and friendly host, making check-in easy and offering great local recommendations. Highly recommend this spot for anyone looking for a comfortable, well-equipped place in a great location!

Matt's place was hands down the most well-equipped Airbnb I have EVER stayed at. I don't even know where to start: the coffee, the snacks, the drinks (seltzer, beer, wine...), the standing desk and extra monitor, the plethora of books, the toiletries - the list goes on and on. We greatly appreciated the off-street parking and outdoor space. The neighboorhood is clutch and in a great location. Matt was responsive and kind - we couldn't have asked for anything more. Thank you!!
All-around great experience. Cozy space, clean and simple. Exactly what we were looking for. Highly recommend!
Una’s place is excellent. Great location. I felt right at home. The porch was nice to sit and work or have coffee.

Great spot! Walking distance to a lot of great places. Parking is easy to find on side streets and the space was beautiful. Our AC had some issues but the hosts were super responsive. Would definitely stay again!

We had a sublimely comfortable and welcoming stay at the carriage house! We loved the eclectic and well-appointed interior. It was a quick walk or scoot/bike to a variety of food, drinks, art, and shopping. We hope to stay here again in the future.

We loved the location and everything was spotless and clutter -free giving a calming feel. There were just little things that kept it from being a 5-star, but really it's a good little getaway esp for people who are just sleeping there and out most of the time. Not having a sink downstairs (which the listing is clear that it doesn't have a kitchen, and there was a great water source - but we didn't realize that the closest sink where you could empty water would be upstairs in the bathroom) posed a few inconveniences. And there was only toilet paper (no paper towels or plates) and a couple tissues left in the kleenex box in the bedroom, so we had to use TP to eat our pizza which wasn't ideal. But, again, great place to come home to after city adventures! Thanks, Bobby!

Linda is lovely and great to chat with; she was so welcoming and good to me during my stay. Her home is wonderful, the balcony garden is a joy and I loved meeting Molly the dog too. My bedroom and bathroom were very comfortable and the shower is great. Linda has everything at hand that you might need and she is a very generous host. I really enjoyed getting to know Denver from Linda’s home and also used her access to the wonderful Botanic Gardens and art museums. Thanks to you Linda and Molly and to your special home. I hope to visit with you and Denver again.

Excessive amount of dust. Very noticeable smoke smell upon entering the hallway. Location was great but definitely Not happy with the amount of dust and smoke smell. Host was not very helpful, they stated a cleaning team would come out and help with situation but smell and dust still present after returning.

I rented this beautiful private location for my daughter Sweet 16 was definitely a win! The hot tub was lovely. The kids enjoyed all of the fun games that this beautiful place had to offer. I was a little bit worried that my teenagers were too loud so I was chaperoning trying to keep everybody’s voices down but altogether, it seemed to be a really great wonderful place to host a little party ! We definitely will be back. It is a hidden gym in the city of Denver. We had lots of fun and the people were very responsive. It was a clean and beautiful space once again highly recommend for Sweet 16 little bitty parties was a blast.

Lindsay’s place was easy to find and just as described. When we first arrived, the noise from the adjoining house had us a little concerned but we didn’t hear a peep after 9pm and slept very well. The place was clean and beautifully decorated, and the location was easy to find and peaceful.

We had a wonderful stay in Denver with Patrick and Lauren. Their place was comfortable and easily accessible. The bed was like something you would have at home in terms of size and comfort level. We thought the decor was so thoughtful and fun! The area was quiet and nice, close to restaurants and the train to Union Station or the Airport. We would definitely stay here again! Thank you for sharing your lovely home with us!
Beautiful place to stay, well decorated, and in a quiet, walkable neighborhood
Hostel Fish is very nice thanks
Thomas’ place was fantastic. Tucked away enough to be quiet but only a block away from restaurants. It’s also right off of the highway so getting to anywhere in the city is a breeze!
Adam was very informative leading up to our stay. The house was just as we had expected and was very clean/prepared for our stay. Would definitely recommend!
Great price and fantastic location. This place was perfect for my family of 4!

Beautiful spot, very close to several places like bars, arcades, grocery stores. Its in a peaceful neighborhood, and the spot is very quiet too. 100% would stay again, but tall people beware there’s a few low ceilings!
Thoroughly enjoyed my stay. Would come again and recommend to others.
Convenient, clean, and easy

Really enjoyed staying at the Zen Den. Great location with easy access to restaurants and bars. The pool table and hot tubs were a plus! We even enjoyed the shuffle board court. Would definitely recommend.

Viktors’s home is beautifully renovated, clean, and more spacious than it looks in the photos. We only stayed one night but could have easily stayed longer to explore Denver. We loved the easy access to the Botanic Gardens and the front porch space is the perfect place to hangout in the morning or evening.
Great, private place in quiet neighborhood. Easy walk or short drive to food options and attractions.

We really enjoyed our stay! Everything was clean and tidy, and it was the perfect size for our small family. The beds were comfortable. Parking on the street was not an issue - the neighborhood is quiet and seems very safe. It was a very short drive to lots of shopping and restaurants. The patio area is cute, although we did not really get a chance to use it. The house was stocked with all the basic needs, plus they left wine and chocolates out for us. I also appreciated the coffee pods and Keurig! The hosts are very responsive! We arrived a few minutes before checkin time and they quickly noticed and adjusted the lock so we could get in early. We also had an unfortunate medical accident while we were in Colorado and had to cut our stay short and on very short notice - they were very kind and understanding and walked us through how to cancel early - much appreciated during a stressful time. Thank you! We hope to be back!
Fantastic place in a great neighborhood. Josh was responsive, helpful, and friendly!

The location was amazing. Could walk around, bike to light rail, and parking not a problem. Layout of apartment was a little strange, but no biggie. The instructions to get in were perfect and easy to follow. I didn’t think it was “bright” as advertised but again no biggie. Overall nice stay for a few days.

Gabriela was a great host. This spot is close to everything in the Denver metro area. Very close to Regis Univ! Place is quaint, well decorated and perfect for what we needed for our Denver stay. Gabriela is very friendly and so is her cute dog!

Anna's place was very well appointed, with loads of high quality towels, soft linens, nice beds and lots of extras. Nice touches included snacks, disposable razors, makeup washcloths and wipes. Courtyard was lovely and inviting space. Would definitely stay again. 5 stars!!

Andrew was a great host. I had a little trouble opening the door at first and he was super responsive and helped me in within five minutes. The room is great for a solo traveler, and the mini fridge and coffee station was a great addition to the room.

My family had a great stay at Katie's place. It was a great base for us while we moved out of our home in Denver and was large enough to accommodate my wife, two small children and father. The neighborhood is great: right by Wash Park, and only a few blocks from Bonnie Brae ice cream.

Our stay at Joshua's house was one of my very best AirBnB experiences. Everything was perfect. The house was so incredibly comfortable and well furnished. And clean. Showers had great water pressure, too! We also really appreciated how well stocked the home was. Everything you needed was at the ready. Joshua was the absolutely best host. He not only replied to questions but followed-up to ensure that everything was exactly as we hoped it would be. And it was. The bonus was the garage parking (for a car not an big truck), which was so ideal for the city. I had not estimated how essential parking would be, and it made coming and going so easy. If I could give our stay more stars, I would!
Love staying at this spot!
Really clean place, Zach is friendly and helpful.

We stayed 3 days whilst moving our daughter in to an apartment close by. Great, comfortable beds, exceptionally clean baths (great shower heads!), nice living space. Just be aware that it is not a full kitchen. There is an airfryer/oven and microwave, but no cooktop and no pots/pans or many cooking utensils. Great restaurants within walking distance. We were always able to park behind the Carriage House (off street), which was nice.

Super easy and flexible check-in which helped a ton. Met Darren on day 2 and he’s a great guy. Lots of space and was very clean — no complaints about the accommodation. Super close to bus and light rail and some good lunch/breakfast/coffee spots.
Great place for a quick stop. Comfy beds and functional kitchen. Roomy and nice layout of the home. Dog friendly location
Nicole’s place was wonderful! We love the location and it was a great size. The patio was perfect for breakfast too!

Alice’s place was great! We enjoyed our stay so much. We were also so appreciative of how responsive she was and how proactive she was with any issues we did have. The space itself is perfect. It’s modern, clean, and exactly as the photos looked. Getting in the first time could be tricky when looking for it, but her instructions were very clear, so we were able to find it no problem. Thank you so much for having us!!

We had a great time at Holden’s house. It’s quite spacious for being right downtown. For Anyone looking for a spot close to Coors Field, this house can’t be beat! Great hosts too with proactive, clear instructions
Definitely a do over! Lovely place!

Our stay was enjoyable and My was extremely responsive and flexible. The area is ideally located in the Platt Park area with easy access to all of our favorite places on Old South Pearl St. Highly recommend if you are looking for a private and relaxing location that checks all of the essential blocks!

I had a wonderful three week stay here. The place is perfect for a longer rental or even quick overnight. I had no issues finding the place, checking in, or getting settled. On site parking is a huge perk. I also loved the location. You're minutes away from a beautiful walking park and conveniently close to grocery stores, bars, and restaurants. Last but not least, Jarrett is an extremely helpful and responsive host. I would definitely stay here again!
We enjoyed our short stay very much. Kelly was super helpful and friendly. Her place had everything you could possibly need and more - very thoughtful. Definitely worth the visit and would come back!
Our stay was very comfortable and Brandon’s check in instructions were clear and understandable. I would recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Denver.

Apartments (I stayed in two) were thoughtfully and artistically designed, comfortable, and user-friendly. Plus the location and convenience were ideal. Large adjoining lot (among other very close public options) made parking easy.
Stayed for a few months and it was perfect for me! Great space and perfect home away from home while traveling for work

michaels place was clean and as described he was very quick to respond to any question he also had good local recommendations my group was able to check in well ahead of check in time as well. I would recommend sating here . If im in the area again i will definitely consider staying here another time.
We had a great time during our first visit to Denver. Zach was very responsive and the loft was in a great location.

We had a wonderful stay here while spending a few days in Denver. The house is beautifully appointed and felt like home right away. We especially loved the downstairs movie area, sauna, and kitchen. Highly recommend!

The host is very responsive , friendly , welcoming and adaptive well to address the issue to make sure that the guest enjoys the journey .When I asked for early check in ,he tried to arrange the earliest time that I can check in . The room is comfortable and clean as well as. The Colorado travel guide and small booklet really help me to explore Colorado easily too !

Great spot for a remote worker - I particularly appreciated the desk, chair and monitor setup. The building and surrounding area is surprisingly quiet, although there is lots to do within walking distance.
Great stay! Great communication. Very cute house.
Troy had all the things that you may have forgotten, clean, quiet and I felt safe. I am from Denver so this made visiting home a breeze. Will definitely use this host again!!!
Loved walking the neighborhood .

We really enjoyed our stay! The location is great—very walkable, with lots of thrift shops, restaurants, and things to explore nearby. Communication with the host was excellent. The unit has a few quirks, like sensitive plumbing and a bathtub that’s shower-only. Overall, a solid spot if you’re looking for a convenient and central stay in the Denver area!

Decent option for an overnight stay - would definitely recommend if looking for value for money. Neighborhood felt more family oriented. Just the one bathroom could be something to consider for a longer stay but worked just fine for my group.

Zach's place was very nice and just the right amount of space and amenities we needed. It was even better that he allows pets, so we were able to bring our pug along for the trip as well. The house was clean and bathroom was super clean. There are a few areas that could be patched up in the bedroom, although did not affect our stay. Bed was comfortable but would recommend bringing your own. We had a great stay and would recommend this place to a friend if they were going to Denver.
Such a cute guest house with a great walkable area that was perfect for my dog! Definitely would recommend staying here.

We really enjoyed our stay in Kyla's house. It was spacious and had everything we needed. The kitchen was well stocked with seasonings and all we needed to cook meals at the house a few times over the course of our stay. The backyard was lovely for hanging out in the evening and grilling. Kyla was very responsive to any questions and always responded in a timely manner. I would highly recommend staying here!
I enjoyed my stay. Nice open space, roomy and clean/updated features.

The house was spotless and smelled great as soon as I walked in. It was cozy, well-maintained, and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The space felt very welcoming. I really enjoyed my time here and would definitely stay again!
Enjoyed our 10 day stay and felt right at home. Our dog loved the yard and walks to the near by lake. Highly recommend this place.
Will stay here again nice place
We had a great time at Matt’s place.

The place was very close to Denver. When you got home, you felt welcomed. It was an old Victorian home, which was interesting to me, but my teenage daughter absolutely fell in love with it. We had a large family in there, and everyone had their own room and felt at home I would recommend it to any family or any couple looking for a getaway treat near Denver. You will absolutely love it. Five stars easy.
We enjoyed our stay at Joshua’s place! Very clean and had everything we needed.
Nanci was super helpful and responsive. The home is beautifully designed, and the Harvard room was inspiring
No washing detergent provided; toilet paper insufficient;

We had a great 5 week stay here. Overall, a really good value. The home is nicely remodeled and spacious. The hosts were super accommodating and kind. About 3 weeks into our stay, we noticed a minor bug issue, and they immediately sent someone out to take care of it, which we really appreciated. A few things to note: there’s only one bathroom, and it’s located in the primary bedroom, so if you’re staying with multiple people, plan accordingly. The neighborhood itself felt safe with friendly neighbors, but it’s not the most walkable area. I walked to a nearby park and it was sketchy, so I’d recommend having a car to explore more walkable spots. That said, it worked fine for us! The front and backyard were perfect for our pup..lots of space to hang out and play. Just a heads-up on parking: we got a ticket when parking on the street once, but there is a garage available, which is the better option. All in all, a great stay!

Robert’s place was the perfect spot for our crew’s annual DeadRocks week! Easy to get to Red Rocks & if you are heading to Mission Ballroom at all for a show, this is the place to be - easy walk! The place was decorated well (not at all like many of the generic Airbnb companies out there) & was a cool vibe. The outdoor areas were nice to hang out in and there was plenty of space for our group of 8! Note that the beds are also comfortable & as a textile person myself, I really appreciated the cotton sheets (no hot, cheap polyester please!).
great place, cozy.
Great place to stay, very modern and clean. We loved our stay. The place was great and had everything we wanted and needed with a great location in downtown Denver.

Kristin’s place is comfortable and spacious. It is completely as described on the website. Kristin was responsive and provided snacks and beer to support our stay. It was very helpful to have a laundry on site.
The location was excellent. Within walking distance to the Rockies Stadium and close to parks, walking trails and shopping.

Jennifer’s place was great.Our first Air bnb in the US on this trip,very welcoming in a great area,close to all amenities Very comfy bed & good shower. Only disappointment was that we did not get to meet Jennifer as she was out of town on a camping trip. Would not hesitate to recommend & would use again if we return to Denver on a future US visit

This is my second time staying here and it was even better than the last! Alex is a great host and was very accommodating when we accidentally left something behind. The hot tub and close location to downtown make this place an amazing place to stay. Everything went very smooth and was a perfect little spot for 2 people to explore Denver. We will be back if in Denver again! This place is the spot and i would highly recommend to anyone visiting.
Zach’s place is just like the pictures. Very pleased with my stay!

We loved the style of this super-comfy apartment — the furnishings and decor are really attractive and have some eye-catching vintage design accents. The living, dining and kitchen area are spacious and the bedroom is very comfortable. The location is peaceful, right on a lovely small park, yet it's also a quick walk to all the restaurants and nightlife in the RiNo arts district. Amber is an excellent host, flexible and helpful. We'd definitely stay here again!

Jason’s place was perfect for my daughter and I. Jason provides clear instructions and pictures to find his place. Once there, it’s clean, comfortable, and easy to walk to nearby restaurants, coffee shops, and Mile High Stadium. Jason was kind enough to say hello and recommend local places to visit. The place had everything we needed and I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again. Thanks for a great stay!!
Host’s home accommodated my large family. It was a pleasant and unforgettable stay for me and my family.

Patrick & Lauren’s place was wonderful, clean and very cozy. It was super close to the city we were able to walk to all our destinations. I would definitely recommend this place if you wanna experience Denver night life.

The Art House is amazing! The warm, contemporary design and stunning art made it feel like a boutique retreat. The backyard pool oasis was the highlight—peaceful, private, and perfect for relaxing. Everything was super clean and comfortable, and Peter was a great host—helpful, responsive, and welcoming. We’d come back in a heartbeat! This is absolutely one of our favorite places.
Great space in a fantastic location - charming and walkable neighborhood with many establishments nearby. Jack was a communicative host with plenty of local recommendations.

Had the most relaxing stay with my husband, 4 daughters and our little frenchie. We came up from Texas for a week-long softball tournament. Enjoyed the space, the calm back patio and yard, the spacious kitchen to cook, the comfortable bedrooms and the convenient location. We couldn’t wait to get back after a long day in the sun watching softball! Loved it. The kitchen was stocked with anything needed to make a meal and my husband enjoyed using the grill to make burgers. Colleen was super helpful and attentive. Highly recommend this adorable home away from home if traveling to Denver. We loved it and appreciated the home so much! Our little frenchie also loved the space and was so happy, too :)
Beautiful place, clean, spacious, and cozy. Perfect for relaxing after long days at work. We really appreciated Byambasuren’s hospitality.
Cozy

Hello everyone! Let me just say that this was one of the nicest stays I've had while traveling! This studio Airbnb was very clean, spacious, and cuter in person than in photos. All amenities listed were available and then some! Location is near the ballpark and even during games was still very quiet, the neighborhood was safe and very walkable. It's located just a few blocks from amazing bars and restaurants and very easy to get around. Sarah, was very communicative and responded almost immediately if we needed anything and was great about checking in to make sure we were good. She was also very accommodating and offered a later check out if we needed. Sarah left us very clear instructions on how to check in and out and also provided recommendations for bars in the area. My friend and I felt very at home here and would definitely recommend it to everyone!

This was the perfect location for our stay! Super central in downtown to restaurants and bars, short uber or scooter ride away to other neighborhoods and the building amenities are to die for! The apartment had everything we needed to make a quick breakfast in the morning, super convenient next to Whole Foods for quick groceries, before heading out for the day and the bedding was luxurious. There’s multiple coffee spots around the area and lots to see and do! We were in town for a show at red rocks which was about a 30min shuttle ride away. Would highly recommend this location for an city/urban style Denver trip! Thank you!!

A peaceful oasis in between Denver and the mountains. The property itself felt and looked like a meditation retreat. I loved being able to work outside on the picnic table while smelling the local plants nestled throughout the property. We didn’t use the fireplace but it was was functional and looked beautiful. The inside of the home was intentionally designed to make most of each space. I didn’t feel confined at all. The feel was that of a rustic cabin, a minimalistic and aesthetically refreshing energy throughout the entire home. The bed was comfortable and the AC did a great job at keeping the home cool on a hot day, making for a cozy and comfortable stay. Overall I couldn’t recommend this home enough for anyone seeking a peaceful, mentally cleansing living experience with indoor-outdoor living. Cherry on top: the owner of this home is such a nice person and they were great / clear communicators from beginning to end. I can’t wait to be back!!!
We had a great stay! Short walk or drive to so many activities. Comfortable beds, covered easy parking, well-stocked and the easiest checkout instructions of all time.
Easy. Clean. Swanky. A refined landing spot after a fantastic day of whatever you want in the Denver area.
This was such a great stay. The area was super walkable, and the hosts offered great recommendations. Would definitely come back!
safe, clean, comfortable, nice location
Had an amazing stay!

Unit was very nice and perfect for our group. We will be back again. I was worried about parking but we never had an issue finding something close. Great building and location. Thank you for the awesome stay.

Lee’s place was in a perfect location. Walking distance to coffee shops, restaurants, ice cream, etc. Short drive into downtown Denver. The place was clean, and furniture was comfortable. We went on walks daily and utilized the backyard. We would definitely stay here again.
The place was better than i expected.... my wife loved the kitchen and it truly had everything you needed plus some.... host was very responsive..... would stay again....
My bf and I enjoyed this stay. Everything was perfect! 👌🏽
Great place and the host was very responsive. Definitely will stay here again!
Loved staying at Matt & Vicki’s! The space was clean, comfortable, and quiet and they were fantastic hosts! I’ll definitely stay there next time that I’m in Denver!
Jerry was a phenomenal host, he was very responsive and helpful! We will definitely be staying again!
The place was great! Clean and private. Everything that was needed was available. The neighborhood was peaceful and nice! Central too many locations. Highly recommended.

Josh is the best Airbnb host I have experienced. He is flexible, communicative, responds very quickly, and is genuinely an excellent human. We ran into some timing issues during our stay and Josh worked with us to make sure all went well. The location is superb… walking distance to galleries, restaurants, vintage stores, book stores, and coffee. Josh’s home is centrally located to almost everywhere in central Denver. We could be anywhere in under 15 minutes. We loved that! If you feel like hanging at home, the backyard is shaded and has soft green grass and lights for at night. Plus, there is a garage in the back that fit both of our cars. We never had to worry about parking. Josh’s place is very comfortable and well-stocked in the bath and in the kitchen with pots, pans, and cooking utensils. If you are looking for a place that is a soft landing after exploring Denver, Josh’s kindness and his place are what you want and don’t know yet that you need.
You Rock dude

Everything about LaMark’s place was amazing! Short distance from downtown Denver. We checked in late at night and LaMark was accommodating of our late arrival. All the instructions were extremely thorough. Absolutely loved how he has decorated the space, all the plants are gorgeous. Very pleasant stay and host.
Good location. Loved the family friendly environment.
Great Place
located in the arts district. if you want to spend your day walking around art galleries with short rides to down town this is a great place.

Everything about the loft was perfect!! Bright, clean, great furnishings, both the kitchen and bathroom were well stocked with the essentials. The coffee and tea bar was a nice surprise! The neighborhood is beautiful and safe, we enjoyed the park with walking and bike trails directly across the street and being able to walk to the nearby restaurants and grocery store was great. Ryan was a great host, responsive to questions and had a lot of great info for things to do in the area. Highly recommend and would stay again when in the area for sure!!
Great host and place!

Bianca y Sean están atentos a la mensajería de Airbnb y contestan casi al instante. El alojamiento es cómodo y bien decorado. Es tal como se ve en el anuncio. El hecho de que tenga espacio para parquear el carro facilita mucho la estancia, más si vas con equipaje. Además la ubicación es buena para caminar y apreciar el centro histórico de la ciudad.
Amazing location and amazing place to stay. David was great with communicating everything we needed to know about the location and the amenities available.
I had a great stay at Leslie’s place. It was convenient, comfortable, and exactly what you’d expect from the photos.
The best and came in clutch!

Carli and Adam’s place was gorgeous, and in a super convenient location. Space is well decorated and feels welcoming. Kitchen was well stocked, beds were super comfortable, and the porch spaces were awesome to sit outside and enjoy a cup of coffee or a glass of wine. Would absolutely stay here again!!
Thanks, great place!
Love this place! Would stay again.

Kimber’s place is immaculate, cozy, and a fantastic location! My daughter and I walked and explored Pearl Street and the surrounding area as much as we could. The neighborhood is a mix of older and newer homes with pretty landscape. Will definitely stay again!
South Denver area location was convenient for our needs.
Great spot in the neighborhood, we only stayed for a night but we loved it! The house was cozy and quiet, we would definitely come here again.
E
Cozy place. It’s very clean and well maintained. The neighborhood is quiet and there are a few good restaurants and stores nearby. The host Kirill is friendly and responsive.
We enjoyed our experience & stay here! It was very clean, very chic, & centrally located!

Really nice hotel right next to downtown Denver and the cherry creek mall was right behind the hotel.Lot of stuff to do in the areas and multiple restaurants and shops around so you never miss a beat.

This is a private, quiet place in an awesome neighborhood. It was so peaceful I can’t believe how close it was to downtown. The place was spacious and comfortable, especially after a long day of hiking. The little details and amenities made our stay so comfortable. Highlighting (from my girlfriend): the sound machine, the tower fan, the vanity space in the closet, the water purifier, and personal touches just for us was truly just outstanding. We highly recommend their space!
Great location.
Great stay, cozy place with a backyard. Had no issues with the kids there for a few weeks. Very safe area and Sloan lake is right next door. Very convenient for driving into Denver downtown.
Just what we needed! Equidistant from the airport and downtown, which was great for our one night stay.
We had a great stay! I would definitely stay again and recommend to friends!
Great spot to stay, not too far from everything and had good restaurants nearby!

We really enjoyed our stay. The house was a perfect setup with the rooms and beds available for our group. It was clean and provided all the kitchen and bathroom accessories we needed. The location was perfect for us. We were very close to downtown and centrally located for the ball parks we were playing at (we were there for a softball tournament). Overall, we would definitely stay again!

Carol’s property was very clean and comfortable, it was exactly what I had hoped for in a home base for a long weekend. Carol was a terrific host who was super flexible and accommodating. Thank you Carol!
Todo estuvo excelente, el lugar muy centro y a una cuadra de una parada de autobús. Todo lo que queríamos hacer en Denver nos quedaba muy cerca en Uber. Muchas gracias
Clean space in a quiet neighborhood. We loved the full kitchen and ping pong table.
Wonderful place! Very clean and homey. Would stay again in a heartbeat.

Lisa's place was great! I've stayed in a lot of Airbnb's and this was one of my favorites. The neighborhood is nice and walkable. We were close to all the things we wanted to do in Denver. I'd stay at Lisa's place again, definitely recommend.
Was just as expected. Room was clean and check in was smooth. Front desk staff was very helpful. We enjoyed our stay here!

Wow! I don't have enough good things to say about this listing. Before I even talk about the place, I just want to make mention of how wonderful Andrew and Viviana were as hosts. They always responded quickly, were a pleasure to talk to, and above all very accommodating and helpful. During our stay, the electronic door lock had stopped working. We messaged them, and received a response almost immediately, with them helping replace the system in just a short amount of time (during a busy long-weekend saturday) with NO inconvenience to our plans. Couldn't ask for anything more. The place itself was also great. Big enough for our group of eight travelers, clean, and anything you would need to feel at home. It's also conveniently located just a short 10 or so minutes walk from some local bars and restaurants in the Rino district which just happened to turn out to be my favorite area in Denver. It felt great coming back to this place every night. Highly recommended. Thx for the stay!
Great home our stay was awesome! Best part was we were able to see whole firework show for the 4th of July right by the house!!! Thanks again for a great stay!!
Great place to stay in Denver! Perfect location and super clean. Highly recommend!

Stunning home set in historic part of Denver. Loved the feel of the neighborhood as well as enjoying coffee while sitting on the greatest stoop ever. Coffee continued in the front yard with most of our time enjoyed out front playing cards and interacting with neighbors. Well appointed house perfect for our large group of varied ages. Would 100% rent this property again.
Alison was such a great and welcoming host. Her recommendations for brunch were great. We had really great sleeps too!

This was the perfect little spot for my partner and I to explore CO for the first time. Loved the neighborhood I felt very safe and the Tennyson area nearby was super cute. Very clean too! Would def book again.
We had a fantastic time at Katherine’s Airbnb. I would 10/10 stay here again. Great location!
Super easy and convenient stay! Thanks so much!
Very cool hostel/bar right in the middle of the downtown area. Lots of restaurants nearby & the Coor’s Field is within walking distance.
Had a great stay! I appreciated the quick response on any question. Would stay if in the area again.

Great house in a great location. It was easy to get downtown for our event at the convention center, but also easy to get away from downtown to a peaceful oasis. It had an excellent back yard to just chill, relax, and have our morning coffee. Thanks for a great stay Kevin!

Amazing place to stay highly recommend! We loved it , it was perfect for a weekend stay. Everything was clean and exactly like described . Hassle free , and if you’re able bodied the stairs weren’t even that bad ! We loved our stay and will definitely be looking here again in the future.

The spot was amazing for our trip to Colorado! Spacious & Troy was super helpful and responsive to my needs. I would recommend this spot if you are in town for something in the convention center, it is very close. The area was safe to walk around to eat/grocery shop.
This was a great place to stay at, close to plenty of businesses and a busy street but here it was so peaceful!
Great host! Clean townhome!

This place was absolutely perfect for what we needed it for. it was extremely clean. kitchen has everything you need. as described the location is just outside the industrial area, but was close to everything. Natalie is an awesome host. responds quickly. Another perfect diamond in the rough.
Overall the stay was good but the shower was missing soap. Small place but fine for one person.
Definitely would stay again !

A nice neighborhood with Liks ice cream within walking distance. Showers were comfortable and easy to use. A little warm in places other than the master bedroom where a portable air conditioner is placed.

Very flexible with the check-in as we arrived early. Property was very clean, comfortable, and definitely met our expectations! Great location, close to just about anything you would need. Allegra's recommendations of local restaurants were spot on! Thanks so much for having us, great hosts!
The place was exactly as the listing described!

Kurt was an awesome host, we met him upon arrival and then it was like he wasn’t even there ☺️ (as in it was very private and peaceful) The house was amazing, it was simple, clean and quiet. We would definitely stay with Kurt and Carol again!!
Dimas was an excellent host. The house is lovely and had everything we needed to feel right at home. We had a great stay.

Great location, and the most well stocked air B&B I’ve seen. Beds were comfortable and the space was spotless. I’d definitely stay there again. Would recommend bringing a sleep mask for the one bedroom as it gets light early.
The apartment was very comfortable & in the perfect location to get around town!

What a relaxing stay! Kelly has a beautiful home in a quiet established neighborhood. We took many walks looking at the beautiful homes and varied architecture. When we met Kelly the first day and she was very pleasant and kind. The space was outstanding; a staircase separates the living room from the bedroom and you can get some privacy if you wanted to watch TV while another other person was sleeping. Bathroom was great, and the space for making coffee and having some snacks was sufficient. We absolutely loved it, everything was very comfortable, and I loved the big windows in front of the bed.
Jeffery’s place was AMAZING and beautiful. Just as described and decorated to the tee. Close proximity to tons of local food and easy access to the interstate. Would stay again.

The place was very clean and we had enough space with 3 bedrooms. The only downside was there is no A\C, so it got pretty warm during the days and at night. There were portable fans in each room. Just a little too warm in July.

We stayed at Clinton’s place for a softball tournament in Denver. The location was centrally located with easy access to the highways. The space was amazing and exactly as described. Clinton even provided us some chairs to use at the ball fields which was appreciated! Neighborhood was safe and quiet. We would highly recommend and would stay again if given the opportunity!
