The neighborhood was very quiet, so I could sleep peacefully. It was within walking distance to several things I wanted to do. Chayla is a wonderful host!
Nice neighborhood and convenient for grocery shopping.

Heather’s place is gorgeous, unique and homey. She had lots of thoughtful and practical touches like a sewing kit, reusable bags, styrofoam cooler, etc. It felt like she really understood the guest experience! She gave us fantastic info about how to optimize our experience at Red Rocks, too!
Hayden was great very responsive. The space doesn’t have a lot of frills but centrally located, clean and walkable for the art district

This place was a great little getaway in Jefferson Park area. Easy walking distance to a few local dining spots, close to the stadium, and quick drive to LoHi area for more bars and dining options. We used the outdoor patio space to just relax and enjoy the view of the park after our adventures around Denver. Alejandro was great and super responsive. Left extra bedding and towels as there was three of us for part of the stay. It was a bit cozy for three but it worked for what we needed. Overall an excellent AirBnB experience!
Very nice place. Would stay there again.

The Artisan Loft is one of the beautifully created and maintained properties we have ever seen. The upscale industrial design is beyond compare, and it is lovely and well built down to the last detail, including the ouside porch and garden area, which we also enjoyed. We were grateful to have had the opportunity to stay there and would happily come again!
Beautiful carriage house it was located in an easily walkable neighborhood to many amenities
Great location. Super friendly staff. The garden in the back was so peaceful to have breakfast in the morning. Really wonderful stay.
Great host and house will stay again when In Denver

Very clean and tidy home! Looked like the pictures! The host’s were very friendly! Easy check in and check out! They didn’t have very many check out rules which is very nice! The host’s stay next door which is kind of cool! The house isn’t a bad area, and is close to lots of activities!
My husband and I stayed here while in town for a show at Red Rocks- Christina’s place was a perfect accommodation for us. Easy to follow directions and very responsive. Thanks again Christina!
We had a great time. it was in an excellent neighborhood to grab scooters and head out. We would definitely stay there again.

We thoroughly enjoyed the sleeping accommodations, the plentiful bathrooms, the perfect outdoor space, and the gorgeous kitchen. We also enjoyed the peaceful neighborhood and easy parking! The hosts were so responsive and kind, answering many questions and providing food recs. The space was perfect for our group and we hope to return someday.

The place was very clean and roomy for the four of us. Bed in bedroom was very comfortable. Has fans available, which I love my fan noise:). Has extra pillows and blankets. Would definitely recommend this place.
fantastic location in a super quiet neighborhood. Fast and easy to get to Red rocks or downtown. Airbnb was extremely comfortable Aden was great.
Loved staying at Gina's place. Everything was smooth and the space was comfortable and homey. Great location.

I stayed here for a month and would definitely stay here again - walkable area, easy to get to all areas of the city, tucked away in a quieter neighborhood but still plenty of restaurants nearby. The place itself had everything you could need and it was very safe and secure. Haylee was very responsive and quick to answer questions.

I’ve stayed at a handful of Airbnbs, and this one was by far my favorite! The space was spotless, thoughtfully designed, and had great family-friendly amenities. The location was perfect—just minutes from shops and restaurants—making everything super convenient. Overall, a fantastic stay and one I’d absolutely recommend!
Fantastic place!
Beautiful home! Felt very comfortable during our week long stay and Kerem was very proactive and easy to communicate with. I would highly recommend this home to anyone!
Stephen's place was fantastic. We will definitely be back!
Joshua's place was so charming and he had all the amenities we needed for our one year old and four year old. Great location and walkable to so many places!

My family of 3 enjoyed our stay at Bonnie’s place. We had a bit of a hiccup with check-in which was no fault of Bonnie’s, but she was extremely responsive and accommodating and we got it sorted out quickly enough. The unit itself is thoughtfully appointed and beautifully decorated- we really appreciated attention to detail like the plush throws on the couch and beds, and the comfortable furniture in the living area. We also really enjoyed the chairs for looking out over the city with our coffee in the morning, and our beverage of choice in the evening. We had a wonderful stay, and would love to come back next time we’re in town.
Great place to crash for the night. Awesome location and very clean.
Great stay in Denver! The townhouse was clean, exactly as described, and the host was helpful and easy to communicate with. Would definitely stay again.

We loved our stay, and would definitely book again. Check-in was a breeze, the appt was lovely, and the location was incredible. It's less than a two block walk to tons of great coffee shops, breweries, and restaurants.

We had a great stay at Joe’s place. The house is beautiful and clean, feels like home and brand new, is located in a nice neighborhood near to restaurants and stores. We didn’t have any issues during our stay, Joe was vey helpful and gave us good recommendations.

I took a solo vacation to Denver and this location was perfect! Also, having a dedicated parking spot took away the worry of parking. I felt so comfortable, cozy, and safe in this studio. Easy walk to Sprouts, a brewery, restaurants, and the park. David's Welcome Binder and labels were spot on and helpful!
A new concept of living in a small place for an extended amount of time, but with everything around you available and at reach in a great building and amazing amenities.
Matt and his wife are super friendly! Everywhere is clean and well organized. The bathroom is really large and decorated with ocean theme. The whole house is full of love. Thanks for hosting us!

Beautiful actual air bnb with a very friendly and responsive staff. The house is beautifully restored and every room is unique. The attention to detail is so appreciated - we had a lovely room on the 3rd floor which was very comfortable. The staff did everything they could to make us feel comfortable. The breakfast in the morning was absolutely spectacular which we had in the lovely garden at the back. Lovely visit all in all.
Clean and close to everything I needed. Very basic but got the job done. Would stay here again.

This is our second stay at Jennifer's carriage house and we wouldn't stay anywhere else. Her place is absolutely spotless, super comfortable and in a great location. We love walking to the RiNo only a few minutes away. The train station is a 7 minute walk and goes directly to the airport. I highly recommend Jennifer's place.
We had an amazing family vacation in Denver and TJs place was perfect. Perfect location, quiet, in a nice neighborhood. We would certainly book here again!

Have stayed here several times and always enjoy it. Great proximity to walkable places in a good neighborhood. I believe they live in the house but they’re never noisy. There are some cats that wander the place which for me is an added treat. You have control over AC and heat so you can set the room to your liking. I’ve stayed here in winter and summer and both are solid. Would def recommend. You will interact occasionally with the folks there but everyone is kind and respectful.

We had a great time at Trish‘s house. It was so clean and had everything we needed. Trish was very helpful. She met us at the house and showed us everything we needed to know. We had one problem with plumbing that she resolved quickly. We especially loved sitting out in the beautiful backyard. The house is beautiful with lots of eclectic art and comfortable furniture.

My family and I were very pleased with the overall stay at Nanas place. Very cozy, spacious and the best part pet friendly. Only thing I would say furniture was a bit outdated. Overall great experience.

Allison and Jason's place worked out perfectly for my daughter and I on our trip to Denver for a few days. In a great location to all the Denver spots, the description and pictures totally matched the Airbnb. Everything was clean and there were fun little extra touches - pasta and sauce left out for our use, coffee press, games and albums with a record player. We were welcomed and told to help ourselves to their herb garden if we wished. There was a cute little table and chairs outside the door for coffee in the morning. We would definitely stay here again! Thanks, Allison and Jason!
Chris and Allison’s place is super cute and it is in an excellent area. Central to anything you would want to experience while in Denver We enjoyed our stay very much 💕
Perfect location Beautiful home.

Mark & Lauren’s place was amazing! The house was beautiful, spotless, and in a fantastic, peaceful location! We felt safe there with our children and did not have to worry about anything common in old houses such as chipping lead paint - the paint is fresh, the beds are very comfortable, and it was spotlessly clean! The cute touches such as typewriter and postcards and organic snacks and a personal note, were very special and welcoming. We couldn’t recommend these hosts more!

Location location location. Felt like you could walk the whole city of Denver nothing was too far away. Plus a plethora of options just outside the door. The place looks exactly like the pictures absolutely Spotless, comfy bed and pillows. Felt like you were in a quiet part of town while right in the middle of it. Easy parking and could get on any highway I needed to right close by.

The Queen Anne Bed & Breakfast was absolutely stunning. Beautiful property with an amazing garden in both the front and back. It is in a great neighborhood directly across from a beautiful park and is very centrally located for many things around downtown Denver. They were extremely accommodating with us. The breakfast is cooked to order every morning by a private chef and they work around any dietary restrictions you may have. On our last morning, we woke up to a neighborhood power outage, but the chef and staff didn’t skip a beat. A camping stove and solar powered kettle were assembled and before we knew it, we had a full breakfast and coffee brought out to us in the garden. Oh, and they bake scratch made cookies EVERY DAY! I cannot recommend The Queen Anne enough. We will most certainly be back!
Hosts were great ., the house was great, comfy beds, open space .Definitely recommend.
The place was freat, clean, cozy, comfortable and convenient. Host was quick to respond and friendly

Matthias' place was great. It's a beautiful, huge house and the bedrooms and common areas are all very large and very comfortable. I loved that everything had a clean, classic look and there was zero clutter anywhere meaning we had plenty of space to spread out. Matthias and his lovely family were very warm and welcoming and responsive. Would definitely stay again!

We had a great stay while visiting family in Denver! We really enjoyed our daily walks around DU and the surrounding area—it was such a treat to stroll to a nearby coffee spot each morning. The location is fantastic—close to Wash Park, Pearl Street, and South Gaylord, with plenty of great restaurants and shops nearby. The house itself was very comfortable, and we especially loved the indoor-outdoor flow with the patio. My only suggestion would be to add blackout curtains in the master bedroom. With our days packed full of activities, it would’ve been nice to nap during the day or sleep in past sunrise. Overall, a wonderful stay in a beautiful neighborhood and Chris, the host, was fabulous to communicate with during our stay!

Sergio provided pictures of the check in process, which was extremely helpful. The home was very clean and comfortable. All cooking utensils were available to make breakfast in the morning. Easy access to the bridge and union station. Lots of restaurants around. Lots to do. Excellent people watching area as well. While it is right next to the trains, we didn’t notice it at night when we were sleeping. Finally, the mattress was amazing. Highly recommend and would stay here again when in Denver.

Troy’s place was so great! Very clean, easy to find, and the rooftop was so cool! I took my cup of coffee up to the rooftop in the mornings, fantastic view. We felt right at home in Troy’s place. Loved having a kitchen to do some cooking. I would definitely book with him again. When I had questions, Troy was very responsive. Thank you for everything!
Carson’s place was absolutely amazing. It is so incredibly well done. A perfect place to stay when visiting Denver.
I enjoyed my stay very much. The location is great. Kat is very responsive and friendly.
Nice and spacious home, walkable to restaurants and the botanical garden. Was easy to find parking. Having a backyard was a plus. Would highly recommend Rohini’s place.

We had so much fun on this trip. Accommodations were perfect for two adults and two teens. Plenty of space for us and terrific location that was easily walkable to many great shops, coffee, and cool restaurants in the neighborhood. The unit was modern and well appointed and offered everything we needed. Hosts were very responsive to our questions. Highly recommend.
This Airbnb was very comfortable and beautiful. The location was walkable, and felt safe. The kitchen had everything needed to prepare a meal. The hostess, Dana, was very responsive to my questions.
Really great stay and lovely host
Great location for going to Coors field. bedding is not the best. ok for a short stay.

Crystal is a fantastic host and the place was awesome! The room is very clean, quiet and has beautiful decor with a nice balcony. The amenities of the place are incredible. There’s multiple entertainment rooms, a full fitness center, yoga studio and the pool/hot tub on the rooftop are amazing. There’s even outdoor TV’s and lounge areas on the roof!! We watched the game and drank up there and it was pure zen! We will for sure be returning!

This was such a lovely place to stay and the hosts were very helpful and responsive. Definitely read the description as you will likely encounter unhoused people near the apartment. We had no problem with anyone and everyone kept to themselves, so it was absolutely fine, but for people who are not from cities or used to this kind of environment, I’d understand if it could be stressful. With all of this said, this Airbnb was perfect for us! We walked into RiNo a few times and were able to take scooters over to city park for jazz which was incredible and rented a car to head to Red Rocks. The apartment was very clean and tidy and had a plenty of helpful items within like ziploc bags and a basket of snacks. The beds were very comfy and the shower was great and spacious. Only feedback was I wish the water pressure was stronger and the AC was a little quieter.
Great clean place. Thank you!
Beautiful place, well furnished. It had just what we needed for our small family. We would stay again.
Awesome place to stay in Denver. Safe, cozy, and convenient. Will definitely visit and stay in here again next time in Denver.

Staying at Christie‘s, was like home away from home, except we were in beautiful CO instead of steamy NC! We loved walking along the sidewalks through the lovely neighborhoods, restaurants, the mall, etc. It was easy to get around by car as well. Great location! Would definitely book again~
We had a lovely stay at Jeremy’s place during our girls reunion. We had a car so it was easy to get around and it was centrally located.

This is a very sweet spot. The apartment is well equipped and quite cozy. The bed was comfy and big. The garage was great and welcome. The neighborhood has bars, restaurants and grocery store all within walking distance although the neighborhood is a little gritty, I felt safe. I would have enjoyed having an owners guide with some tips in the area but having said that I did not reach out to the host. My only suggestion would be a refresh of the outdoor area which was nice at night but could use a little TLC. I would definitely return!

Fantastic stay in Denver! Perfect place for two of us while visiting family. Great, quiet location within walking distance to restaurants/coffee. Holly’s place was super cute and clean. Had everything we needed!

We had an amazing stay at The Denver Art House! The house is designed incredibly, very comfy furniture, perfect for a group and felt like a special place to spend a few days with friends. I would definitely recommend and hope to return again!

This place is amazing. My husband and I normally travel to Denver weekly from the mountains and this was definitely our favorite spot from now on. Speaking of views, able to see downtown Denver and Powerfield Stadium, or better known as Broncos Stadium. The place is impeccable, modern, and super organized. I absolutely loved it! We're really looking forward to coming back. Thanks, Justin!
Cute back garden private entrance. Spacious with oversized furniture. Older home had lower ceilings, dark bathroom. Functional for a quick stay.

I'll start with the positives: Chelo was super kind as he allowed us to stay beyond the checkout time because we were tired after a long flight. That helped a lot. Communication with him was clear and nice. The apartment is definitely homey and cozy, and really well decorated, with some nice personal touches. The kitchen is perfectly equipped for cooking. The beds, both in the bedroom and in the living room, were extremely comfortable! It was mostly clean and we felt really at home, thank you Chelo. On the lower side, we had multiple issues. First and most importantly, the water pressure in the shower was extremely low, almost to the point where it was unusable. Also, it was hard to control the water temperature and it kept shifting from freezing cold to scolding hot. The trash can in the bathroom wasn't emptied before our arrival, and generally the cleanliness could have been better. Also, there's no AC and the windows can't be opened. For very hot days that's not ideal. Thanks!!
The space is small but clean. The apartment is on a busy street but there are parks, coffee shops and restaurants within walking distance. Access to the light rail is great.

Amazing location! Our stay at Tennyson was phenomenal. Cole was incredibly welcoming and thoughtful throughout the entirety of our stay. He had tons of great suggestions on where to go, where to eat, what to see... Plus, his place has the most epic sitting window that looks right out on the heart of Tennyson! We would love to come back one day and stay at Cole's place again!
It’s a great place to stay, the kitchen area is smaller than we imagined but overall great. The hosts are very kind and provided prompt help when we need some extra kitchen utensils. Recommended!

We really enjoyed our stay at Shannon’s AirBnB. The place is quiet and private, easy to get to with plenty of grocery and eateries within a short drive or even walking distance. Lots of amenities and nice touches like a hand written note and flowers to welcome us, beverages in the fridge, kitchen basics including coffee and creamer. Highly recommend and will definitely look at this place first the next time I visit Denver!
Nice Stay, can not think of anything that we missed. Enjoyable days….
Love Denver and this was a great location within easy walking distance of Union Station. Highly recommend

I had a wonderful stay at Racheal's place! Check-in was seamless. The space was exactly as described; clean, comfortable and thoughtfully decorated! Thank you for the warm hospitality! I would absolutely stay here again!

My group loved all the areas to hang out in Luke’s place. There are places to come together and places to hide away with a book or headphones. I typically don’t like hot tubs, but Luke’s salt water hot tub is 🧑‍🍳😘. Luke was very responsive before and during our trip — the house was low on some staples (dishwasher pods, trash bags, etc) when we arrived and since we were going to be staying a week, Luke had them delivered to us.

I had a great experience with my stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in easy. The neighborhood was safe and convenient, with plenty of shops and restaurants nearby. I’d definitely book again and recommend it to others looking for a smooth and enjoyable Airbnb stay.

Love Brett’s place. It was beautifully appointed and in a great location! The rooftop was my favorite place to hang out and see a great view of downtown Denver. We even could see fireworks from there one night! We would definitely stay there again
Great place to stay and will be back when traveling to Denver.
Highly recommend. Great place in a great location.
Perfect for a couple of days when you don’t need a full kitchen but a clean, easy and comfortable place to stay. We would definitely stay here again.

We had a great stay at this Airbnb during our visit to Colorado. The home was exceptionally clean and well-maintained, which made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. The host provided clear and detailed instructions for check-in and throughout our stay, which made the whole process smooth and stress-free. The location was perfect—close to all the places we wanted to explore, including local attractions, restaurants, and scenic spots. It truly served as a convenient and peaceful home base for our trip. We would definitely recommend this place to others and would gladly stay here again on a future visit!

I can’t say enough about how wonderful my day was. Nadine was an excellent host and very responsive. The furnishings and decor were stunning! The house was pristine clean. My son and his family within the area and I will definitely rebook.

All was as described. I was traveling solo and it was perfect for what I was looking for. Clean and comfortable and the washer/dryer came in really handy. Price was more than fair for what was on offer.
Great place to stay in Denver
We had a lovely stay in Denver, great location and very comfortable. highly recommend.

Place was clean and aestheticly pleasing. Dallas responded quickly and kindly to all inquiries. Parking on the street was seamless. Also appreciated the scentless space as someone who is sensitive to fragrance.
Lana is a great host and the place is super cozy. Would definitely stay again.
Great host! Lovely location! Such a charming neighborhood that we goto out several times every day to enjoy long walks with our dog. We wish we could've stayed longer!
Awesome area, awesome little apartment and awesome host. Literally could not have had a better experience. Will definitely look to stay here if I’m back in Denver.

Apartment is great once you get inside. The photos are accurate. Host is fairly responsive. Some of the responses seem Ai generated but nonetheless responsive. Location, while close to downtown, is rough. Many homeless, houses surrounded are run down and “questionable” activity at night. I would not feel comfortable here with children. Fine for adults. Would not walk around at night.
The studio was very comfortable and was in a great location. There was no place to get ice. There is a bar downstairs but it was not open the Wednesday night we were there.
Robert’s place is amazing! Beautiful home with everything you need. Wonderful neighborhood and in a great area. I would stay here again and again.
Fantastic stay
Cindy's place is exactly as described. Peaceful and clean with all the amenities. No parking on-site, but it was very easy to find close street parking. We would definitely stay again.

Super cute place in Denver! Couch and beds were comfy and had all the amenities that you would need for a few nights. Christine was also so nice and responsive, would recommend staying here if you’re looking for a place in Denver!

We had a great time at this airbnb. The neighborhood can be walkable but it would probably be better to take ubers in the evenings/late night. We absolutely adored the deck! The kitchen would be perfect for those wanting to stay in and cook. The beds were very comfortable and the bathrooms had loads of space for getting ready. We'd absolutely come back!
Richard’s place was perfect for my husband and I to explore Denver and the surrounding areas and experience a concert at Red Rocks. Everything you need, walkable, and quiet!

Kendra’s home is exactly as described and presented in the photos. Wonderful and walkable area with great food and bars nearby. Rooftop deck has beautiful view overlooking the city. If timed right the Elitch Gardens fireworks are an amazing view. Kendra provided great instructions, very responsive to communications, and easy checkout. I would absolutely stay here again if I were in Denver area! It was an absolute pleasure. Thanks Kendra!!
The house was comfortable and beautiful! Perfect location in a great neighborhood. Rooftop was epic and bedrooms so comfortable. Slept good every night!
Great spot for our family to crash for a quick trip. Very clean and had everything we needed! Nicholas was easy to communicate with too.
Perfect studio in the basement of Lucy's house. Bed was comfortable with enough pillows, full bathroom, kitchen area with sink, microwave, and frigerator!

This place does not match the photos. It’s clear they took photos years ago and since then, then place has fallen into a state of disrepair. There were holes in the walls and shower, terrible lighting, a window A/C unit in the way of the curtains (which couldn’t be closed because the place would get too hot). The sheets smelled bad (probably just super old), the internet only worked if the bathroom door was completely shut, the plants had been dead for months, and the lights were a mess to get on at first. The door hardly locked and the gate was broken, so if I weren’t with a partner, I wouldn’t feel super safe. The shower is also a major slip and fall hazard- it needs a safety mat and the fridge is almost worthless due to lack of shelves. Overall, great location, but one of the worst AirBnBs we’ve stayed at. Just felt misled from the photos and like the owner needs to put more care into maintaining it.

Wonderful place, comfortable and well-furnished for long stays and remote work. Terrific location, one block to Whole Foods and restaurants, easy walk to parks, Botanic Garden, Denver Art Museum, and downtown.
Kelly’s place is very spacious with great amenities, and fluffy towels! Kelly was very communicative and was flexible where she could be with late checkout, which I appreciated.
Bianca’s place was fantastic and in a great location.

We had a wonderful stay at max’s place. Max was a great host. The apartment is clean. We were going to stay until November but there was a Karen downstairs harassing us, telling us that we don’t belong there. She almost ran me over with her car. Max has a beautiful place and I would’ve loved to stay there but unfortunately things didn’t work out.

Taylor was absolutely INCREDIBLE! What an amazing host! We had the pleasure of briefly meeting him and he was so kind! Taylor was also great with recommendations and helpful information for the area. The neighborhood is perfect! So much to do and everyone is so friendly. If you are considering booking this place, stop thinking and do it!!

LaMark was a very warm and kind host! His house is absolutely beautiful and the room we stayed in was incredibly comfortable. He truly welcomed us into his home and we are so thankful he allowed us to stay with him!

Hillary’s home is lovely and the area is so walkable! Every direction we went we found lots of restaurants, parks and shops. The home itself was clean, cozy and had everything we needed - we enjoyed our stay.
This was a great spot! The apartment was very comfortable and clean—I would love to stay here again! Walkable to a bunch of cool vintage shops and good food!

Leah was a friendly and communicative host. Her directions and photos for the home were incredibly helpful, arriving after dark by myself I had some difficulty initially locating the alleyway with GPS but since she had sent such clear directions I was able to figure it out quickly. The home itself is adorable, spotless and comfortable and the koi pond in the back was so peaceful and such a fun little detail. Highly recommend this home and this host!
Very cozy space! Would love to revisit
Perfect location in walking distance to lots of great restaurants and shops!
What a wonderful time it was, to make friends, and cook good food.

Great place to stay in Denver, for a variety of reasons. First off and foremost, Cindy and Daniel are fantastic hosts. We've stayed there 3-4 times and a part of any trip we look forward to is getting to sit in their backyard and chat. Place itself is excellent - always clean and comfortable. Backyard is a great place to sit and unwind. Location is excellent for several things around Denver. Like quirky - 5 minutes to South Broadway. Want to go to the zoo or Botanic Gardens - 10 minutes or so by car. Looking for restaurants - hard to decide whether to walk or drive because several are nearby. Want a complaint - here it is. They do too good a job and it's hard dates when apartment is open! Easily one of the best places to stay n Denver!
We loved staying here! Great location! Would book again!

We loved Kristin's modern, one-bedroom carriage house – an ideal Denver base! The unit was perfect for two, offering a comfortable living room, good Internet service, and an in-unit washer/dryer. Having a full kitchen was wonderful for leisurely breakfasts at home. The carriage house felt private, quiet, and clean, making our stay incredibly relaxing. It's fantastic location was perfect for walkers (we did 4-5 miles daily!), providing easy access to a diverse range of fantastic restaurants like Snooze AM, Jelly, and Duo. We especially enjoyed the 30-minute walk to the baseball stadium. Marco's Coal Fired Pizza had amazing gluten-free pizza (dedicated oven!), and Acova was another great celiac option. For non-walkers, Uber/Lyft are readily available. Beyond dining, the neighborhood felt very safe. Kristin was an exceptional, proactive host, providing clear communication and ensuring everything about our stay was perfect. We truly couldn't have asked for more. We'll definitely be back!

Clean and cute space in a great location, with tons to do in walking distance or a short uber away. Conveniently close to a train stop to the airport, Union Station, etc! We stayed for a show at Red Rocks and visited Meow Wolf. The space is on the smaller side but for 2 people who were mostly out and about, it was perfect. The bathroom felt luxurious and the shower & tub were wonderful. The bed was also very comfortable and soft. The area felt safe and we enjoyed the nearby art district. Fair warning that that you can hear pretty much everything on the floor above you, people walking/talking etc. Patti was a very kind and responsive host. Would definitely stay again!!

This is a beautifully designed and outfitted apartment. The bedrooms are comfortable and the living area is pleasant and very much suited to hanging out with family and friends. Also, Jen and Rob are great hosts. We ran into some trouble with a closet door (totally our fault) and Rob was over to fix it ASAP. We'd love to return here the next time we're in Denver.
Always a good choice for us

I stayed at Mari and Chelo’s place for just over two months during my internship. They were incredibly kind, easy to talk to, and made me feel safe and welcome. The Skyline Room was spacious with lots of closet space and a private bathroom, plus I had designated pantry and fridge space. While they were lovely hosts, the home felt more like living in someone’s personal space than a shared guest area. The living room wasn’t a space I felt comfortable using, and the kitchen was sometimes cluttered and not the cleanest. The house can also be loud at times due to thin walls, a vocal dog, and activity at odd hours. The location is better suited for someone working near the airport or Aurora, as there’s not much nearby and it was a long commute to Centennial. Overall, I appreciated their warmth and hospitality, but spent most of my time out of the house as it wasn’t the best fit for my needs.

I had a great time in Andrew's Accessory Dwellong Unit above his garage. it was a nice one room space where I was able to relax and sleep. I spent very little time in the Airbnb, and found Rhino to be a great gateway to Denver.
Huge well appointed kitchen and the outdoor space was tremendous! A little tricky driving up the first time at night but very good directions. Will certainly stay again
Great stay, exactly as described. The place was clean, comfortable, and the hosts were responsive and easy to communicate with. Would definitely stay again.

Great place to stay if you're coming to the Denver area to see lots to things. It's centrally located. The host was super flexible with check-in and check-out and answered the few questions we did have quickly. The only downside is that the upstairs part of the house got very loud at times, including during the off-peak noise time. It got much quieter after the first day or so. But if you are planning to stay in a lot, this might be something to know. Otherwise, an overall pleasant stay with very kind and responsive hosts.

Such a beautiful home and great hosts. Kat was very responsive and helpful/friendly. I really enjoyed my stay here, the bed was extremely comfortable, almost like sleeping on a cloud, the living rooms were so adorable and the shower had a cute design with great water pressure. The house overall is so adorable and is perfect if your looking for more a cute vintage approach w some modern designs as well. The neighborhood overall was very walkable and safe. There's many places that's close nearby that you can take a peaceful walk to, for example city park and coffee shops. The location of their house is close by to downtown and union station, about 10 mins which makes it efficient for transportation. The hosts does a really good job in making sure their casa es su casa. I would definitely stay here again!!!!
Skyline Aristocrat exceeded all expectations. Gina went ABOVE and BEYOND in helping us in all stages of the reservation and check in process. We will be back as soon as possible.

The place itself was good and decent. However something weird happened when the host took two of my suits I placed in the closet. When checking out I texted him he said yes he has them and he thought they belonged to the previous guest. This didn’t make sense because the previous guest was a woman and the suits are men’s. I don’t know what was going on but I am glad I remembered that my suits were missing before checking out. The host didn’t ask before taking them. Don’t know what his intentions were but that happened.

Beautifully preserved carriage house. Very clean and stocked with necessities. Claire is a lovely host and fantastic communicator. After a long day of driving she left the lights on for us. Our fur pups loved meeting Bear 🐕 and the beautifully fluffy resident black cat 🐈‍⬛. Wish we could have stayed longer. We wouldn’t hesitate booking again in the future. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Haley’s home was wonderful! It’s located in an area of Denver (Cherry Creek) that’s super charming and very walkable. We stayed with kids and walked to the botanic gardens, restaurants, the pool, everywhere! Haley was a terrific host. Would recommend to anyone looking for a quiet stay!
Exactly what we needed at the end of our trip! The space was beautiful and Andrea & Mike were so kind and responsive!
Peaceful neighborhood. Restaurants all with in a few blocks. Walked for miles with my dog. House exactly as pictured. Bonus was the back yard for our fur baby. Would definitely stay again.
Stayed here a second night at the end of our trip and had no issues. Room was clean and comfy bed.
We loved staring at Erin’s place. The apartment is cute and you can’t beat the location. Walkable to so many shops, restaurants, and bars. We’d stay again in a heartbeat.

The Airbnb was very clean in a great location close to a lot of things downtown 5 to 10 minute Uber ride if you’re not driving very secure to get in elevator or through any door every door you need a code.
Great for a short stay. Plenty of places in walking distance to eat at or grab a coffee. Seems like a good neighborhood. We never felt unsafe.

This was a great stay for a week of work with my finance and our friendly dog Jack! Comfy, quiet, and cozy. There are really beautiful walking trails within five to ten minutes south of the home. Overall, a great stay!

Our stay at Megan’s guesthouse during our recent trip to Denver was great! The space was clean and exactly as pictured. The bedroom was cozy and the bed was very comfortable! We appreciated the treats left for us and the coffeepot. Would stay again if we’re ever in the area!
Loved this place. Very clean and great location.

Just came back from a week in Denver for a show at Red Rocks. Holden’s space was absolutely perfect for us and another couple we traveled with. Centrally located and could easily walk to many areas of Denver that we were looking forward to: RiNo, Larimer Square, Coors Field. Breweries and tons of restaurants not far from the front door. Holden and co-host Devin were extremely responsive and accommodating with any questions we had. Easy to get out in and out of downtown as well if leaving the city as we did some white water rafting and Rocky Mountain National Park. Location was our top priority and this could not have been any better if looking to really explore the city!!
Enjoyed our stay. Convenient and cozy!
Excellent location. Very private. As described. Very quiet. Nice to have parking space right next to the unit. Highly recommend.
This space is great. Very convenient location and nicely furnished. As noted, you are downtown and there are a lot of homeless people around but they never bothered us. The host was very responsive.
Needed a last-minute check-in on my way back from West Yellowstone all the way to Oklahoma! they accommodated my needs, Place was very quiet and peaceful and clean.
perfect for what we needed for the weekend my friend and I were close to the concert we went to. great location

Wonderful place next to Washpark. Very walkable to park, light rail station, and good restaurants. Brett’s place was very neat and cozy. Very clean and nice shower room and living room area. The place is very spacious and renovated! Totally recommend to stay.
Kerry was a very nice host. Enjoyed our outdoor space also. Would definitely recommend staying here!

One thing I like about this place it was the vibe I was looking for while at visiting Denver. The backyard and front your was open and relaxing. The bed and the AC were heaven and the nights are really quite. I love the shower for my height of being 6’4 and the living room was so warm lots of art and vibrant lighting at night.

Location was incredible and the place itself was very clean and suited our needs for our month long stay. We were both able to work remote with video calls & have no wifi issues. The loft is the perfect area for remote work. Lots of stairs which we had zero problem with but worth keeping in mind if that’s an issue for you. The parking garage was also very convenient.
Great stay! Erica was very responsive and we had a great time!
Enjoyed our stay.
Great stay for going to a Red Rocks show (20mins away) or exploring the area. Great location and close to coffee and restaurants! Glad we found this place!

Perfect for our needs. Easy to get to red rocks for a concert and great brewery/coffee shop right at the end of the street. Amanda was very responsive to any questions we had. The place is just as pictured. Would stay again!
Fantastic location!

We stayed at Jennifer's AirBnB to do sight seeing in Denver and as a home base to check out Estes Park and Breckenridge. It worked out great! location was convient and felt very private. Kitchen was well equipped for making meals too. We spent a lot of time chilling on the patio in the evenings and mornings. She has a friendly dog who was always excited to see us! There was also a sweet neighborhood cat that blessed us every morning before we headed out - as cat owners it was a nice surprise!

Shannon’s place is incredible! Great location right in the heart of RiNo and the Arts District. Great breweries, restaurants and vibes abound! The home is well equipped, spacious and perfect for the price. Would love to stay again.
We loved our stay at this clean apartment! It was walkable to some amazing restaurants and a great place to work from home when needed. Would stay again!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Two Wolves. The house location is perfect if you want to split your time between downtown Denver and seeing a show at Red Rocks, which is exactly what we did. There are also great grocery stores close by like Trader Joe's and Whole Foods, in addition to a local store. The kitchen has everything you could possibly need to cook up meals. The house is super clean, fully appointed. The beds and furniture are so comfy/cozy. The back yard is beautiful and peaceful with soft grass I walked (or laid down) on every morning to get grounded. We enjoyed our coffee, wine and meals outside. Alan, the owner is available if you need him and great to talk to, but also makes sure you feel like you are the only ones there. Highly recommend if you want a quiet, comfy, homey, reasonably price place to stay in the Denver area.

This was a great place to stay! We loved how walkable the neighborhood is and the building was safe & quiet. We rented a car and had no issues with finding free street parking. We walked to coffee, dinner, and ice cream, but also loved the easy access to 25/70 to get to other places around the area. Overall, we would highly recommend!

Our family had a great stay at Tanya and Kelsey’s Guesthouse in Denver. Communication was great and self check in was a breeze. Their place is super clean and stocked with anything you could possibly think of needing to make your stay comfortable. Added bonus was how easy I was able to work remotely, using the workspace and monitor that was provided. We would definitely stay at Tanya and Kelsey’s place again!

Lily was super responsive and even had us able to check in early! They had everything we needed at her place. They were down a fan but immediately responded to our request and brough another one. The place is small but it's perfect for our 1 one night stay. The backyard and table was great to enjoy the nicer evenings. The beds were incredibly comfortable! The water pressure in the shower is low and slow, but nothing that's unmanageable.
This is a beautiful house in a lovely neighborhood! Had off-street parking, which was great. Very well decorated, and had TV in living room & primary bedroom., which is always appreciated.
Adorable studio. Spotless and super comfortable. Easy uber ride to tons of great Denver spots.

if you like city life and historical buildings this is the place for you. the host was very quick to respond to any messages. with a few furniture and maintenance upgrades, the inside would be quite cozy. the outside of the building is less than desirable due to the liquor store below flooded with trash and homeless people. the taco joint next door was quite tasty.

Our stay was wonderful! The RiNo district is a cool and fun neighborhood with lots of fun bars and restaurants within easy walking distance of this charming house. There was a park right nearby that kept my daughter entertained for hours! Rachel was friendly and very responsive. Can’t miss!
Amazing host and great place to stay
The location was prime and walkable to many shops and restaurants. The street was peaceful and quiet, with beautifully manicured landscapes.

Great spot to stay in a great neighborhood! Tomas was an awesome host, quick to respond and even accommodated a late checkout for us. 12/10 stay, and would definitely book again next time I’m in Denver.

Zosia was very good about responding to needs. Her place is attractive and very nicely remodeled and updated. My stay was interrupted by a hospital stay and surgery (hiking accident), so not as enjoyable for me as it would have been otherwise, but that of course was not her fault.
Nando’s airbnb was excellent - location + check in instructions were clear. Airbnb was clean and comfortable. Would stay again

The house is beautiful, comfortable and immaculate. It has everything you need & more. The area is nice and close to everything. The host was very nice & accommodating. We would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others.

We really enjoyed our stay! The space was beautifully updated, sparkling clean, and ready for guests upon arrival. It’s located in a quiet, safe neighborhood, and the host provided detailed directions for accessing the space via the alleyway which was super helpful. The kitchen was well-equipped with high-end appliances (though we did have to Google how to use the fancy stovetop). We also appreciated the filtered water in the fridge, especially since we were staying extra hydrated throughout the week. The shower was truly amazing—I could’ve stayed in there all day! There were a couple of minor hiccups: one of the two AC units wasn’t working, but the host did provide a box fan, and we grabbed a second one for comfort. The pull-out couch was a bit tricky—only one adult could comfortably sleep on it, and we had to prop up the head with couch cushions. We also noticed a small leak from the washer. Overall, it was a great stay in a beautiful space!
Quiet, cute little place to stay for a concert downtown. Walkable to Sloan's Lake and Odell's brewery. Easy to Uber to the concert venue.
Very nice place to stay in Denver, centrally located between downtown and Rino. Walkable to lots of dining, bars, breweries, and Coors Field for some baseball games.
A+
Great place. See last review.
Convenient location but neighborhood sketchy. However, apartment itself felt safe. Enjoyed patio in evenings when temperatures cooled down.
Excellent place to stay!

Phil & Laura’s place was such a great choice! Close to the light rail that takes you right to downtown Denver, close to a little shopping store for essentials and also check out the Pupusa truck set up in that same parking lot! Hosts were wonderful and had a lot of great suggestions of things to do and where to eat. We will return!

The Moxy was a great place to stay for my daughter and her boyfriend in their 20s. It was a super convenient home base in a great area with tons of shopping and restaurants right out the door! They had a great time and said the room was awesome. A tip for future guests who have a car- you can save yourself $40 a night by finding a close by spot using Spot Hero vs paying the crazy hotel parking fee. ;)
This is a great find, and I would stay again!!
Nice place, well appointed
The host was very responsive and helpful!
The place is same as described, clean and has all amenities
Cozy and spacious apartment in a great location.

This home was so beautiful and felt so homey. Our favorite part of the house was the peacefulness of the backyard! Everything is so well organized and is stocked with everything you need ! The location is super close by to fun activities and popular areas. Jennifer and Lydia are great hosts and very clear with check in and check out instructions. They even have a list of recommendations for things to do around the area! Definitely booking again for future trips and events!
A beautiful home that can fit a big group while also being very conveniently located to great bars, restaurants, and more. We had a great time, and all communications were fast and easy. Thanks!

This house is so cute, and we loved the location! Very easy to walk to RiNo for food and drink, and we got a parking spot right outside. It was peaceful, had everything we needed, and the patio was great. Jeff was easy to reach.
Had an amazing stay!
Fantastic for large groups who want to be near the city.
great place to stay would book again very friendly and nice area

Devin's place has a comfy bed and a hot shower, just what I was looking for. There aren't a lot of bells and whistles, but thats what I was looking for. The neighborhood felt safe and secure. If I had any complaints, it would be that the rental is the basement. I was kind of expecting a guest house, but it wasn't a big deal.
The space was great for our group of 4, and it was so close to many things to do. Would definitely recommend to others and look into booking in the future.
Absolutely loved this little apartment for the weekend me and my auntie stayed here! lovely cute little apartment was very homey and the balcony was just the cutest!

This place was absolutely perfect for our weekend with our kiddos and their friends! Close to Elitch’s and walking distance to so many things! We all felt right at home! Jake and Whitney are great hosts and very responsive.
Cute little space. Great location. Jessica was very friendly. Good for one traveler staying a few nights. Thanks Jessica!
Great stay, great location!

The apartment was cute and clean and thoughtfully outfitted with everything we needed. The decorations were cute. Nice central location to everything we wanted to do. The owners were super friendly and responsive! Overall a great place to stay!
Second time staying here and had another great experience. Wonderful host, neighborhood, and location.
Very nice and comfortable!
Great location, comfortable space, helpful host!
Ken is a gracious, communicative, and understanding host.
Absolutely perfectly appointed and stocked! Wonderful location and felt like a luxury stay…wonderful spot!
Very comfortable and clean. Would definitely book it again.
The place was stylishly decorated, clean, and spacious. The swing egg chairs were very comfortable. We had a good time relaxing in the cozy living room.
Incredible unique spot!
Beautiful apartment very nicely furnished, worked out great for my family

This was such a great find! Easy walk to everything you could want whether in LoDo or on the other side of the river. The place was clean, had a very nice work space with an inspiring view of some Denver attractions. It was really nice to be in the thick of everything with a quiet getaway right in the middle of it all. The host is exceptional! Very flexible and responsive to questions. I couldn’t say enough nice things about our experience
This place offered everything we needed. Very comfortable bed. Place was larger than the pictures looked. Beautiful back yard
Very wonderful host and the home was beautiful.

Check in was flexible and easy. Apartment is as pictured. For tall guest note that the apartment is in the basement of the house so the doorways are often less than 6 ft. The kitchen and bathroom seemed like they could use a deep clean. Pink and black stuff is growing in the shower but the shower is very nice and hot. Spiders also seemed to enjoy this place along with us. Neighborhood felt a little rough. Overall, the apartment is fairly represented and if you want a nicer place it will cost more. I would recommend this place as a budget stay in Denver. It’s close to public transportation so that is nice as well if you don’t have a car. Washer dryer worked well.
Great stay and exactly what we needed for a quick night away. Comfortable, clean and welcoming.

Robert was great to work with! He accommodated an early check in for our group and was very easy to get in contact with. The house fit 9 adults comfortably in town for a wedding. Would definitely recommend!
Quick stop over in Denver for the night and Christopher's place was great. Very clean, comfortable and tastefully designed. Would definitely recommend staying here!
Excellent location, quiet, safe.
Wonder location with easy walking to everything I needed.

This condo was the perfect location for walking through Denver. There’s easy access to the dairy district, union station, 16th street mall, the art museum, and the capital. We walked everywhere! The condo easily accommodated 5 people and was a lovely space. When we had issues with air conditioning, the host was very responsive. Thank you for letting us stay in this beautiful condo!
Great little house with a private backyard, garage for parking, and centrally located in Denver close to everywhere we wanted to explore. We had a great stay!

We had such a great stay at Jonathan’s place! He was an incredible host—communicative, thoughtful, and truly went above and beyond to make our weekend special. We were in town for a bachelorette party, and Jonathan surprised us by leaving some snacks and drinks to welcome us when we arrived. It was such a kind gesture and made us feel immediately at home. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience—highly recommend booking with him!

The house was great and we had a fantastic trip! Very clean and nice having a private yard to yourselves! The area surrounding it wasn’t my favorite. I know it’s the city and there are not always brand new neighborhoods, but this was a little run down for my personal comfort. I mistakingly assumed the surrounding houses would look as nice as the one we stayed in. The music hall is also right up next to the house. When booking I thought it was down the street. We loved the music from next door but it’s much closer than expected! The house itself had everything we needed and was great! Again just sharing my experience with the surroundings I’d want to know if booking!

LOVED this well appointed, beautifully decorated home. It was so comfortable. We both slept better than we had in weeks. We had plenty of privacy, but Rick was very friendly and always available to answer any questions and recommend local restaurants. The location can't be beat. It is right across the street from the excellent Denver Museum of Nature & Science and a short, easy walk to the Denver Zoo. The large Denver City Park has two lakes and makes a great location for an evening stroll. I can't recommend this place, or our host Rick, highly enough. Next time we visit Denver, we will definitely stay here again.

Jamie’s place was perfect! Well appointed and spotlessly clean. Location is wonderful. Jamie is a great host. He is flexible, responsive, and incredibly compassionate. We had a family emergency and he was great in meeting our needs and working with us to make our visit perfect. We will definitely be back!
Great place, clean, easy to get too and great communication
The best host by far, ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ gold stars.

Daniel hosted us for my bachelorette party and all weekend all of my bridesmaids could not stop commenting on how nice the place was. It was very clean, has a great basement for movies and a lively kitchen, and the rooftop was so much fun. Daniel was very responsive and helpful for the whole trip and made it very easy on us to check-in and check out. Overall an amazing stay, would highly recommend!
Nice place, fits well for a group.
The condo was great with 2 master suites which suited 2 couples nicely. Everything we needed was at our disposal. Will definitely stay again if we get back to Denver.

Had a great stay! Bed is super comfy, had an awesome coffee/tea set up., some key bathroom toiletries. Very close to beautiful park and golf course, short driving distance to awesome tacos. Hosts were very clear and responsive. Very tidy!
Great spot to rest if you’re exploring the area. I would stay here again
Great stay, very nice neighborhood and not too far from downtown or restaurants in the area.

This is by far the coolest hotel/airbnb I have ever stayed. The place is beautiful decorated, full of little sweet surprises, like a gorgeous bar on the roof top, the closet under the bed and the window that becomes your movie theater. Take the time to explore each nuck of it and be ready to be delighted.
It was perfect for our quick stay. Such a cute area!

Loved our stay here. It’s a cool place with a comfortable bed and an ingenious use of space. There are lots of good restaurants within walking distance and we appreciated the breakfast options that came with the room.
Great location perfect for anyone looking to be right by Downtown Denver. Very clean and walkable to Rockies Stadium and all the fun district around it.

We had a wonderful stay at Maria’s charming space in Cherry Creek! It was exactly as described—easy to find, simple to access, and stocked with everything we needed and more. Thoughtful touches like small toiletries, earplugs (though the space was very quiet), and a well-equipped kitchenette made our stay extra comfortable. The only thing we missed was a dedicated kitchen sink, as we had to use the bathroom sink for mugs and silverware. Still, the Nespresso machine and coffee add-ins were a great perk! We loved relaxing on the beautiful patio and would’ve spent more time there if we weren’t out exploring the city. Maria’s chic spot was perfect for our girls’ weekend—cozy, stylish, and convenient. She was incredibly accommodating, responsive, and friendly. She allowed us an early check-in & frequently checked in during our stay to make sure we had everything we needed. We had a fabulous long weekend and would stay at her place again in a heartbeat!

Under difficult circumstances we booked Josh's place at 9pm and found everything clean and orderly. Josh was very responsive and accommodating, and I would highly recommend a stay for someone looking to be right in the city and near the park.
Would highly recommend, walkable to a lot of cool restaurants and shops!

Everything about Liliam’s place met our expectations. Clean, cozy and comfy. It was a pretty hot weekend in Denver and we were able to stay cool as a cucumber in between outings. Lots of great restaurants and super cool artwork to check out while strolling. I would totally stay again.

This is the most well-equipped Air Bnb I have stayed in. No stone went unturned when it came to the amenities. The hot tub was a great option to unwind after a long day of exploring. Kimberly was quick to respond with all of our questions and left a book filled with great recommendations. Check in and out was very simple. Thanks for everything!

We enjoyed our time at Simon's place. The space is nice, very comfy and you're close to a good amount of shops (we utilized all the scooter share apps nearby). We cooked in the kitchen a good amount which was nice and all in all have no complaints! We had a great trip and thankfully worrying about the airbnb was not one of the things we had to do while in town.
Great place! Would stay again. Sonja was great!
We enjoyed our stay & would stay again.

Rick's place is exceptionally well-equipped and comfortable. We enjoyed the easy access to the 32nd Street restaurants and the Sunday farmers market. We also appreciated Rick checking in to make sure our stay was going well. It's a nice spot, and we can recommend it without reservation.

This was a GREAT stay for our first time in Denver. Our host Alex was great, communication was definitely there - they gave us recommendations on things to do and places to go which was so helpful. The location is awesome, because even though it’s not directly in “Downtown Denver” there are so many impressive, enjoyful spots within walking distance. The only thing we struggled with was finding the place. The directions were super clear though! We’re just not used to the city layout and it only took a few extra minutes to figure it out. 10/10, thanks for having us!

Shaun and Shelby are incredible hosts. They were very responsive and are so kind. when we had an issue with the AC they came and fixed it right away and compensated us. Their house is gorgeous and has everything you need, it was so clean and the location in the trendy RiNo neighborhood is unbeatable. I would stay here again and highly recommend it!

We loved our stay at Kristen's! The location is perfect, walkable to so many good restaurants, bars, shopping, and music venues. It is stocked with everything you need and the beds and linens are very comfy. So thoughtfully decorated and Kristen is a wonderful, communicative, accommodating host. Don't hesitate if her place is available, book it!
Absolutely wonderful home with plenty of space to stretch out. Would highly recommend!

Stacey has put a lot of thought and effort into providing a very welcoming, comfortable, and functional space with her furnishings. She had everything needed for a long term stay too! For a small home it was great for myself and my dogs. There is even a doggie door to the backyard! Neighbors are kind and helpful. Neighborhood is quiet too. Really loved her place and I highly recommend for single travelers! Reasonable rate too compared to the majority of Denver AirBnB’s available.

Great place! The location was great and having a parking spot was essential. Lisa was super helpful and super responsive. We had the best time! I will DEFINITELY keep her in mind for my next Red Rocks trip.

One of the best airbnbs I have stayed at so far!! Very helpful host, clean and beautiful space and checked in with us to make sure we had everything we need for a nice stay. I will be back for sure!! Thank you for our amazing trip to Denver

We loved our stay! I was a bit worried as this was our first time staying in a guest suite air bnb, but it was very secluded and felt safe. Loved the neighborhood and how quiet it was. This has been one of our favorite air bnb stays!

We had a great stay at Laura’s place! She was very helpful and responsive, and checked in with us mid-stay to ensure we didn’t need anything. The only things to note would be the living room area seemed slightly smaller than what was pictured, and there is no door to the bathroom coming off one of the bedrooms. Walkable distance to many downtown Denver attractions, and not too far of a drive from neighboring cities for hiking (Boulder, Golden, 1.5hr from Estes/RMNP)

Great stay! Stayed for a month and the hosts were great and helpful. The Airbnb is quiet and has what you need for a short or an extended stay. It looks just like the pictures, a little small, but there’s an amazing outdoor area to use and I would certainly stay here again! Overall, def recommend.

This home was so cute and perfect for what we needed! We had 6 couples and there was the perfect amount of space, and we loved hanging out in the backyard and around the fire. The home was supplied with everything you could need and everything we forgot :) highly recommend!
This was our third stay at Ruby's place. The space, the host, and the location keep us going back.
Beautiful stay. Nice welcoming snacks. Very clean, nice neighborhood.

Great location with easy access and restaurants nearby. Place is well kept, well appointed and has a cool historic vibe. Neighborhood is lively at night, so if you are a night owl, you will love it! Zach was amazing and easy to communicate with and gave great recommendations for getting to/from Red Rocks easy- thanks!!
Elegant flat in a chic neighborhood!

Great location in capitol hill area. Trader Joe’s is right next door. Off street parking available. We enjoyed the outdoor seating space. Renovated kitchen. Would book again when in the area. Close to area restaurants in walking distance.
Kasa’s apartment was a fantastic place for us to stay the night. It was clean, fairly central and more than enough room for us all. Would stay again.
Lovely, quiet space.
This is my Denver go to! Great location and everything you need. I will definitely be back again. :)
This place is so cute and charming, just like the description and better. Plus Mish took great care of us, communicated right away and supplied everything we needed. I highly recommend staying here.
Jessica’s place is a very beautiful, cozy, clean place to stay! The location was perfect for us and we walked everywhere. Loved our stay here and would absolutely stay again.
We loved sitting out on the patio with the gas fire pit! So nice for summer. And having a full kitchen and laundry was also helpful.

Conor's place is by far the best Airbnb experience that I have had. The place is easy to find and is in a very nice, safe and quiet neighborhood. Check-in was so easy. The space felt like home to me as I am a neat, clean freak. It did not have any odor, it just felt great from the moment you walked in. The place had everything you could possibly need. I stayed for 5 nights and he had everything from olive oil, coffee pods to dryer sheets, everything, and not the cheap stuff. The shampoo, conditioner and body wash smelled dreamy that I felt spoiled when taking my shower. The bed is THE MOST COMFORTABLE bed ever, so I slept extremely well. The sheets were delicate and clean and the extra pillows made it heavenly. Extra towels were provided which I did not use but was really impressed by it. The decor in the unit is modern so you feel like you are staying in a 5 star studio unit. Conor was very accommodating and communicated well and on time. I am very happy I booked!

This is a great stay! The apartment is super nice. Very clean and updated. The amenities are great- snacks, water, and treats for the dogs - which was nice. Great location if you want to be in the middle of Denver attractions - Meow Wolf, Denver Aquarium, mile high stadium. I highly recommend.

This bedroom is exactly as described, with clear instructions on house use and guest expectations. Tricia was always easy to get a hold of, and super flexible anytime I had a question or request. If you want the experience of being Hosted, I highly recommend this stay!
Great location, clean, great space for a couple. Brett is a great host! Very responsive, definitely makes his guests a priority!

Cozy spot with lots of good food options within walking distance. Perfect place to stay if driving out to Red Rocks - quick drive! Lots of cool artwork in the house. Coffee supplies, beverages and snacks were provided. Lance was very responsive to my messages. My family and I had a great time in the space. Highly recommend!
I loved this Bnb! It was very spacious and very clean. I’ll definitely stay again when I’m in the area.
Excelente lugar
Great location and great stay. Super close to good restaurants and bars without being noisy at all.

Mark was a great host. Met me as I arrived and made sure all was perfect. Went out of his way to help accommodate us with parking and gave extensive recommendations for the area. Highly recommended Mark’s place.

Pamela was a wonderful host with the house comfortable and right across the street from the botanical gardens. The beds were very comfortable and we felt right at home. Full kitchen which enabled us to cook meals. The outside area is comfortable to sit out especially in the morning and evening with the friendly chickens running around. The chickens are very friendly and love people visiting them. This is an old Victorian with lots of interesting wood trim and floors. The rooms are big so this is excellent for three couples or people with children. Pamela provided many extras like cereal, milk and fruit along with coffee and tea to start your mornings. My only regret is not having enough time to visit with Pamela and Greg and learning more about wines. Would definitely consider this location when I am in Denver again.

We enjoyed our second stay at Dave and Johanna place! The location is great and the unit is spotless and well-stocked. After a few hotel mishaps, we are grateful for a peaceful place to stay while being close to everything. Highly recommend! Highly recommend!
Great place for Denver, walk around a beautiful lake and great restaurants down the road!
It’s important to note that the house has only one bath.
This is a very cute guesthouse attached to a garage. It’s very close to lots of great shops and restaurants. I would definitely stay here again!

Heather was a great host. The apartment was clean, everything was as described and it wasn‘t too far from downtown. Good place to go visit Golden, Red Rocks etc too. Heather also responded quickly to our messages. Thanks again for having us!

This apartment is in an incredible location in RiNo. It was easy to find and access, and absolutely beautiful inside. Zach was a great host and made us feel very welcome. We would absolutely book again!

We had a great stay at Simon’s place. The neighborhood was quiet and the backyard was a great place to relax in the evening. The house is super cute - Simon did a great job remodeling a historic home. Parking was always available and a King Soopers grocery store is only a couple of blocks away. We would definitely stay here again!

The space was cozy and interesting. I always think it’s funny as a pet owner to see people consider fenced sidewalks as a fenced yard for dogs but fortunately there’s plenty of actual green space around within a few blocks of walking. I wish the kitchen space was a bit more functional considering how steep the steps are and trying to walk with plates to eat so you aren’t stuck standing to eat a meal in the kitchen. The upstairs was great thought comfy bed, good ac system and solid place to land for a few nights.
Clean and convenient stay for our day in Denver

The place was a wonderful location, I enjoyed my room,upon check in the place seemed very clean, I used the UV light in the bathrooms and so forth and everything was sanitized well. she was very accommodating and had a wonderful, beautiful home. Lots of cool things to do right around the apartment. Wonderful town
Well appointed. Great design and thoughtful amenities.
Je recommande vivement. Très bonne literie, super machine nespresso, calme. Un très bon sejour.
My stay at Thomas’s was great! Safe, quiet neighborhood and my room has everything I needed!
Thank you!
Amazing location! The host was amazing!
Cute neighborhood! Very responsive hosts. Would definitely stay again.

Dane’s place was perfect for our family trip to Denver! The place was spacious and accommodating but and the view from the roof top terrace was great! The kitchen was spacious and equipped with everything you could possibly need. The living room with the super comfy couch was perfect for movie watching or game night ( with lots of provided games) and the 3 spacious bedrooms gave us lots of room to spread out. The master bathroom shower was amazing..and having a tub in one of the bathrooms was perfect for our littlest traveler! The home was impeccable and Dane was super responsive from booking to check out! Highly recommend!
Carole allowed us to check in early and was great with communication. Her space is very nice, clean, and private. I highly recommend to all travelers!

I thought the description of the place with photos was accurate. It was very clean and i had everything i needed! Bed was very comfortable. I appreciated being told where to park. I only got a little confused at first as the GPS doesnt take you to a back alley where to park but nonetheless once i figured it out. Which didnt take long. It was an easy find and great location.
Great location and the home had everything we needed!
We loved our stay—uniquely decorated, perfectly stocked kitchen for cooking, comfortable beds, and a convenient location. Would love to stay again!

We enjoyed our stay! It was very clean and the bed and couch were comfortable. The furniture and ascetic are really nice. The neighborhood is quiet and street parking was easy. The only thing to note is that you can hear people talking and moving around upstairs. We stayed for a few nights and it didn't bother us, but if you're picky about sound, that is something to consider.
Location was very central to everywhere we needed to go. It was spacious and plenty of kitchen items to use such as dishes spices coffee etc.

Let me start by saying, my partner gave this place 5 stars and I gave it 3. So we met in the middle with 4. Here’s the pros. It’s a beautiful place. I like the layout, kitchen and lighting throughout. It’s decently close to downtown and you can walk to places. Some downsides, the bed wasn’t very comfortable, there were no blinds on the small windows above the bed which were too bright for us to sleep in, and the apartment sits above the garage so the garage door opening up, woke us up as well. Lastly, I didn’t think to read this closely but it was the first Airbnb I stayed at without a tv. My partner didn’t care but there were times I wish we had it. The hosts are outstanding and communicate very well.

comfortable and at home feel. even though days were hot, nights were cool and we were comfortable with the fans- no AC needed! safe neighborhood, good location- I don't think we drove more than an hour away in the whole week we were in Denver. we had a lovely stay!
We had a GREAT time here! My son and (now) Fiancé found the place perfect for our needs. Katie was helpful and responded whenever we had concerns. 10/10
Great place to stay!

This is a cozy little place that is clean and convenient to get to. Check in was easy and everything was just as described. We did have some issues with the internet when we first arrived, but our host was very responsive and got the issue resolved quickly. Other than that, the amenities were perfect. I wouldn't hesitate to stay again, for sure.
Great location near Washington Park. It is a nice basement apartment. We would stay again.
Excelente anfitrião, recomendo!

The space was great and located in a perfect location for wandering the vibrant neighborhood. Located right in the middle of wonderful restaurants and coffee shops. The garage door was a huge hit. Really fun to have it open and people watch. My husband was working while traveling and this was the ideal situation. Cole is super friendly and quick with communication. If driving suggest you park out front and once unloaded park the car on a nearby side street without parking restrictions. Super easy. Would definitely stay again!
very nice apartment
Excellent experience. Would return to same accommodations is ever back in the Denver area.
Our stay at Johanna's was great. The place is brand new and just as described. It was centrally located for all of our activities and we found several great restaurants in the area.

Judy’s place is beautiful, cozy and the neighborhood feels very safe. I needed a place to stay for two nights in downtown Denver for a professional commitment and many of the hotels are over priced with no included parking and the reasonably priced ones are in very sketchy areas. This apartment is located in a peaceful and very safe neighborhood, this has a lot of value to me considering how sketchy some Denver areas are lately. The apartment was spotless and very welcoming. Everything is as described in the listing or better. I wholeheartedly recommend this gem to anyone visiting Colorado. Thanks Judy!
Thank you for letting us stay at your AirBnb! It was perfect for our family.
This is such a sweet space. We had everything we needed to enjoy our stay. The beds were super comfortable and the water pressure was perfect. The location is excellent! A+
Eric was a very accommodating and a kind host. I highly recommend him if you need an extended stay.

The space was just as described and in the pics. I had to work quite a bit while on my trip to Denver, so having an extra monitor to connect to my laptop was perfect. The space was clean and comfortable. The Arts district was a neat area. Very short walk to Renegade Brewery and Coffee. Was able to easily find Parking. Close to Cherry Creek path to downtown for a few jogs and quick commute on a Bird Bike. Hayden was super flexible and responsive. Would stay there again.
Great place to stay! Very convenient locations and instructions from Anthony were really helpful. Would love to come back and stay here again!
Had a lovely stay. Everything was clean, comfortable, and matched the listing exactly. Beautiful little place. Really appreciated the coffee station and other nice touches. Definitely recommend.
Had a great stay!
This is a very cute and cozy place to stay if you're wanting to experience different areas of denver! Very close to downtown and has a lot of local shops within a 10 minute drive!
We had a great stay, place was very clean, and Troy was very accommodating!

Nicole and John are very thoughtful hosts and made sure we were comfortable and happy throughout our stay! The local dining recommendations were outstanding, the neighborhood is beautiful and peaceful, and the space is clean, comfortable, and cozy!

Jeremy & Adeline were great hosts. Unfortunately the A/C died on the first day right before my arrival but they were proactive in letting me know and offering to cancel / refund. They were able to get a company in to completely replace the A/C the very next day and offered me a discount for the inconvenience. I would definitely stay there again in the future.
Great place to stay! Perfect location, very walkable to all sorts of great bars and restaurants. Would def recommend!

I definitely enjoyed my stay with Zuni Lofts! The place was just like the pictures on the listing. I loved how the place was decorated and situated; it felt lived in. The building and the surrounding neighborhood was safe and lively. There are a lot of restaurants in walking distance. It was really easy to get Uber/Lyft to the spot for pick-up/drop-off. I’d book this place again!

Lovely stay! Used this as a home base for a conference at the Mission Ballroom. I didn't have much of a chance to explore all the great-looking restaurants in the area, but I did very much enjoy having coffee & croissants every morning at Hearth a block away. The room was clean and comfortable and spacious, as advertised.
Apartment very well located, very clean and organized apartment.

We had a wonderful stay! The location was perfect—just a short drive from Red Rocks, which was the highlight of our trip. I brought my daughter for her birthday, and the place was clean, cozy, and had everything we needed. The host was responsive and made check-in super easy. It felt like a home away from home, and we loved being so close to both Denver and the beauty of the foothills. Highly recommend for anyone visiting the area, especially if you’re planning a Red Rocks show! There is a shuttle nearby that gets you there and back! Easy!
Dion was accommodating and always helpful when I had a question. The place was spotless and exactly what I was looking for.
Beautiful place! Decor was amazing, place had everything we needed for all 16 of us. Location was great. Totally recommend!

We loved our stay and Craig a phenomenal host! The neighborhood is quiet, peaceful, in a great location and the porch is a great addition! We had a little trouble with the bathroom door but Craig took care of the issue same day and definitely goes above and beyond as a host! My wife and I needed a quiet place for her to study while in town and Craig’s place was just that. Highly recommended!
