Patti’s place was a lovely find in a lovely neighborhood. The location was incredibly convenient for exploring the city and the accommodations were second to none. It did not disappoint and I would eagerly stay here again.
This place was great. I hands down will recommend it to anyone who is looking for a good spot. Spotless clean.
Comfortable little space with a private backyard. We were only there for one night, but I easily could have stayed for longer.
Super cute and great location!
Excellent location, great stay. Zach had good communication, checkin/out was smoother than any hotel in the area.
Overall an amazing place in a great spot, Catherine was an amazing host for our stay, will definitely stay there again if we decide to come back!
I have no additional feedback to provide

We absolutely loved staying at SkyLoft for our “mini” honeymoon. It was perfect for us newlyweds & we really appreciated all of the recommendations for things to do, places to eat, & the tickets to the Denver Botanic Gardens. We would definitely book again if ever back in Denver!
Friendly and helpful host. Good location and lots of space for all my friends. Great place for a friends and family reunion.

Overall this is a nice, clean and spacious apartment in a good location close to places to eat and drink. Beds were comfortable, the kitchen was nice, bathrooms were clean and very ample storage areas if you're in a big group. Check-in was straightforward with clear host instructions. The apartment's front door uses a security code, but lacks an audible signal to confirm relocking. The host provides an online portal link to check lock status. The outdoor area could do with a spruce up and one of the wooden benches was snapped. You're overlooked by the building opposite so would be nice to have the option of blinds or curtains for some privacy. Light sleepers or remote workers may need earplugs due to constant thudding from upstairs footsteps.

This place was rad. Great room and amenities were cool. Hotel smelled kind of weird- NOT the room. That was perfect. Loved the shower! Disappointed I didn’t realize that parking on site was $52 for overnight. STEEP.
Great place, felt like home

This was a beautiful AirBNB! Perfect for couples! Loved the patio with the beautiful Denver skyline views and the area is soooo walkable! Little Man Ice Cream, Maci Cafe, Postinos, Little Owl Coffee, and Recess were some of our fav places to walk to! Tracy was very responsive, proactive, and professional. Really happy with our stay and the quality of the apartment!
Lovely place, great neighborhood and responsive hosts. Hope to return.
Nice, very clean airbnb stay. Good neighborhood, pretty close to downtown. Was as described, it is a space over host’s garage so you do hear the garage door opening and closing but no big deal to us.

Fabulous apartment in a lovely, idyllic neighborhood!! Gustavo and Kathryn were always extremely responsive, friendly, and helpful. They let us leave our bags for a few hours after checkout, which was a lifesaver. The apartment is quiet and beautiful - lots to do nearby, but peaceful. Thank you so much for everything!!

Step back in time at this beautiful, spacious retreat. It worked great for me. I would suggest that if you are very tall, the bedroom area has low ceilings and plumbing pipes above, so it may not be the best for you. The gardens are fantastic, as is the location, and I had a good night's sleep.

Dillon’s place was wonderful! We felt right at home. He was extremely responsive and accommodating. He even accommodated us to leave our baggage in the airbnb after checkout since our flight was later. Thanks Dillon!

This place was exactly as pictured. Soft sheets and blankets. Had everything you needed with helpful notes around the place to direct you to everything. Neighborhood was quiet and very walkable to coffee, restaurants, and cute shops.
Just the place my partner and I needed after a long flight! Extra comfy bed and peaceful home. Adorable pets as well! Highly recommend!

Gosh, what a lovely stay. Spacious, spotless, comfortable, so many amenities. Kind and thoughtful hosts. Extremely comfortable bed. Lovely grounds. The neighborhood is great and full of interesting things to do. I would have moved in if I could have.
Nate and Jessica were warm, friendly and super responsive. It’s obvious they have a passion for historical architecture and work hard to make it available for their guests to enjoy.
Very clean place I. A quiet neighborhood but within walking distance to bars and restaurants. We would gladly stay again!

William and Denise were great to work with, quick responses. Typically, I’m resistant to booking a “guesthouse” due to the lack of privacy, but this is the best case scenario! It’s completely private, with a separate entrance and a fence separating from the main house. It’s a great space with good natural light, the bathroom is beautiful and super clean. I would totally stay there again. Thank you!
Nice place, I will stay again if I’m in the area.
Great home especially if you only plan to be there for sleeping and showering! very close to downtown and has local restaurants, breweries close by.
Fantastic location, charming home. Mariel is a fantastic communicator and excellent host.
The room was an upstairs bedroom and was comfortable and convenient. The host was easy to communicate with and accommodating. We enjoyed our stay very much.

The host was fantastic in explaining check-in and check out details. They had a pack and play plus washer and dryer on site. The kids and dog Loved the backyard. Location was fantastic. Close to Edgewater Market and Sloan Park, plus other Resturants and Breweries.

We had a delightful stay! The neighborhood is so cute and you can see The Radiator cafe from the property. Everything felt safe and very family friendly. I loved the front porch swing. The rooms were bright, clean and lovely. It was the perfect stop for us on our roadtrip and I would stay here again! Thanks, Adam!

Stephanie and her husband are some of the finest hosts Air B&B offers. Their guest space is an excellent place to stay, and overlooks their stunning yard and garden space. It's quiet, private, and well-appointed. The neighborhood is quite nice, as well, being close enough to Colfax and 6th to keep them in reach while being far enough to keep them at arm's length. As I mentioned, the hosts are friendly, receptive, and respectful to the Nth degree. They are receptive to feedback, and couldn't have done much more to make me feel at home. As a bonus, their charming cat loves to keep his guests company when he's not busy with his volunteer work in the local wildlife community. Only stay here if you like modern, comfortable, well-attended spaces with kind hosts and pleasant surroundings. Thumbs way up.

I had a great stay at Brooke and Jinoo’s place! The check-in was smooth and communication was always friendly and helpful. The house was clean, cozy, and filled with thoughtful touches, from Starbucks coffee to all the small details that make your stay more than comfortable. The neighborhood was peaceful and the space felt like a home away from home. I’d definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!
The property was great. It had everything you need. Parking was good.

The neighborhood is very walkable and safe and I enjoyed looking at beautiful exteriors of houses in this street! You can easily find cute cafes and great restaurants nearby and if you are lost Matt &Vicky also has lists of local recommendation. The Airbnb felt right at home and I had a quiet private room during my stay! 100% recommend.

I stayed one night at Alex and Daniel’s place and definitely recommend it! The neighborhood is great, with lots of restaurants and coffee shops within easy walking distance. The room is very clean, comfortable, and quiet. Alex was super communicative and helpful. It’s definitely a great base from which to explore Denver!
Great location and always responsive. Central and walkable to everything you need. Working from home multiple days and the internet was reliable and fast.
Great spot, the space was clean and comfortable. Easy to walk to downtown Denver and many coffee shops a short walk away.

We had a wonderful stay at Matt’s place! The bed was incredibly cozy, the Wi-Fi was excellent, and we really appreciated all the smart features around the home. Matt was friendly and quick to respond, making everything seamless. Beautiful new home & walking distance around Wash Park - highly recommend!
Great stay and location, would definitely visit again!
Such an adorable place! Super clean and cozy! Lucy was such an amazing host and would check in on us and made sure to make our stay enjoyable!
The location downtown Denver made easy to go out to local restaurants, concerts and Coors field.

We had a great experience! This apartment was clean, comfortable, and within walking distance to restaurants and shops. It was well stocked with items that would not usually come with an AirBNB. Rick was easy to reach, and there were no issues. We would come back here if ever in the Denver area again!
Had a fun time staying at this place.
Great place, great host. Took a VERY last minute reservation and got me out of a bind. Met JB as I was arriving and had a wonderful conversation. Definitely where I’ll stay next time I’m in Denver.
Chris’s home was perfect for our family who were back visiting after moving away from the area. Chris was incredibly responsive and helpful. Would absolutely recommend to friends.

Margarethe was a marvelously responsive host and so willing to accommodate what we needed. We were there long term before our lease started and she even helped us move some things over to our new home. Such a wonderful welcome to our new home in Denver.

I stayed for 2 months & anytime I reached out, Mark was quick to reply & helpful! Great place to stay only a few minutes drive to downtown Denver. It was super clean and had everything we needed. Thanks again!

Great location with multiple breweries, beer garden and coffee options, be sure to stop at Nowhere Coffee on 39th, awesome little place out of an Airstream. Nice park at the end of the street, easy street parking, pleny of food options nearby.. Black Shirt Brewery, RiNo Beer Garden, etc... Clean place, washer and dryer, private fenced in back yard for the pups.
Nice neighborhood, near plenty of restaurants. Comfortable stay.
Host was great and flexible with check in, park and grocery right there and not far from downtown!
Great location, walking distance to a lot of family friendly activities. Had all the amenities needed. Really enjoyed our stay here!

I had a lovely time at Adrien’s place. It felt just like home. I did have a few hiccups but Adrien was always responsive and willing to make it right. Enjoyed the area very much. Perfect for a solo traveler.
A newly refurbished home in a central location in Denver making everything in the city accessible.

We were blown away by the attention to detail and amazing amenities during our stay. Sloan Lake was so peaceful to walk around each morning and we enjoyed sipping coffee on the private rooftop patio. The beds were comfy and we appreciated the little details like a steamer for our clothes, instant hot water, washer / dryer, charging stations on the night stands, noise machines, etc. Would absolutely stay here again!

Joseph was a great host. He was super responsive and quick to fix an issue. The location was great, too! Cute part of town and good alley parking. However, two bedrooms didn't have doors and one bathroom didn't have a door so it lacked some of the privacy we needed with our party. In addition, the upstairs primary bedroom (king bed - one without a door) has no window treatments and bakes in the summer sun. So, if you are traveling during a warm season, be prepared that this room may be unusable. It is a pet-friendly stay which is great but it does come with the pet smells, too.
Great location & service. Super close to mall and really good neighbourhood. Looking forward to coming back!

We had an amazing stay! The apt was in a quiet neighborhood, and was nice and clean. My only concern was the mattress. It is a 1 bedroom, and the mattress was rather uncomfortable. We did a lot of hiking so it would have been nice to come home to a comfortable bed. Other than needing to update the mattress, the space was 10/10!

A very comfortable apartment for our short stay. The kitchen had all the basics, the beds were very comfortable, and the lighting is bright. There is now a small table in the dining area. The neighborhood is lovely and the hosts were responsive and pleasant. Even during a hot summer week, we stayed cool, and we heard no outside noise.

100/100 would recommend staying at Kristyn’s place! Kristyn was extremely helpful, kind, and accommodating! Her place was walkable to many restaurants and shops, but also was within driving distance to everything and anything! Extremely clean, centrally located, and Kristyn was amazing!
Very nice stay for a week in Denver. Hosts were very nice and helpful throughout the stay. We had a great week
This Airbnb was the perfect spot for a quick night in Denver before heading to the airport! Everything was clean, cozy and exactly as described.
Very responsive host, clean place, nice amenities!

There were many delightful touches throughout the place. The deck off the bedroom was a quiet escape among the trees. The place had everything we needed plus many touches that added to our comfort and pleasure.
Prima overnachtingsadres. Goed bed en sanitair

Great place right in the heart of Sunnyside, with restaurants a short walk away or a short drive to other Denver neighgborhoods. Host was great to communicate with, and offered a ton of suggestions. Highly recommended.

Great place to stay! My son and I attended a concert at the Bluebird Theatre and it was right within walking distance. Lots of restaurants and grocery shopping close as well! I would highly recommend!
Great deal Sarah was very helpful and the guesthouse was private and cozy!
Very nice stay—has everything you need, very clean, extremely comfortable bed.
Thank you!
Great location and clean space! They were very responsive to all the questions I had.
Would definitely book with Shane again!
Great, easy, nice

Great place and location - only one full bath upstairs with shower in clawfoot tub so a little tricky getting in/out - can’t beat location - spacious downstairs for gathering and sharing meals. Nice backyard with porch seating too. The kitchen is also well equipped. Def recommend Alex’s place

I stayed at Lisa and Alex’s place for a month, and it was a wonderful experience from start to finish. The home was clean, cozy, and had everything I needed for a comfortable extended stay. Both Lisa and Alex were incredibly responsive and thoughtful hosts—always available if I had any questions or needed help with anything. Would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommended!!

We loved our stay here - three nights in the middle of the week. The place is accurately represented and offered everything we needed - it was just me and my 12 and 14 yo girls. The place is cute and reasonably priced. Tons of stuff is within walkable distance - notably, restaurants, convenience store, and laundromat. We felt safe walking in the neighborhood at all times of day. Owners were nice and super responsive. I would definitely stay here again, It’s not perfect - but it’s not the Four Seasons and you’re not paying Four Seasons prices. It’s an older home that’s been moderately updated and has everything you might need for a few days stay. Only issue we had is that it took anywhere from 3-7 times with the correct code for the front door deadbolt to disengage - it’s only an issue if you really really have to go to the bathroom!
Great, simple, safe place to stay! Parking was a little tough, but besides that it was a great experience!
We had a great stay! Allan was amazing with instructions, suggestions, and responsiveness.

I had an amazing experience staying with LaMark in his amazing home . He is very responsive and very friendly . House is immaculately clean cozy and very well decorated . Very safe and central location . Will definitely stay again
Great place!
Great condo with good access to coffee shops and restaurants!
Great space & host! Perfect for a Denver getaway.

We had a fantastic stay in the heart of Denver. Everything was close by and extraordinarily walkable. The room was beautiful and very spacious. The hot tub was perfect and the record player was a nice touch. Can’t overstate how at home we felt. The staff were warm and welcoming beginning to end. Any questions we had were immediately answered and still can’t thank Nicole enough for giving us some of her own Tylenol. Thanks again. The service was fantastic. Breakfast was both thoughtful and delicious. The menu was different every day and somehow kept getting better. Fully expect a top notch breakfast experience. We’ll definitely be back next time we’re in town.
Loved the view and simplicity of the space

House was adorable- comfortably furnished, well-stocked kitchen, doggie door, walkable. Katie was very responsive & answered all of my questions. Would consider staying here again and would recommend it to others.
Amazing property. Must visit house if in denver with a big group
We really enjoyed our stay. Well suited for a long term stay and very nice unit. Would highly recommend!

Sam has a great space in a great location! Walkable to restaurants and bars. Very responsive and super friendly. Loved the extra living space. The lock was really tricky to figure out and caused a bit of stress going in and out. Unfortunately I had to dock a few points for that and due to another issue, partly out of their control I think, but I’m most positive it was addressed shortly after my stay.
This place was about 5-8 minutes from the Broncos stadium and other downtown functions. It was clean and the owner communicated well. Keep up the great work!
This is our second time staying at Melanie's, and it is always an exceptional stay!

We had such a wonderful stay! From the moment we booked, they were incredibly responsive and made sure we had everything we needed for a comfortable visit. They gave us fantastic recommendations for local attractions and restaurants — every spot they suggested was a hit! The home itself was spotless, cozy, and had everything we could ask for. The highlight for us was definitely the hot tub — the perfect way to unwind after exploring the city. Chris and Daniel’s hospitality truly made this trip memorable. We can’t recommend their place enough and will definitely be back the next time we’re in Denver!

We loved our time at this fabulous house. We had three generations, including multiple kids, and it was perfect. It was stylish, fun, spacious and inviting — the outdoor spaces, the main house, and the incredible screening room. Olivia was great to communicate with and all felt extremely easy. We’ll all be back for sure next time we’re in town — we all decided that we HAVE to come back to play more games, try the fantastic hot tub, and just hangout more.
Rental is as advertised.
My family and I had a great stay here. Street parking was a hassle but otherwise, beautiful and clean home.
We stayed for a week and were very satisfied with the place. The apartment is very spacious and everything was very clean

I stayed in Adam’s house for a whole summer while working in Denver. Overall I had a great time and I was happy with how my living situation worked out! Adam was super nice and chill, he also recommended local places to visit or go camping. The neighborhood is peaceful and it was nice having stores nearby. I’d definitely recommend staying here!

The house was great! Six adults fit very comfortably. The neighborhood is close to downtown without being noisy. There’s a cute coffee shop up the street that we visited multiple times. Worth a stay next time you’re in Denver!
Quaint and quiet. A good place to stay in the area. Parking can be tough with larger vehicles.

I found myself needing a same day stay in Denver for a few quiet days, and Mason’s place was exactly what I needed. Beautifully and neatly appointed, the apartment had everything I needed and was pristine and uncluttered. The linens, the bedding, the throw blankets were of a terrific quality too, which was a very nice touch. The bathtub was luxurious as well. As a basement apartment it was well lit and did not feel like one. One could hear slight footfalls here and there but the soundproofing was excellent, as I am very sensitive to sound :) There’s a small market I walked to which had everything I needed to pick up, with local and organic options. I did not venture much on this trip, but I could have walked to many local spots which Mason recommended. A great stay!

host was very responsive and understanding. the place itself was very accommodating with a well stocked kitchen supply, between seasonings/pots/pans/utensils/sponge/etc. well stocked bathroom, with qtips/bandaids/wet wipes/towels/etc. place is also in a really good location, right next to inspiration point park which is a cool lookout looking at the mountains, and its just a quick <10 min drive to food, shopping, coffee, dispensary’s, etc.. its also a not bad drive to lookout mountain which is a really pretty lookout point. overall great experience and perfect place for our group of 4, i would definitely recommend!
We can’t speak highly enough about the castle! It’s a great location really interesting space and wonderful hospitality.
Travis and Wendee were great hosts. We felt right at home in their beautiful home. It’s centrally located and very comfortable!
Great for a short stay in Denver

The place was even better than pictured and described and i absolutely loved the space and the neighborhood. It is in a lovely neighborhood that was quiet while surrounded by lots to see and do. I would recommend and hope it’s available the next time I’m in Denver!
Great stay. The house is very well located and it was well set up for our one year old daughter - high chair, pack and play, plastic plates and cups
Cannot speak highly enough of Emily’s place. Super clean and nice! Close to all of the things we wanted to do. All was as described and would 1000% stay again!!
Great stay at Allan’s flat. Really clean and easy to find
A great Host!
Nice cozy place
Great place to stay
I enjoyed our stay here even if it was a short one the city has a lot to do, and I would say if you love the city lights it’s a great spot to stay at.
A fantastic location for an extended stay. The house is very private with a great outdoor seating area. Perfect for a local visit to the university or to explore the larger Denver Metro Area.

The place was really cute, and Nikki and James were kind enough to be willing to accommodate an additional person (for 4 people overall) at no charge. The AC went out the 2nd day we were here, but once the hosts were contacted they were able to get it fixed within 6 hours which we appreciated as it was the heat of summer. We enjoyed our stay and felt it was a good value, and checkout was a breeze!

The house was very spacious, with plenty of room for our group of 5 adults. The location is nice, with some restaurants and a convenience stores within walking distance. But it was also a quick and easy Lyft/Uber ride to downtown for our meetings and events. I would highly recommend Aleah's place.

This was perfect for my quick stay in Denver! The spot is very well located and allows you to explore a nice area outside of downtown Denver while also being close enough to the train that you can get there really easily. All I could have asked for!
Kat's place was pleasant and clean! The decor felt very homey and personal. Checking in and out was simple. Thank you, Kat!

Our stay at Yemi's place was great. The place was clean and comfortable. The host was very friendly and responsive, which made the stay even better. The location was very convenient, close to everything we needed. We would definitely stay here again. Thanks Yemi!!!

It would not be a bad place but waiting for code to enter 3 hours was outrageous! Not even apology or anything. Just like nothing ever happened . I called 5 times , messaged multiple times - no response . Otherwise place was good but after a long day not to get codes till 8 pm is pretty upsetting .
Great place to stay, especially if you a traveling with many guests! The house was spacious and clean. The neighborhood is close to grocery stores and walking paths.
Amazing location, and very responsive hosts!
This is a beautiful home! We really enjoyed our stay here. Highly recommend!

I seriously cannot say enough about this place and Caren! Before we even arrived in Denver, Caren was communicative and welcoming. Upon arrival, we came home to a wonderful place with all the amenities and the best location. Just a quick walk to and from union station. Great food options and a grocery store right beneath the building! The place had everything we needed and more. Everything was clean and she even accommodated us with extra chairs. Beds were comfortable, bathrooms were lovely, and kitchen had everything we needed. The extra amenities in the building are awesome! The place was wonderful, but best of all was Caren, our amazing host! She was so welcoming and responsive. She really went the extra mile to make sure our stay was fantastic. Couldn’t ask for a better place or better host. If we’re lucky enough to be able to we’d love to stay here again for our next trip to Denver. Thank you Caren!
Clean and very centrally located for every plan we made. Great place
Lovely home in a safe neighborhood that is walkable to anything you might need. Beds were so soft and comfortable. I slept amazing!

Shane’s place is situated in a very quiet and peaceful neighborhood just a few blocks from the RiNo district. Parking was easy and plentiful. There a lot of cool bars and restaurants nearby. The unit itself was very comfortable and clean. Coffee is provided which was a nice touch.

My family loved this stay. The kids want to do well in college so they can own place like this! The deck and view are PHENOMENAL, and the interior decorating was top notch. Soaps in the bathrooms were high-end. We used one of the rollaways, which worked flawlessly. Closet space was plentiful. We walked to lunch at Tony P’s pizza, coffee at Sapor, dinner at Hampton Social and breakfast at the Fox and Hen. We’d heard that street parking can be tricky, but the neighborhood is super-walkable, so we just left the car in the first great spot we found. Highly recommend this stay in Denver!!

I highly recommend this place! It was spotless, very well decorated, and had all the appliances/everyday items you may need. It was a short 15 minute drive into the heart of Denver. The kitchen was very nice and the bathroom was spotless!

We had a quick overnight stay at Daniela’s (4 adults total). Daniela was responsive to any inquiries and had great recommendations. Everything was described as it was in the listing. As an added bonus, everything had labels so items were extremely easy to find. Thank you for a wonderful stay.
The apartment was in a great location with lots of things to do in RINO. The host was responsive and accommodating. Highly recommend!

I enjoyed staying here! It was very pleasant and was very easy to walk to different restaurants nearby. I enjoyed the vibe that the place had and loved the books that were left on the bookcase during the stay. I was staying for the APA convention, and Chelo’s psychology book selection was very nice. Additionally, while the place did not have AC, it was very comfortable in the apartment despite being in Denver during its heatwave. However, one critique I do have is regarding there being some dirty containers left in the freezer. Other than that, the experience was very pleasant.
We enjoyed staying at Sam’s very much, everything was exactly as described. We loved the neighborhood and location is close to everything! House was so cute and perfect for all of us.

Amazing location-- central and walkable but also private. Very clean, and so nice to have an outdoor space and also garage. Host was great about sending clear instructions but gave us our space--perfect balance. Definitely recommend!
Spotless, safe, and a fantastic host! Will definitely be checking here first for any return trips to Denver.
We had an incredible stay at this property. The house was clean and had everything that we needed. Additionally, it’s in a great location for exploring Denver.
I needed a place to stay for an internship and had a great time here! Molly was very nice and helpful.

Ricardo's place felt like home by the end of the stay. This was the perfect place to spend my days during my internship in Denver. The location was extremely helpful as I was able to walk pretty much everywhere. The space is neatly organized and provides you with everything you need. Ricardo never misses a thing! I am so grateful to Ricardo for allowing me to spend my summer at his amazing apartment. 100% recommended for any students interning in Denver!

Kimber's place is the perfect spot to stay in Denver! It is walking distance to great local coffee shops (we loved Steam and Corvus), close to beautiful parks (check out Washington Park), close to great restaurants (we loved Somebody People) while also being quiet and private! I really appreciated how many windows there were and the vaulted ceilings with skylight which let in beautiful morning light and made the space feel even more airy and lovely. The apartment was perfectly set-up for a road trip like we were on and I think would also work for a longer stay; we appreciated having a laundry room with ample storage and a garage that was able to fit a standard SUV with mirrors folded in. There was air conditioning so even though it was nearly ~100 outside the apartment was comfortable and climate-controlled. Not to mention Kimber left great refreshments and snacks for us to enjoy and was flexible and accommodating with our check-in process. We can't wait to return!
Very nice clean place. sometimes staying in someone’s place can feel awkward but you have the basement to yourself which is nice! thank you sam & ursula!

Près de l’aéroport et non loin de Denver. Très calme. L’appartement est dans la maison, comme décrit dans l’explication. Il faut donc passer par la maison pour y entrer ce qui fait un peu bizarre au début, sans que ce soit un problème.

We had a great stay. The house itself maintains "old home" charm like beautiful wood finishes but is also updated with a chef's kitchen and air conditioning that kept us comfortable despite record Denver heat. We stayed with our two young children for 4 nights and it was perfect for us. The location made it possible to walk to great dinner options and a grocery store for when we felt like cooking. Unlike other Denver neighborhoods, street parking was not a problem, and we were able to park right in front of the house every day. Linda was very proactive and responsive, even giving us the green light to check in early without even asking. This was especially nice on a day that was 97 degrees! For those who care about connectivity, the WiFi signal was strong and internet speed was fast. The TV in the main common area (i.e. family room) has an Apple TV, and a Sonos soundbar. TL;DR would happily stay here again!
很可惜因为火车取消的原因没有入住Birdy 可爱又温馨的房子。但我们在入住前的沟通非常顺畅，她幽默风趣又友好。即便因为火车取消不可抗力的原因导致无法正常入住，Birdy 非常慷慨地退了全款给我们。她的慷慨让我约发觉得没有入住很可惜！希望未来有机会再来丹佛，遇到Birdy 和她可爱的狗狗。祝福她和家人一切顺心幸福！
Great place to stay!
Great place, centrally located, comfortable furnishings
Great location, nice and helpful neighbors, quiet. I enjoyed the natural light in the unit cominfrom the skylights.
Enjoyed our stay
Ideal! Great house, very cool spot. Kim was really responsive and helpful.
Shae's place had everything we needed and her quick response time made it incredibly easy to stay here. We enjoyed a great stay here.
We had a great time at Erin’s and Allie’s place. Exactly as listed and within walking distance of many restaurants shops and art galleries. Would recommend

I contacted the host the day before saying I was landing early morning and inquired about early check in, nothing until next day two hours before actual check in time. It was an impersonal, automated response, saying earlier check in, before 4pm, maybe was possible and for an additional fee. First, 4 pm check in when you are traveling is too late, some flexibility could easily be granted. Second, the host manages over a dozen properties, mostly hotel rooms, so you are just a number, hence the impersonal automated messages. As for the room, it faces a courtyard, and a loud rambling noise shoots up from the bottom floor, where the hvac for the entire building is located. I do not recommend staying here and it’s overpriced for what it is.
It was an excellent stay thanks again

Gabriela’s place was exactly as described. It was the perfect size for 1-2 people, with a bedroom, nice sized bathroom and great living area. The bed/linens were so soft and between that and the black out blinds I slept so well! Neighborhood was quiet, and entire stay was pleasant. Would recommend!
Great location close to everything. Very walkable. Gym was really nice as well.
מטבח חדש עם תנור מקרר חדשים, היה משש כיף. הכל היה נהדר הייתי חוזר.

Simon's place is a great location close to the Auraria campus and all the downtown activities. The home has a great sense of style with lots of fun art and esthetically designed spaces with tons of character. Simon was super helpful with suggestions on things to do and restaurants to try. Great host all around. Thanks Simon!
We had a great visit in a lovely home with lots of room to be together or spread out. Would stay there again
Beautiful house, comfortable and clean. the area was peaceful and quiet!!

Beautiful, clean space. Close to downtown Denver and sunnyside, football stadium within walking distance. We did have some issues with a smoke detector beeping during the first night and day of our stay but Julie was responsive and did her best to try to fix it. It ended up stopping on its own. Would recommend.
Nina provided a clean, comfortable suite in a beautiful part of Denver. Her place was stocked with essentials and felt very safe as a solo female traveler.
Really enjoyed! Beautiful, cozy place.

Pamela was so helpful with any question we had. The home is well stocked with everything you need. Location was great; easy walk to the light rail station. Would highly recommend booking this home to explore Denver and the surrounding areas.
Very dog friendly! Sarah was a great host. Place was very clean. Loved the huge bath. In this place you’ll eat out. No stove, so restaurants are a must and handy. Love Sloan lake! Price was great!
Alfonso's place was great! It was in a lovely area, close to grocery stores. Also, the place is lovely. We had our own private entrance and an outside area to relax in.

My daughter and I attended a conference at the convention center and we were able to walk which was very convenient. There is a grocery store not far from the Airbnb which was nice and a Trader Joe’s. We loved the homey, comfortable apartment. We would definitely stay again.
Great location for an extended internship stay. Walking distance to light rail for an affordable city commute, sloan’s lake was great for evening walks, and the host is amazing!!

Our time at this Airbnb was absolutely wonderful. The home was spotless, beautifully decorated, and stocked with thoughtful touches that made us feel right at home. The bed was incredibly comfortable, the kitchen had everything we needed, and the living space was cozy for relaxing after exploring Denver. The location couldn’t have been better — close to great restaurants, coffee shops, and easy access to downtown. We loved being able to explore the city and then come back to such a peaceful, inviting space. Our host was fantastic: friendly, responsive, and truly went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed for a great stay. If you’re visiting Denver, this is the place you want to book. We’d stay here again in a heartbeat!

We had a great weekend stay here! We had difficulty getting into the Airbnb as the code that was provided did not work at first. However, after a quick phone call they were able to get us in and were very responsive. The location was great to walk to breweries and a quick drive downtown. The bedroom with 2 beds got a little hot the first night but we noticed it was because we had the door closed and there were fans located in the closet we could use. Great stay for our girls weekend and we liked having the outdoor patio to go out on in the mornings and evenings!

Rob’s place was perfect for us 7 folks. Don’t let the exterior scare you away. Although it’s an old house, Rob has revamped the house really well! Comfy beds, clean bathrooms, awesome kitchen. Rob was super responsive. Will def stay there next time when we visit Denver.
Walkable neighborhood and a comfortable space! Alfonso was a wonderful and communicative host. Would stay here again!
Jessica was a great host and her place was perfect for our stay! She was very responsive and helpful when needed.
We loved our stay at Isaias’s place. It was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. I highly recommend.
Nice place, really enjoy our stay! Bed was super comfy!
Very enjoyable

This was a great place to spend a few days with friends. Neighborhood was quiet with some shops/resturaunts within walking distance and others a short drive away. The home itself was super clean. We were impressed with the overall design of the home as well as the pure thoughtfulness of the hosts. We had everything we could have possibly needed for our weekend. We will definitely try to stay here during future trips to Denver!

I had an amazing stay and Kerry was a great host! The space was private, clean, and everything was easy to access and use. It was a great space to come back to after a long day of being out and about in Denver!
Great home to stay in for large groups!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ – The Vibe House is everything the name promises and more! We stayed here with 6 friends for a Red Rocks trip and were blown away. Every room was stylish, unique, spotless, and beautifully finished. The location was perfect — right between Red Rocks and downtown Denver — so getting anywhere was easy. They thought of everything: stocked kitchen, cozy blankets, and even a welcome gift for our dog (treats + toy 🐾). Our group was a mix of guys and girls, and everyone loved it. Tons of space to hang out, get ready, and soak up the immaculate vibes. And our host, Jackii, was the sweetest — super responsive, helpful, and made us feel right at home. We honestly didn’t want to leave! Cool, comfy, clean, and clearly cared for by thoughtful hosts. 10/10 would stay here again in a heartbeat and recommend it to anyone wanting the ultimate Denver stay.
Great location, easy access to local hotspots

We had such a wonderful stay here! The space was spacious, quiet, and peaceful, with comfortable beds that made it easy to unwind. We especially loved the loft area and the amazing balcony, perfect for relaxing. Even during the hot days, the place stayed cool and comfortable. The laundry was great and easy to use, and the kitchen had plenty of items, which made it easy for us to make coffee each morning. The décor felt eclectic and charming, and we instantly felt relaxed and right at home. We would definitely stay again.

Love our stay here! House was good size, backyard was amazing and the interior was really comfy. Keep in mind this house is not the main house and is in the backyard of an occupied house with a dog. Didn’t bother us at all tho! Would definitely stay again
Place was great. Extremely convenient to everything downtown. Sloan Lake neighborhood is nice as well
This is an amazing property and the hosts are even better. They were very friendly and always quick to respond. Couldn't recommend it more!
Had a lovely stay here! The yard was great for our dog and the area was close enough to the city where we could explore.

Was at this unit for six weeks. Definitely enjoyed my stay, you can tell that the host put a lot of love and thought into the unit with the decor and all the amenities available. It is perfect for a romantic getaway for couple or long stay professional. Close to Colfax which is both a positive and negative if you know the area but lots to do within easy walking distance including coffee shops, bars, restaurants, and even several grocery stores. There is a dedicated parking spot, which is a must have in the area, that does require a bit of maneuverability to get in/out of. Otherwise, great rental, location and host.

highly recommend! adorable place to stay for a long weekend. we went on a girls trip and enjoyed the house so much. it was very cozy and we loved the decor! we did not have a car and we found some absolutely delicious restaurants close by including the art coffee place for breakfast burritos and coffee and the mexican place for yummy tacos and margaritas! hot tub was great and a lot of space. Fernando was very responsive and allowed us an early check in as well as a late check out since our flight was so late! would definitely stay again :)

Jason and Lisa were awesome hosts! They even let us check in early, which was such a lifesaver. The location is perfect—super close to everything we wanted to do. The place was sparkling clean and had so many little extras you don’t usually see in an Airbnb, which made it feel really cozy and convenient. We’d definitely stay here again!

A modern and trendy hotel/apartment with many amenities. The roof top lunge was perfect with beautiful views. It was nice walking around the neighborhood and enjoyed all the extra equipment in the sports room (bikes, helmets, games). Such a unique room with comfortable bed and tons of natural light.

Stunning condo! Modern and clean with luxury touches throughout. Bed was very comfortable and there was no noise. Walkable to great food and coffee as well as the canal trail. We spent a couple evenings hanging out on the rooftop with great views of Denver. We would definitely stay again.
Nice place indeed! All laid out perfectly........easy entry, great views, excellent lighting, etc.........Nice and close to food and local haunts!!
Great stay- thank you

Diandra and George were excellent hosts! I was traveling alone for a conference and felt so safe and at home at their place. I primarily used the bus to get around and it was so walkable to so many bus lines and in a beautiful neighborhood. Extra shout out to them both for letting me check-in early to accommodate my schedule, and all of the extra touches around the place - from the rose wine to the sound machine and local recommendations, and the amazing comfortable bed!
It is a comfortable, newly renovated place that is close to everything we want to be. Thanks for sharing it with us.

Responsive and friendly host, with clear instructions that made check-in easy. The property was exactly as described—clean, comfortable beds and pillows, looked just like the photos, and had all the listed amenities and services. Located right in RiNo, it was very walkable to everything in the neighborhood. We were in town for an annual fundraiser at Improper City and found this to be a perfect spot. We’ve stayed at a Sonder in the past, but will most likely be booking here again next year.
The place was perfect for us and our stay in the Denver area. Hannah had great food and hiking recommendations!

The outdoor courtyard area was nice and somewhat private, the neighborhood was quiet and peaceful ; overall the stay was delightful. This was booked as a birthday staycation for my daughter who desperately needed rest and she was very pleased.

Johnna's apartment was wonderful - it's near beautiful parks and good restaurants and is a well-located spot to get around the city from. The space was very clean and comfortable, and is in a great old historic building.
We had a great stay! The perfect spot for a Denver getaway. The home is in a quiet area but walking distance to a wonderful downtown with a ton to do!

We were very happy with our stay! It was plenty of space for 4 people - Be prepared for lots of stairs, but the home had useful amenities including a fully stocked kitchen, a washer/dryer, and a nice relaxing rooftop to hang out on. The beds were very comfortable. One of our favorite parts was that the home was next to the light rail - which was quiet by the way. Having the train so close was convenient to getting downtown. We only took advantage of it a couple times but we all commented on how we wish we would have used it more. We had a small SUV which fit perfectly in the garage. Any vehicle larger than that may be tricky to park. The home is located close enough to a small area to walk around in and go to a couple restaurants, breweries, or a park - and there are plenty of electric scooters in the area. We would definitely love to stay here again in the future.

We didn’t feel safe. -Couldn’t lock the shared door from our side. -Bathroom window curtain was drawn and the window itself was cranked upon arrival. -Requested to decline cleaning services- we didn’t want our host coming into our space. Her response was, “Sorry, but daily trash pickup, etc, is what we do. We are not snooping, for heaven's sake; but this is our home, and we do that.” Despite the cleanliness and charm of the location itself, we didn’t feel safe, and Melanie was inconsiderate of our concerns.
Great house in a great location. Worked great for my family. Would stay again.
Great stay for the weekend. The place was as described, clean, quiet and in a great location. No problems finding parking. I would stay again if I'm in the area.

We didn't meet our hosts, but Alleene was extremely responsive from the time of booking, pre arrival, and throughout our stay. She provided very clear instructions that made our stay simple and comfortable. Living room was a perfect spot to curl up with a book or watch tv. Fantastic location, clean house, very inviting. Thanks for offering soft drinks, condiments, and a comfy bed!

I really wanted to love this place, but it left me disappointed. It’s a cute house and street parking was easy, but the view is blocked by a tall community building. The biggest issue was the air conditioning. I had asked for it to be set to 68 since it was 100 degrees, but we arrived to 77. The thermostat was confusing, and though we finally got it cooler, it was frustrating. They also advertised portable fans but none were provided. Bedrooms were mixed—one had blackout blinds and a more comfortable bed, though it was squeaky. The pillows were the worst part: stained cases and yellow, dirty-looking pillows that seemed unwashed. While the house looked generally clean, there were dead bugs by the windows, dried splatters on the wall, cobwebs inside, and dusty vents. Overall, the property has potential but needs serious attention to cleanliness and comfort. For the price, it wasn’t worth it.
Great place!

This location was very convenient for us to visit our son's family. Very clean and easy to travel to and from. Instructions on staying were clear and well thought out. We found it quiet and restful for our purposes, and would stay again. Thanks Susan
Andy was a great host! He replied to my messages quickly and his place had every amenity I could need. I would definitely book this home again if I were ever back in Denver.
Great stay!

Very well laid out unit, spacious, high quality finish, and dedicated off street parking. We will definitely stay here again. Right across the street from Sloan's Lake, which is very convenient. There was a drumming event going on one day we were there, which was noisy, but ended in the early evening.

Lionel's place was just as described. The bedroom was spacious and clean. We had minimum interaction, but when we did speak he was very nice. Lionel was accommodating and helped us out with the check-in. The one shared bathroom was always clean, but it was somewhat inconvenient having to go downstairs to get to it, and obviously, having to share it. This is not the host's fault, this was explained on the listing. This was a first for us and it took some adjustment on our end. The location was perfect, close to bars and restaurants, all within walking distance. Extremely safe and very nice neighborhood. Overall, we had a great stay and Lionel was a great host. The bathroom thing is just a personal preference, that's all, it's nothing against the host or the property.
The Apartment was very cozy and well decorated. once of the best Airbnb private entry studios I've stayed in. The street traffic was a little busy but the place was a great little gem.
Matthias’ home was very accomodating. Awesome location in a nice neighborhood and the house was very clean. Would definitely stay here again!
I’m a regular at Mikes, my kids live down the street. But he’s also close to Tennyson which is a happening area. We love it there Thanks Mike
Great place in a convenient location. Host was super friendly and responsive. The full kitchen and backyard areas a great.
Great host! Check it out!
This was my second stay with Anya. Great spot in a great location. Any time I’m in town and it’s available, I’ll book.
Lovely place to stay while in Denver with great access to food and shopping!

Great stay! Very convenient to the different neighborhoods in Denver. Located right beside the Broncos stadium. Everything was clean and tidy. The host had everything you would need then some. The rooftop and hot tub were a wonderful addition.
Enjoyed our stay! Wonderful location, very clean and well appointed. Hosts were extremely helpful. Would stay again next time in Denver
We were comfortable as a family of 5 and enjoyed the cozy, architectural features of the home. Very welcoming, well stocked, and great communication.
Marlene's space and communication are superb 🤙
Great affordable stay. Conveniently located in a fun neighborhood.
Excellent bungalow. Better than described in the listing Teresa is an excellent host Loved the location. Highly recommend.

Thank you, Alex, for a wonderful stay! Given our late flight, we especially appreciated the extended checkout time. We also loved the location, modern kitchen, backyard, and patio. We highly recommend this place, and we would stay again in a heartbeat.
Alejandro was responsive and very friendly. The place was the perfect place to stay in Denver!
Great location, clean, would stay again.
Really good location. The beds were very comfortable. It was really easy to communicate with the host and we got quick responses. Enjoyed our stay very much.
Great spot to stay! Loved the artsy vibe of the place. Great hosts and very responsive when I had questions. Highly recommend. Lots of great spots to walk to.
Perfect place to stay for a little getaway! The location was in an accessible spot to get wherever you needed to in the area.
Great place
Nice space in a nice neighborhood! Clean and perfect for two couples traveling together!

We stayed in Andrew's apartment for roughly 6 weeks whilst we were visiting friends in the area. Coming from abroad, Andrew was very helpful and flexible with check in, researching our flights and schedule before hand. The apartment is perfect for long stays as somewhere peaceful to live. We were able to work, cook, eat and wash our clothes with no issue. All appliances are new and very high-spec. The place was clean and well equiped for a longer stay. The local area is also a fabulous, walkable pocket of Denver with supermarket shopping, bars and restaurants all within a short walk. We will be back!
Can’t recommend this place enough! Cute vibes, walkable eats and shopping, and friendly staff! Will definitely return if ever in the area again!
Great location. Loved walking Sloan's Lake daily.
Allison was a fantastic host. Residence had all the amenities I could want and more, and Allison went above and beyond to make sure all needs were met. Highly recommend.
Excellent space. I would return here many times.
Truly lovely home with a beautiful deck, wonderful location. The hosts are great to communicate with and home was very well stocked and CLEAN!

Alex was a great host, very responsive, friendly and helpful. The space had everything we needed and the yard was absolutely beautiful. Loved getting the opportunity to try some of the eggs from his chickens and even spotted a bunny while in the hottub. The hot tub was very clean and a perfect way to end our days. The neighborhood was very walkable, with a nice grocery store, coffee shop, and cafe all down the block. Would recommend to anyone staying in Denver.
The apartment is beautifully furnished, immaculately clean and generously stocked with amenities. Rachel is a great host - communication was clear, prompt and friendly!
Great

We really enjoyed our stay at Karlye’s! The place was easy to get to, neat and today, comfortable beds, and in a quiet neighborhood. The only thing we had minimal concern of was that the bathtub didn’t drain very well, and there isn’t a vent in the bathroom so it stayed steamy for quite a long time. Very minimal issue. The hot tub was wonderful as well! Overall we would definitely come back next time we’re in Denver!
Easy place to stay while visiting friends in the city.
Loved staying at Kate’s place—super welcoming and homey! Coordinating with Kate made the trip super easy and was super accommodating. Definitely recommend staying here!
For me it is a great place to stay.

Johns home was well decorated and the perfect size for my peers and I! The rooms had plenty of room and he was always so fast to respond whenever we had a question or concern! Would stay again whenever we are in Aurora!
5 stars!!!
Alex had a lovely place, lots to do around his house. I would definitely stay there again if I need a place.
A quality accommodation in a nice, walkable neighborhood.
Great location! Private, clean, and exactly as pictured.

Cam’s place was just right. We spend only one night but felt right at home. They had everything we needed and more, like food in the fridge for making breakfast. They paid great attention to details which made a difference!
We loved our time here! It was super clean and central to so much to do in Denver. The highlight for me was being greeted by Finn the cat every time we came in!
Thomas' place is neat and cozy, we enjoyed our stay there!

This place had everything we needed. the neighborhood was quiet but it was still close to downtown. Everything was clean and it was actually bigger than we thought from the pictures. The host was really friendly and responsive.
Beautiful home and well decorated. Enjoyed all the little extra amenities around the home. Location was great with many great restaurants in the area and quick access to downtown or the highway!

We enjoyed our stay there. The apt. was redone and very nice. The kitchen was well stocked, utensils small kitchen appliances, coffee, a drawer full of spices with plenty of prep space. The bedroom and bed were nice with a walk in closet, plenty of room! The bathroom had a large shower with a built in seat.
Highly recommend. This place is located in a great neighborhood with so much to do! The place was super comfortable for my husband and I!

It was perfect!!! Nice, clean, perfect location; and everything was soft! Softest toilet paper ever! And the linens and towels and carpets! Spacious, walking distance to most interesting places. He was always responsive, helpful. We felt at home.
Roland was great! He allowed for early check in for me and allowed me an extra 20 minutes for checkout! He communicated well and the house and rooftop are amazing! Thanks for having me!
This is the perfect place for short stay or visit. Great location, very nice private room, upscale finishes, bathroom. I will definitely stay here again.

We had a great stay here! Cute location, extremely clean and comfortable, and Evan was very sweet and responsive. The pictures were spot on and we loved having so much space for such a great process. We would absolutely stay here again!

Positives: The house was clean, and the beds were comfortable. Our host, Zack, was extremely responsive and offered a small refund for the issues we encountered. Cons: While the house appeared to be well kept, there was a small leak from the bathroom ceiling. Water would drip from the light fixture after we heard the upstairs unit using the bathroom. More consequentially, the neighborhood surrounding this house did not feel safe. The Airbnb unit is surrounded by several abandoned houses, and we were accosted by a confrontational man at the park two blocks away. There were also no paper towels in the house, which led us to walk to the nearby 7-11. The manager and clerk there were very apprehensive about a man we saw while walking in. This made us pretty anxious about our safety. Later, Zack let us know the Owner had a policy of withholding paper towels due to plumbing issues and offered to ship them to us (which he did, to his credit).

We loved our stay at this beautiful house. It’s in a great location - walkable to restaurants. The beds were very comfortable! The space was great - we had plenty of room for 6 people. I would definitely recommend. We plan to visit again. Thanks

Everything was perfect. Communication was top notch and Zach was super friendly from the start. He also accommodated our early check-in request as we switched from a hotel to his loft which meant we weren't lugging around suitcases for 4 hours. The place was spotless when we arrived and Zach insisted upon no extra cleaning duties (he really honors his renters' "vacation mode"). The loft is advertised as being in a noisy neighborhood, but we found a fan for white noise and slept great. The bed is comfy and the linens were great quality. There were plenty of towels, wash cloths, and shower essentials. The shower was super clean and had good water pressure. The couch was so comfy I wanted to buy one for my own place. The private parking in back was super handy as it is just steps away from the back entrance. On our last day, Zach was able to offer a late checkout, but we had an early flight and couldn't take advantage of it. I highly recommend this place and would stay again.
Beautiful, unique place. Great host.

Fantastic space! Easy to walk to many restaurants and bars and as a solo female traveler I felt very safe walking around alone at night. Beautiful apartment wirh a gorgeous patio and the most comfy bed. The kitchen is well stocked with appliances and cooking pans. The hidden gem of Hearth just out the back gate is amazing, absolutely perfect pastries (croissants and so much more!) and coffee.
Glad to have found this gem so close to Cheeseman and the botanic gardens. Cute little space perfect for what I needed

Our stay at David's was great. The space was clean, quiet and well equipped. We had no trouble finding parking on the street. The location was excellent for us - our daughter's place was a short walk away. Cheesman Park and the Denver Botanic Garden were highlights for us. The neighborhood is lovely. We had a minor issue with the TV, but David responded promptly and resolved the issue. We would definitely stay here again.
Mark’s condo was the perfect place for my girlfriend and I to stay over the summer! It was clean, modern and in a great location. Mark was always friendly, quick to respond and helpful! 5 stars!

We loved our stay. The location was excellent, right by union station with an easy walk to great restaurants and activities. The apartment was even better than the pictures, absolutely beautiful. Everything from the booking, check-in through the check-out was seamless and Martin was an excellent host. We hope to visit again. Thank you

We stayed for the weekend at Christopher’s place and we loved it! The street and area were walkable, quiet, and beautiful. Tennyson street was a short walk away and had restaurants, stores, and a park. Christopher’s place was tidy and clean and had all the amenities you need for a perfect stay. Everything was labeled which was helpful as well!
Unresponsive hosts.

The location offers excellent value for the price. Both the room and bathroom were immaculate, and the front desk staff was very courteous. Initially, I was unaware that I was staying at a hostel until my arrival. LOL!! Despite a previous review mentioning noise from passing cars near the second-floor window, I found that using noise-cancelling earbuds mitigated the issue. Overall, I had a positive and enjoyable stay!!
Place was perfect for my needs, quiet, clean and in a great location. Thank you for hosting me.

This house was in a great location for us. Restaurants and grocery stores nearby as well as easy access to the highway. Nice kitchen where we’d plan our next days adventure on the big table and a nice couch to relax after a long day out. We had a hiccup during check in but Adam was quick to respond and rectify the issue. All in all a great place to stay!

Our family of four enjoyed a two night stay while in town for a concert. The upstairs was wonderful for our two college girls and while my wife and I enjoyed the whole downstairs. We felt extremely comfortable staying at Andrea and Joe’s place because it was spacious, clean, and fully equipped with all that we needed such as dishes, microwave, coffee and coffeemakers. Hosts were also accommodating in granting us a late check out time. Lastly, location is close to all downtown venues and easy access to I25.

We had a great stay at Heathers place! Stocked to make you feel at home. Would highly recommend this to anyone staying in the area! Proximity to the grocery store and gym was a huge plus for us. Thanks for a great stay!
Perfect stay. Amazing location. Katie and her family were helpful and kind.

Great basement apartment in convenient location. This is a large 2 bedroom and located close to grocery store and restaurants. The basement is updated and clean. It’s an older house so the access stairs are a little steep going into the basement but it was worth having a large space to stay in after a 6 day road trip packed into a small car.
Great place!
Clean space with everything you could need for a stay in Denver. Surrounding neighborhood was cute and felt safe!
Our second time here and it was excellent as was last time. Fantastic downtown location, clean, and comfortable.

First time using Airbnb. Great communication from the host. Place was pristine and as advertised. Felt like a safe area, especially being in Denver by myself for the first time. Would recommend this space!
Me and my husband went for a concert and it was the perfect space for him to work and me to have some relaxation with the dogs!
It was a beautiful home. Sad that we didn’t get to enjoy breakfast in the morning due to having to leave early but hopefully next time. Would definitely recommend!
Brand new place very comfortable!

Great location for being able to access mountains for day hikes, get downtown, and enjoy local restaurants and walks around the lake. Perfect private space with everything we needed for our visit to Denver along with excellent communication.

Bailey’s place is a little slice of heaven. All the amenities you could possibly want or need. She makes sure your comfort is first priority. Very convenient drive to the Red Rocks Amphitheater and downtown Denver. Treat yourself to a lovely stay here when you can.
Central to everything, host was a great communicator. Great for smaller groups.
Enjoy staying here when we visit family. Convenient, comfortable place. We will stay here again.
thank you!

We loved out stay here. We had a group of 6 and there were plenty of bedrooms and bathrooms for us. The main hang out area was great for us. We loved the little deck overlooking the city. The place is beautiful and decorated well and was a very comfortable stay. We were in Denver to go to Red Rocks and we walked from the airbnb to get the shuttle at Union Station. It was perfect.
Andrew was responsive and accommodating of our requests. The home was clean and as described. 5/5 would stay again.

El anfitrión fue amable, pero hubo varios inconvenientes, tres personas y solo una cama, un sofá incómodo y un colchón pinchado sin sitio para poner, por lo menos que fuera un sofá cama, no había mesas ni sillas, tuvimos que desayunar con las nuestras del camping, es un sótano que controla dueño casa desde arriba el aire acondicionado, pasando frío en la noche sin poder bajarlo, por eso nuestra experiencia no ha sido buena, cualquier hotel de la zona tiene precios similares, con mas servicios y estos problemas
Great place to stay. We felt right at home.
Nice place with helpful hosts. Everything was clear and the unit had everything we needed.

All in all, the stay was just ok. The building is very nice, and getting in and out of the unit was easy. The finishes are nice, but they aren't NICE nice. The photos make this look like a luxury sta,y and when I got to the unit, the first thing I noticed was the stained rugs, the marks on the walls, and just the rough edges everywhere. Also to note that the parking in this building is VERY small/tight. If you have a truck or are not great at parking you will struggle in this building as their garage under the units (which is a nice thing to have) is just very very tight.
Great home in the heart of the Highlands. Great layout to the house and very clean, organized. The walkability to restaurants and shops was perfect. Highly recommend booking this home.

This was a great place to stay in Denver! Very clean and new, it was nice that you can park in the garage, and close to things to do in Highlands neighborhood while being less pricey. Jeremy communicated clearly and was a great host.
Our stay was great! Wonderful view of the city and great location. Plenty of food and other venues in walking distance.

Keith and Chris have a phenomenal home. It’s extremely clean, beautifully decorated and it immediately makes you feel comfortable. I would and will recommend their home to anyone who is passing through Denver. Not only that but they were both very sweet and great communicators throughout my stay.
Comfy,cozy,real good kind people thank u for let me stay here..I’ll try to get more days but it’s already booked

A perfect stay for early flights- Matt was responsive, flexible, and communicative with a last-minute booking. Our commute to the airport was smooth and it was great to have a good night’s rest in a safe, comfortable place!
Great place great location easy check in responsive host private and affordable!

We had an excellent stay. The accommodation was spotless and very comfortable, with lots of small, thoughtful touches that made everything easy and enjoyable. The neighborhood was lovely, with plenty to see and do nearby, and it was very convenient to get around. Check-in and checkout were completely hassle free. Highly recommend!
Great place to stay not far from the airport and the city. Lovely neighborhood, lots of space in the apartment, comfortable bed and lots of extra amenities.

My friend and I loved our stay in the castle, a favorite Airbnb experience for both of us. We were so impressed by the space and how much there was to explore, and the breakfast offerings and ducks were such a fun bonus! We were also lucky for the opportunity to speak with Nate about the history of the castle, what a neat place and lucky find. Definitely a highlight of our trip.

Miguel's place is perfectly located on a quiet block between all the great restaurants and cultural spots on Welton and RiNo. Multiple bus lines right on the adjacent street plus a nearby light rail station make getting around super easy. The house has thoughtful touches throughout - beautiful hardwood floors and a newly renovated kitchen downstairs, plus we loved using the extra upstairs room as office space. Fast internet TVs on both levels and connected smart home features make long term stays enjoyable, eco friendly and safe. Miguel and Jim are fantastic hosts who really take care of their guests. They dropped off salt in winter and provided a BBQ and outdoor furniture set for summer chilling. Friendly neighbors too. Would definitely stay again!

The Chic Retreat is accurately named. It is a beautiful retreat in a great location! The space itself was clean, and nicely appointed. The bonus, I was not expecting, was a garage! Not leaving my car on the street gave me such peace of mind. Highly recommend this space and host.
wonderful hostel, warm welcoming and super chill! highly recommend! will be back!
Jin was so great working w us when our schedule changed last minute. Very responsive and friendly. And the space was awesome
This place was a real haven in the Cal Hill area. The apt was carefully laid out and complete. My be only complaint is that it did not come with a drip coffeemaker. Throughly enjoyable.
Great space! Good location near lots of restaurants.

Kelly’s place was perfect for our stay. Plenty of space inside to hang out and for two of us to work without being on top of each other. Kelly was easy to work with both before and during our stay. If we need a place next time we are in Denver, Kelly’s place would be the first place we look at

We stayed at Amy's place for a week while we were out here for vacation and it was in the perfect location. The room in the basement was perfect and cozy. We of course loved their cats! We already have our next trip our to Denver booked with Amy! Can't wait to come back!
Had a great stay at Morgan’s place, highly recommend.
Place was just as described. Host was very responsive. Would stay here again.

Caren’s apartment is a great jumping off point for your stay in Denver. You don’t need a car and can walk just about anywhere. The convenient location above Whole Foods makes grabbing food to cook or items you may have forgotten a breeze. The apartment itself is adorable, styled for the traveler. Being a corner unit makes it feel spacious. The kitchen has all of the basics to cook at home. I would definitely recommend this apartment for your next stay in Denver!
Thank you

Zach's place is cute and very convenient location wise. The only bathroom is upstairs with the main bedroom. It was within walking distance of our daughter's place so it worked well for us. It was a little more worn than we were expecting but we were so busy helping our daughter we really only used it for sleeping.
Great place! I didn’t have a car but was able to use the metro to get to downtown pretty easily. Loved the balcony!
Stephanie’s place is the perfect stay in Denver - central location, quiet and safe, comfy bed, and space all to yourself. Will be staying here again!
Great stay, recommend
This was the perfect place to stay during my summer internship. It was easy to walk over to the lake and go to both Downtown or towards the mountains.

Aaron's place in Denver was exactly as advertised with two bedrooms, a putting green and super comfy couch that pretty easily accommodated two adults and two kiddos. Great location with plenty of street parking. Aaron was super responsive and quick to answer questions and provide helpful recommendations. Definitely recommend and would stay with Aaron again in Denver.
Jack’s place is even better in person. We stayed one night and it was the perfect size for 4 people. Very clean and tidy space, and large back patio to hang out.
We had a wonderful stay! The home was clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Zack was very communicative and made everything easy. We’d happily return.
Awesome location, super fun and very clean place. Will definitely stay here again. Easy to get around Denver and lots of great restaurants walking distance.
The place fits the bill for close to downtown/denver attractions. The beds were super comfy.

We had a wonderful stay. The accommodations were perfect and very clean. The kitchen was laid out well and Paul showed us the trick on how to make coffee! Loved the spacious outside deck - perfect for enjoying breakfast in the morning or a glass of wine in the evening. Paul was very welcoming and always friendly when we saw him as we were coming and going. The whole loft was very well stocked from linens to kitchen supplies to cleaning items to necessities that needed to be restocked. Very clear and easy directions on things to be done before we left. Convenience for us was exceptional. We will be back!
This was a great spot! Near parks and restaurants, shopping. Very close to downtown but quiet. Michelle is a great host. I would recommend this place.
Addishiwot is very friendly and responsive! The room was cozy and perfect for a weekend get away. Thank you!
We were a five minute walk to our conference and really enjoyed our stay. I will say that the king bed upstairs is divine - very comfortable! Thank you!
Sarah's place is nice and cozy. We strolled to Union station one evening and Uber back (around $12). We had a good time there.
We had a great time staying here. The location was great and had lots of cool spots that were walking distance. It’s surprisingly close to downtown Denver as well!

Very nice air bnb, perfect area, and very easy to do some remote work, experience new restaurants, and get to anywhere in Denver area. Very nice to have Bonny nearby to check in if we needed anything too. Parking was easy! Overall great stay!
Kara answered all of our questions very quickly and gave us local recommendations. Great host!

Stayed here for 2.5 months for a summer internship. Could not have asked for a better host / place to work out of. Austin went above and beyond to make sure that we had everything we needed. Cannot recommend staying here more.

We had a great stay at Olivia‘s lovely house. The apartment was spacious, beautifully decorated and close to the park. The area is very quiet but still not far away from the city centre. We did not have a car so we used Uber to get around. Olivia was very kind and helpful. We would definitely stay there again.
This place felt like a home away from home. Everything is high quality. Lots of food and drink places in walkable distance. Debbie put in welcome drinks and snacks and emergency toiletries

This place was very well stocked with everything you could need. The beds and couch were comfortable and it was decorated very cute! It’s only a few blocks from a lake that was great for dog walks with lots of restaurants and things to do nearby. The neighborhood was great! A few small things, but nothing that should stop a booking! The garage pictured wasn’t available for my visit which was fine for the summer as there was plenty of street parking! If that’s a need of yours be sure to clarify, the host mentioned she could have gotten it ready if it was something I needed but I decided not to. This is also a duplex and the walls are thin so there are noises shared. The neighbors were very considerate and weren’t too loud but you can hear people walking around sometimes which caused my dog to be jumpier than usual and her barks were heard by the neighbors. Emily was quick to communicate and I was able to be more on top of stopping her and think that it was better for most of my stay!

The location was great-close to downtown & Red Rocks. The home was clean & the bed was comfortable. However our experience didn’t feel like 5 stars. We were only provided 1 towel & washcloth each for a 4 night stay. When we asked for more, the initial response was that it might be several days to receive them. The host did send washcloths via Amazon delivery next day, which we appreciated, but the follow-up message still felt dismissive. Instead of simply resolving the issue, we were sent “statistics” about washcloth use, which came across as unprofessional. We also want future guests to know that parking isn’t always available out front. Several nights we had to park a block away, and we received a $50 ticket because we didn’t notice that restrictions change depending on the day. This was our mistake, but it’s worth noting. Lastly we received a message that felt like pressure to leave a 5 star review. While the property was nice, the way issues were handled left us disappointed.

Great stay at Laura's place. Loved having cocktails on the rooftop deck at the end of the day. Neighborhood was extremely walkable. We walked to Fox and Hen and The Bindery for breakfast. Laura was exremely responsive - highly recommend!

We recently spent a week at Lisa's place visiting our daughter who lives in Capital Hill. The location is great. It very much a neighborhood, but also close to the downtown LoDo area, Rockies stadium, etc. It's also a quick jump to the highway to head to the mountains for hiking and sight seeing, etc. Lisa communicated great with us. Lisa's place is as-advertised. The photos are accurate. We were impressed with the cleanliness and how fully stocked it was with supplies. We were there an entire week and never ran out of anything. It is also very secure. There is ample parking (not street parking). We also enjoyed the outdoor patio as well. Highly recommended. We would definitely stay here again.
We had a great stay! The location was easily accessible and we enjoyed having our own private garage for easy in/out. The space was comfortable and we would definitely come back!
Couldn’t have been happier with my stay. Clean, great area, and friendly host. Gabe was such an amazing host this summer!!

Very cute apartment. Walking distance to a specialty grocery store with a good bar and prepared food options and a few restaurants. Everything else we wanted to visit was a short drive away and fortunately street parking in front was easy. The apartment is indeed cozy. In hindsight too small for our family of 4, including two little kids. Single travelers or couples who pack light will fit better in the space. There is an air conditioning unit in the bedroom, which worked well during the 90+ degree days during our visit. The a/c unit struggled to cool the rest of the apartment, but a fan Stacey provided did help.

This Gem of a getaway was a Beautiful and convenient location. The home furnishings were clean, comfortable, cozy and familiar feeling. The host was accessible, flexible and informative. We'd definitely stay again. Thanks for letting us enjoy Downtown Denver from your View! 🥰

Loved our stay! The location is incredibly walkable to a ton of coffee shops, restaurants, stores, etc. The flat is STUNNING - photos don’t do it justice! We would stay here again should we return to Denver :)

This was the 4th place I stayed at in my month in denver and it did not disappoint! Beautiful, spotless, all the amenities I needed. And the bed was so comfortable! Everything was new, skip staying at someone's home with dated entertainment and appliances. This is where you want to be. This location is absolutely unbeatable! Parks and 10/10 ice cream just steps away. Be aware of the bathtub (not shower) but was manageable! really appreciated the well stocked kitchen and lots of extra linens
