Despite being so central, the loft itself was quiet and relaxing—perfect to come back to after a long day out. Loved having the full kitchen and in-unit washer/dryer as well; it made the stay incredibly convenient. The only thing I’d mention is that parking was a bit hard to allocate and to note that when they say Urban, they mean URBAN.
Great host! Absolutely loved the Steam shower after a long day on the road seeing beautiful Colorado. Loved the privacy and accessibility to the main spots in Denver.

The space was nicely and efficiently configured. The temperature is controlled remotely, so there is a constellation of space heaters one needs to use to compensate. The three dogs finally got to know us, but if you’re not a dog lover, that might be an impediment. Overall it was conveniently located to our family who lives a block away. Entry is with a key rather than keypad, which we had come to expect at other AirBnBs. Tina takes great pride in the accoutrements of her space. Overall good stay.

I travel to Denver a lot to vacation sit family. This truly feels like a home away from home. SO comfortable and inviting! The space is so well thought out, beautifully decorated and everything you need to feel at home. The location is also a stand out! Close to Cheesman park, the zoo, and downtown for so many museums! Walk to two different grocery stores and several restaurants. Parking on the street was free and easy. If you don’t feel like going out just stay in the full size well stocked kitchen is amazing. Fast WiFi, great TV, several cozy outside spaces and a full sized washer and dryer. Ian thank you so much for sharing your space! Our daughter and son in law are still talking about how much they enjoyed the stay.
Just what is needed only used to stay close to the airport
Found this place on a last minute trip that I don't regret reserving. The place had everything we needed and was a great place to stay and in a great location to explore the surrounding areas.
Great location, very close to Washington park. Kitchen was well equipped, the bed very comfortable. Hosts were great communicators. Beautiful space. I’d stay again anytime.

We stayed here towards the end of November to celebrate our anniversary, and we were amazed at the level of attention to detail the Hen House had!! Even from the outside, it looks beautiful. The interior was very clean and had everything you could need. The bed was comfortable, he had extra pillows and blankets just in case it was too cold, which were not necessary as he had central heater so we were never cold! The bathroom had plenty of towels, he even had extra feminine products and a few other extras, which came in handy! The kitchen had everything you can need to cook including utensils and even included coffee/tea pods. We accidentally dropped one of the very beautiful plates and were more than happy to pay for it, but when we reached out to Alex, he told us not to worry about it. What a great, understanding host! We never had issues with parking or checking in. It was also very close to all the main downtown attractions, but also had some great walkable shops/restaurants. 10/10
Perfect for what we needed !
Great place to stay cozy and clean
nice place a block away from whole foods and King Soopers. there is a little garden with a table and chairs, wish it was a bit warmer to enjoy it. the place was quiet.
Casa absolutamente hermosa! Esta fue probablemente la casa más cómoda y hermosa en la que nos hemos hospedado a través de AirBnB
Very nice home, we stayed with our 9 month old daughter and we have a great time.
We stayed here while in town working for a couple of weeks. Grocery Store and Convenience store within a block. The house had everything we needed and we'd definitely stay here again.
Elizabeth’s place was great. Had everything we needed. Elizabeth was responsive and helpful. She was very accommodating when we needed to extend our stay twice. I would stay here again.
Great location, perfect for short stay.

Kathy is a gracious host and the location is great, but my stay was not comfortable. The place is cramped, with subpar heating, cheap pillows, and an extremely soft mattress, which may be to some folks’ liking but was not to mine. I had to leave after one night.
Awesome room and awesome hotel

This is our second stay at Floras place! Flora knows hospitality! This is a five star stay all around! I host 25 to 30 properties across Alabama and Florida and I would choose Floras home anytime! If you need a quick and easy stay near the airport, this is it! Shannon FiveSTRReviewProperties dot com ~Optimizing and automating waterfront short term rentals~

Victor’s place was perfect for our needs! It was close to where we needed to go. Great restaurants all around. Victor was very knowledgeable about the area and when asked, provided us with a number of restaurants close by to enjoy. The area was very safe. The place came with a surprisingly comfortable roll out bed/sofa. Parking inside a secure garage was very convenient. Plenty of space to fit our Honda Pilot.
Extremely nice location, numerous restaurants in walking distance . Luxury style space that is very comfortable and safe . Amazing communication from the Host .
This was a great location for our short trip to Denver. Kristy was an excellent host!
Danielle’s house was clean and very spacious and great location for us

We enjoyed our stay at Julie's place. The neighborhood was nice, we walked to Sloan Lake and nearby restaurants. It had a kitchen and washer/dryer that made it feel like home. It gave our family the space we needed with the two bathrooms and three bedrooms. Parking on the street was easy. As already noted in the listing and reviews, its the first floor of a duplex. If you are sensitive to a little noise from up above, maybe its not the ideal place for you. It was not a problem for us and we would be happy to stay here again. I think that is all factored into the great value of the place.

Great location! Walkable to Tennyson Street’s restaurants, bars and shops as well as grocery stores. Also a short drive or Uber to downtown Denver. Evan was a great host and was quick to respond to any questions we had. We’d love to stay again the next time we visit Denver.
Lovely place with great ambient

Our family stayed here for four nights and it was a perfect house for our needs. There was plenty of room and it was verrrry comfortable. The tv areas, game area, bar, hot tub, bluetooth sound system…all lent a degree of luxury we hadn’t expected. The office was also very useful. Beds were great, bathrooms well appointed and totally clean. Overall, very nice and would rent again.

We always enjoy our visits to Tanya's place, conveniently located just a few blocks from our daughter, son-in-law and grandson's home. This year we spent Thanksgiving in Denver and took advantage of the well-stocked kitchen amenities to make turkey dinner. It made for a great celebration with our kids!
Amazing house. Super comfortable and well stocked. Great location too! Best stay ever!
Amber was super nice and even was responsive after the booking was over, helping us locate items we left behind 🙈

The apartment had everything we needed, and very convenient that it has a Whole Foods attached to the building. The place is small, but perfect for two people. The bed was super comfortable and overall the place was clean and well taken care of. When in the city, I would stay here again.
The home was perfect for visiting our children. The house was beautiful and spotless, it had everything we needed. The tub was wonderful & beds very comfortable
Clean and cozy place with responsive host! Would recommend.
Everything was absolutely perfect!! Should have stayed longer..

We enjoyed our 6 day stay at Taylor’s Airbnb. Very convenient location, exceptionally clean with excellent amenities, including a comfortable king sized bed, large screen TV, hot tub and washer and dryer. Taylor is an excellent host!

We really enjoyed staying in this clean, cozy family home over Thanksgiving! It was more than enough space for our family of four. Very walkable to a coffee shop, playground and pizza place. Blake was an excellent host! We really appreciate you sharing your home with us!
Incredible loft in an incredible location. Everything is walking distance, the area is wonderful and the loft is spacious, well decorated and very homey. Will be staying here again.

I had a great experience at this Airbnb. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Check-in was super easy, and the host was quick to respond to any questions. The space felt cozy and well-taken care of, and the location was perfect—close to everything but still quiet and relaxing. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a smooth and stress-free stay! My family and I stayed here for three months while we found our next house (we did!) I also brought home our second daughter to this house.
Everything was as promised. Very neat, everything you need is there.

A perfect place that’s right next to everything you’re looking to experience in Denver. Chayla was courteous and very welcoming. Would love to stay here again and would definitely recommend it to all my friends and family.

Our family of five (with three kiddos) had a great stay while visiting family in Denver for Thanksgiving. The location is central to the museums/zoo/botanical garden, as well as downtown. The house is clean, warm, and has lots of space. Having a garage to park in was very helpful. My only complaint is that my husband and I spent too many hours playing the old school arcade game in the dining room, but that's on us - not on our hosts. :)

This was our second stay here and it did not disappoint. Heather is a phenomenal host, her place is everything you need, wonderful condition and in a great location. We had a mid size SUV and had no problems with the off street parking. Laundry is a super bonus, great size. We will definitely be back again soon!

The location could not have been better for us. So close to our favorite gourmet store, Marczyk, and close to family. We will definitely be back. The host, Thomas, let us know we could extend our stay at either end, which was kind.

I stayed with Kim for just over a month, and it was exactly what I needed. Kim and Ashe are super friendly and make you feel right at home. Jasper (their dog) has lots of energy, but he is a good pup. The location was great with lots of things to do being so clise to downtown and the historic 5 points area. I am gratefu for such a wonderful stay. Thank you Kim for all the late night chats and for helping me though this transitional period!
Great stay ! Great home ! Perfect for when you want to just relax and enjoy family.

This is an amazing place for those valuing privacy and a great space to their own, but with all the conveniences of being in the heart of vibrant Denver. Lessley is a fantastic host and was proactive, responsive, and incredibly friendly. The space had everything needed for being comfortable while there. We especially loved the full bath and kitchen, as well as the ample yet cozy space for the family to enjoy their time. This will definitely be our first spot to look at in the future when visiting family in Denver!

Great location! Lots of restaurants close by. We rented a car and did the German Christmas Festival one night and caught a basketball game the next. Parking was never an issue. We could always find something close. The building felt very safe. The apartment had everything we needed. Our family of five was very comfortable. The apartment is very spacious! Huge kitchen! We really appreciated the coffee and creams & sugars they provided so we could have coffee our first morning as we had a very late arrival the night before. The host is very responsive and helpful! I highly recommend the Tasty Pot restaurant which is right downstairs if you like Asian food. Delicious! We would stay here again.
We loved the house and Washington Park across the street. Host was so accommodating.
Your place was perfect for our weekend visit to Denver. We felt right at home in your peaceful house. Thank you for sharing this beautiful treasure with us.

Stayed here over Thanksgiving. The unit is spacious, with a nice fireplace (we used it once on the roof), in-unit washer/dryer (dryer was great, washer had a slight musty smell. Common if doors stay closed), plenty of towels/linens, and the rooftop deck with mountain views is a highlight. That said, it felt very corporate and impersonal. • All communication was automated. Sent two direct messages via the app, got zero human replies. • Check-in instructions are vague. Address leads to a massive condo complex with multiple buildings. Had to scroll deep in the details to find our building/unit number. Screenshot it ahead, folks. • Location is hit-or-miss: Backs onto an industrial zone, so some paths are unlit/sketchy for walking. One of the streets leads straight to shops, restaurants, and groceries. There is a coffee shop nearby as well • Rooftop furniture/cushions were uncovered and seemed untouched from prior guests. • tvs were outdated and only some of the remotes worked.

This place is absolutely beautiful and comfortable! Love all the small amenities in the kitchen and bathrooms. Also, the hosts were so responsive before and during our stay. We will definitely book this place again when we visit Denver.
Comfortable, clean, and conveniently located. Great neighborhood to walk!
it was an amazing place to stay!

This is a great upstairs apartment. It’s only a few blocks from Tennyson, 38th, and lake Berkeley. For us it was perfectly located! The check in was super easy. We arrived after dark and that can be treacherous! But the apartment was well marked, lit up, with parking right outside the door. The apartment had a very well equipped kitchen for all our needs. But all we needed was the French press, the espresso maker, microwave and refrigerator. I had to contact Host Finn over parking and we got an immediate response (the question was where I could park when the sweeper comes). We have family in the area so we return annually. I hope to book next year. Thanks!
Quiet neighborhood, comfortable home, was lovely and we enjoyed our stay! Will try to stay here next time. 🙂
James’s place was perfect in terms of size, location and comfort. He was a great host, friendly, timely and responsive. Would definitely recommend!!
great spot, even as a "basement" unit, large windows and nice natural light

Tara's space is nice and well equipped. The house is cozy and the beds are comfortable. The location worked well for us while visiting family in Littleton - it's also close to Denver and many activities.

what a brilliant place to stay! we have stayed in various areas of Denver over the years, but Kyle's was one of our favorites! we were able to walk to various shops, restaurants, and coffee shops and we were walking distance from some of our favorites like the Milk Market and the Spicy Librarian. the house was very clean, the kitchen was gorgeous, and the private yard was a lovely addition! we will definitely be keeping this one on the list for future stays!

Wonderful rental. Great for 2 professionals working, we each had our privacy and work space. The neighborhood was wonderful with lots to do working walking distance. I would absolutely stay here again
Great location, residential, felt safe, walking distance to lake and walking trail. Close to restaurants. Host extremely responsive and accommodating. Definitely recommend and would return.
just as described, was perfect for a four day stay. I felt right at home :)
Nice place, super responsive host. One point worth noting -- of the three bedrooms one is on the main level with the kitchen/living room and lacks a door.

We really enjoyed our stay. Alex was a great host and the home accommodated us well. It was our home away from home. We had everything we needed. We would definitely stay again when we are back in Colorado.

Comfortable, private and easy to find. We enjoyed staying and it was within walking distance of a cute coffee shop and diner. We visited a relative so never went anywhere else nearby. The host was always very responsive and kind. I would recommend.
great communication throughout stay. Very clean and comfortable

The Berkeley Hotel is a lovely stay, on an exciting walkable street. Along Tennyson you will find great coffee, breakfast, bakery goods, natural food stores, great used clothing stores, pubs, super lunch and dinner places, it’s a delight to walk- about, grab an electric scooter, or drive : all enjoyable to do!
Enjoyed my stay! It’s very peaceful and beautifully organized. Mandy was very fast with responding. Great host. Would most definitely recommend.
We would highly recommend Nancy’s home. It was comfortable and had the best stocked kitchen! I was able to cook a Thanksgiving meal for my family with no problem!

We loved our stay at Gary's BnB. It was a large, immaculate apartment. Even though it was a basement apartment, you couldn't tell at all—it was bright, inviting, and open. Furthermore, Gary was extremely responsive, and made us feel right at home. Highly recommended.

My family had a lovely stay at Dorota’s house. Her home is very comfortable and clean and well-equipped. We felt right at home. The location is perfect for an easy walk into Cherry Creek. We will definitely stay there again on our next trip to Denver! Many thanks Dorota!
Great place to stay for the holiday. Close to lots to do. Walkable to fun restaurants and activities.
A comfortable and convenient place, as depicted. Would stay again.
Awesome place, in a great location.

Of the 1001 thoughtful touches (yoga mat! great kitchen! laundry!) the most charming are the hosts themselves. Besides goat petting and fresh treats, Susan offers carriage rides events--you won't want to miss!
Great location, roof top restaurant and mini bar available in the room! Loved my stay there.

Highly recommend! The location was quiet, close to Jefferson Park for dog walks, and walkable to Safeway for groceries or to the coffee shop. The home was very clean, comfortable and had separate sleeping spaces. The hot tub was a huge perk. Everything you need for a memorable Denver vacation!

Fantastic, communicative, helpful and flexible hosts. Helped us out w/ special requests. Pros: * House is SO cool if you like vintage style. Nooks/crannies/built-ins/etc. More spacious than it looks. * Well stocked kitchen that allowed us to cook Thanksgiving without a hiccup. * You're near a highway but the house is so solid you don't hear any traffic noise. * Large laundry room makes it easy to clean as you go. * SUPER friendly hosts that helped us with quirky needs without question. They went way over/above. * Off street parking * Space heaters / fans for white noise / micro climate heat (daughters!) Cons (almost none): * There's not an egg pan (nonstick), so kitchen clean up can be laborious if you want omelets. * The neighborhood is a little run-down / edgy but not an issue if you're ready for it. * My daughters (lightweight) said the beds were very comfortable. My wife and I (not lightweight) thought ours was too firm. A feather topper would have helped us.
Mike was super helpful & accommodating!

I travel back and forth to Denver often and have older children as well as grandchildren. We always look for somewhere that is large enough to fit the family, but also has good couches & bedrooms (a must check for when searching for Airbnb’s as many have hard, uncomfortable and cheap couches). We also look for places the entire family can sit and relax, talk or play board games. This house has it all. Additionally, communication is key from hosts. From booking through the last day stay, the host checked to ensure I knew exactly where to go and instructions about the house. I had to communicate asking a question late in the day and he responded immediately to let me know. Our Thanksgiving was awesome as a family and the house was perfect for us. We spent alot of time in the basement on the side without the TV’s and with the TV’s. Also it is very easy to get comfortable as every area in the house has its own temperature control system. This house was a huge win!
The hoe was comfortable and clean and well equipped. It was within walking distance to my family so it was perfect. We had 2 adults and 2 young children there. Great location!

I can’t say enough about how responsive Aileen was, even checking in during our stay to make sure we were comfortable. She has added a lot of nice touches like snacks, toiletries, coffee, snacks. She went out of her way to make that we knew about the flights of stairs which were as described. Everything was squeaky clean and comfortable. Beautiful views of the mountains and surrounding neighborhood.

Our stay was amazing! The house was clean, spacious, and exactly like the photos. Check-in was smooth, communication was quick, and every small detail was taken care of. We would definitely stay here again. Host was very responsive and helpful.
Great stay!
A very comfortable room with nice bathroom, private entrance, easy walk to nearby restaurants, and most importantly, easy walk to daughters place. Highly recommended

Nhung's place was perfect for our extended family's trip to Denver. Plenty of space to spread out and well appointed with everything we needed. Normally we end up spending extra money for little things we didn't pack, but this house was FULLY stocked with all the extra toiletries, paper products, dishes, cookware, spices, coffee, you name it! The host was super responsive and extremely flexible with our travel plans. The house is beautiful and in a quite neighborhood, a quick drive to downtown Denver and there's a walkable shopping center with a movie theatre about 5 minutes away. All in all it is a wonderful property and we wouldn't hesitate to rent it again when we come back to town!
Great stay! Good price and location

Very nice home. Convenient location in the upper Highlands area of Denver, near numerous interesting restaurants, bars, coffeehouses and services. Well-appointed home stocked with a large variety of necessities, espcially in the kitchen. Sarah was very attentive to our needs and responded very quickly to the few inquires we had. The fee charged for our stay was pretty much market rate-we were ok paying the fee because the home provided good value. Would definietly rent again on our future trips to Denver!

The Norway house was perfect for us - 3 adults and 2 small well-behaved dogs. The fenced-in backyard was great for the dogs and we enjoyed walking them in the large park across the street. In spite of the dense housing, it was very quiet neighborhood at night. Billy was friendly and responsive to our questions. The house was clean, warm in the winter and the kitchen well supplied. TV is awesome! Highly recommend this house/area of Denver. I would stay there again!
Just a gem in a cool walkable neighborhood. Two supermarkets close by. Really just ideal for our thanksgiving trip!

The Brown Palace is a gorgeous and unique building. It’s a great place to stay for a few nights. They offer a lot of events and have restaurants on the first floor. When we arrived, they were hosting the Sugar Plum Ball and there were a lot of children running around. Tea time is also a highly active time in the lobby. The elevators are old and small, so expect to wait a while, especially during check-in and check-out. My only real complaint was that we didn’t have any “plush robes” in our room, as advertised, and when we tried to get ahold of someone, the phones didn’t work. On the last night of our stay, we went to the desk and they were able to find one robe for us. It’s also a Marriot family hotel, so if you’re not a member, you need to pay for WiFi? Might be smart to book through their website…

The house is in a nice location with lots to walk to. Sloane’s lake is a really pretty walkable area and there was a playground only one block away that was great to have so close. we also walked to a coffee shop every morning and although we did not go to any of the restaurants there were several within walking distance. The house had plenty of space for our group of 15 and plenty of beds. Some of the rooms had multiple beds which was good and bad. The third floor has a bed in the kitchen and a loft bed which we were surprised by as neither have any privacy. Two rooms had two king beds and most of the rooms did not have adjoining bathrooms. However there was plenty of space as the house is large. There was a living space and kitchen on each floor with huge tvs. We celebrated Thanksgiving there and it was great to have 3 kitchens. Jose was helpful in giving us an early check in and accommodating some special needs. Overall it was a great place for our large group and centrally located
Location was great for our needs. Nice space and well appointed. Would stay again.
Great host! Made last minute reservation due to long layover in DEN. She was waiting up for us, and made us feel comfortable and right at home!
Great spot to hold up while visiting Denver. Bathroom sink and shower can get too hot, but otherwise no complaints. Thanks Mish!
My fiance and I stayed here for my birthday. We loved everything about it!
Immediately felt at home!
Great location, spectacular finishes, all we could ask for on our family vacation

Ashley’s place was a great place to cook a Thanksgiving feast. The kitchen is well equipped and the dining room was a spacious place to eat and play games. We appreciated the binder with helpful information and local recommendations. The place is very comfortable and the location is lovely for walking. Despite being on a busy street, it’s very quiet inside. Ashley is a friendly, fast and accommodating host. The directions for parking in the driveway seem weird and daunting, but they are actually quite clear; just follow them step by step! Also street parking most nights was easy. Highly recommend.

Zach's place was awesome! just as described, in a good location, and easy to get to and from. The beds and linens were amazing, super comfortable. Zach was also very responsive and got back to us very quickly when we had questions. 5 out of 5 stars for sure.

I genuinely couldn’t have asked for a better stay or a better host! I spent about four months here and loved every moment. The home is spotless, perfectly located, and equipped with everything you could possibly need. Courtney went above and beyond—always responsive, thoughtful, and kind. I’d stay here again in a heartbeat!
What a lovely place with a great view of the city! Also, the backyard is fantastic for dogs. We really enjoyed our time at this house.
Great location next to RiNo district. Everything was as described. Super easy check-in and checkout. Had everything we needed. Nicolas was great and very responsive.
This is our second stay at this comfortable and spacious apartment. Great location and Mai is so helpful!
One of my favorite Airbnb's I have ever stayed at. The house was so well equipped, clean and comfortable. The host was communicative and helpful. Nothing but good things to say! It was 10/10.
Great location and host. House is nice as well but for the price there were a few misses.
Great place to stay! Hannah was super responsive & the place was quiet, clean & in a safe neighborhood. Highly recommend

Your home is so beautiful! I was born and raised in Colorado and your home made me feel so warm and homey. I felt right at home. Thanks for having us! Please enjoy the goodies! Looking forward to booking with you in the future! ❤️
Great place to stay. Clean and modern.

The beds were very comfy, probably the best yet and the kitchen was well stocked. Place very clean and clear that a lot of effort went into rehabbing the townhouse. Felt like new on the inside. Sebastian always was quick to respond with any questions. Mixed neighborhood with old and new housing. It was very quiet just despite being just a few blocks off Colfax. Close to both Lowry and Stapleton.

The space was perfect for cooking sides for a Friendsgiving. Quiet and private and really beautifully decorated. Carol was extremely helpful and responsive. Directions to the entrance were clear. We had an awesome stay!
Great place!

It was a beautiful home with a beautiful view. Great space and comfortable. The host was always responsive and polite. My kids and husband enjoyed staying here and that couldn’t make me happier. I definitely recommend this condo.
Enjoyed my time at Eric’s place. The area is super convenient for most tho ha to do in Denver and his place was clean, easy to navigate and his communication was clear.

Had a great visit for thanksgiving week with our family. We enjoyed the location being close to City Park and walkable to local restaurants. Brianna was very responsive to our questions and felt very comfortable. Thank you.
Loved this place! Everything was perfect, and had such a beautiful view of the mountains. Walkable to someone places too.
A little hard to park, but it’s a great house, you can find everything you need
A nice set up for a getaway and good location!
This is a magnificent place with warm and welcoming hosts. I love the location and walkability. I am a happy return client. I’ll be back in a couple weeks. Thank you.

Our stay at this Airbnb was excellent from start to finish! The space itself was pristine, modern, and thoughtfully equipped with everything a traveler might need. The kitchen was fully stocked with helpful supplies, and having access to a washer/dryer, iron, and folding table made the stay even more convenient. Check-in was seamless thanks to the electronic door lock, and the dedicated parking spot was a huge plus. The neighborhood is beautiful, quiet, and perfectly located - just a short distance from the center of Denver. Wes was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout my stay, making sure everything went smoothly. Overall, I had a wonderful experience and would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Denver.
Great comfy home! Very flexible and responds fast!
Great place in a central location. Host was very communicative and went the extra mile to ensure that we had everything we needed.
We came in for Thanksgiving to visit our son. The home was very clean, cozy and comfortable. Perfect for our stay. Loved the rooftop fire pit!

The property met our needs. It was a bit smaller than the photos indicated. Especially in the living spaces on the main level. The barn doors to the main bedroom did leak noise and light, but that was mentioned in the listing. No closet space in the main bedroom was unfortunate. The kitchen was well stocked and the playroom downstairs was a great addition! The host was extremely responsive to any questions or concerns.
Laura was a great host! The place was amazing so much stuff to do within walking distance!

Overall, an awesome place. Host quick to respond. Great location, close to a park, downtown Denver. If you're a light sleeper, take some ear plugs, the furnace makes such a loud sound. High rise, steps to come up and down to your room and kitchen area. Enjoyed being able to cook our own meals! Thank you!
Perfect place for our Thanksgiving weekend. Conveniently located. Well stocked kitchen. Well maintained property, cozy and comfortable. Prompt and clear communication with host.

Jack was great to work with. He responds quickly to any questions or concerns we had. His place was exactly what we needed for a quick stay over Thanksgiving weekend. It was clean. Beds were comfy. Would stay there again.

Overall our experience was great. Great location, amenities as described. The only issue was no heat downstairs. The fireplace does work to warm it up in the room it’s in but there is not central heat.

The place is very nice, cozy and feels like home. It has a spacious living room which is perfect for our movie marathon after dinner or board games. Kitchen is pretty nice too. Everything is working well and is able to accommodate us all at the same time for breakfast and dinner. Rooms wise, beds are all very comfortable and clean. Steven provided more blankets if in case needed since we stayed during the Thanksgiving week. All sheets smells good and fresh which made us sleep well and rest enough. Bathroom is well cleaned and prepared, too. We've asked too many questions and Steven answered them all and also gave recommendations. The heater is also working very well and kept us all warm during our stay. The house is also close to grocery stores if you need anything. All in all, it was a great stay. This made our group's first trip together more memorable and fun. This place is highly recommended.

Great place and location! There are multiple towers at the complex which can be slightly confusing initially but easy to navigate within a day. Walkable to anything you want downtown including Union Station and Ball Arena. My kids and I had a great time and would definitely stay again!

My family (4 adults and 2 kids) loved staying here over Thanksgiving! There was plenty of cookware and serving pieces for our meals. We felt safe and comfortable--the house is very spacious and is in an excellent location! Allen was very responsive to our questions (even though they were on Thanksgiving Day--sorry!) and extremely helpful. We would highly recommend staying here.

That's place really very clean! I was surprise omg. Very cozy house and nice people 😊 I got everything i need, felt like its was my home😌 Thank you so much and i will definitely recommend this place 100000%
was very pleasant we got a fast response every time we needed something we'll definitely stay by Kendra again
Tyler was a great host, the location was exactly what we wanted, great off-street parking. Perfect for our two couples- lots of room- loved the office off the kitchen. Extremely clean!!

Daphne was very considerate for us traveling with an infant, and had a packnplay set up and a basket of kids toys. The sheets were soft, bathroom was stocked, and all in all the details were really thoughtful. The only thing that keeps this place from being 5 stars for us was the kitchen set up- there were no baking sheets, and most of the pots and pans were extremely scratched teflon with what seemed like a misc collection of lids. We really like airbnbs for the opportunity to save money by cooking, and that wasn't the easiest to do here, plus the dishwasher doesn’t open because the door hits the side of the oven, which was a little funky. One more thing to note for future renters is that the bathroom/shower was a little tough to use for folks over 6’ and the ceilings are low in the staircase and bedroom. All that said, we appreciated this place and had a comfortable stay.

Laura’s place was the perfect getaway for our weekend in Denver, and Laura herself was kind, flexible, responsive, and courteous. The home was tastefully decorated and the area around it had so many great restaurants to choose from. She even left a book with recommendations that were really helpful.

I have lived in the area before and wanted to get a feeling of what that was once again. Needless to say this place gave me that! Cozy, new, clean, truly loved it here. We had a good stay at this Airbnb in Tennyson. The location is fantastic—right on Tennyson Street, surrounded by great restaurants and cafés, which made it incredibly convenient to explore the neighborhood and grab meals or coffee just steps away. Another highlight was the kitchen, which was very well equipped. It had everything we needed to cook comfortably, which isn’t always the case with short-term rentals. One thing to note is that the apartment doesn’t face the sun, so it can feel a bit cold at times. That said, the heating system works well, so it wasn’t a major issue for us. The main downside is the noise. Because the unit is located directly below a busy restaurant/bar, it can get quite loud until around midnight. When the restaurant kitchen is closing, there is also a very loud engine-like noise—we’re guessing it might be a food debris collector or kitchen equipment. It’s something light sleepers may want to keep in mind. Overall, it was a comfortable stay

Thanks for a great stay. I really liked your neighborhood and its proximity to the park. I appreciated the space heater along with the heat pump, made it pretty cozy.

I had a great stay at Tracy's. The place is behind the house in the cute basement, and it has plenty of space. Everything was really clean and Tracy was responsive to any questions. This is the spot to book when in Denver! Marlene and her husband Doug were great hosts and very insightful about their surrounding neighborhood, the house is in a very nice walkable area while being super close to downtown and shopping districts. The house itself is super clean and has some amazing artwork! 10/10 would book again!
Beautiful apartment that has just what you need. Very easy to find parking, loved the area.
I lost track of how many times I’ve stayed with Kasa! Amazing host and experience! 🤗🤗
We were very pleased with our quick visit. Yvonne greeted us and showed us to our room. The space was very clean and smelled amazing! Cozy and home vibes for sure. Would definitely stay again!
Loved the care and attention to the house. Didn’t feel like a rental, rather a home. Very chic and efficient.
Location was convenient for our visit. Could walk to local restaurants if needed. Felt safe.

The location could not have been better for our needs! Broadway is loaded with a variety of great restaurants, there is an excellent climbing gym nearby, grocery shopping is minutes away the neighbors are nice. I had a great stay here! The space was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Everything was easy and the host was great to communicate with. I would definitely recommend staying here and would stay again.

Really love the place! Super nice and super clean! Perfect walking distance stores, coffee shops and a restaurant downstairs. Only down side was the parking. Had to leave our car 2 blocks away in a public parking lot paid about $50 for 3 days
Great place, great location....just as advertised

David was a great host. The place was clean, well-appointed, and uncluttered, which made it feel like home. The kitchen was excellent and fully usable for cooking meals. The location was perfect—I walked to several restaurants and to Wash Park every day. I would definitely stay again.

What an amazing staycation! We truly enjoyed every little moment here. The tiny home is cozy yet surprisingly spacious, and it made our stay feel very comfortable and relaxing. We loved everything about the house and really appreciated the host’s thoughtful touches.
Stayed for a night for an Avalanche game and it was the perfect location! Super easy communication, clean, and fun aesthetic!
Such a cute spot! Will definitely stay here again when I’m in Denver. Centrally located and a charming private space :)
Wonderful stay. Great location, super close to Cheesman Park and some other attractions. Decently stocked kitchen as well! Host was very welcoming and even let us borrow some olive oil to cook with!
Beautiful space, great location, friendly & responsive host! Highly recommend and would definitely return! ♥️
What a fantastic space - loved what you are doing in this space for the broader community. Very comfortable.
Exactly what we needed thank you!

My son and I stayed at Chelsea’s place for 4 nights and we had a great trip. The place was as described and was adequate for our needs. Chelsea is extremely responsive and was very helpful in answering our questions. Cheers

My friend and I stayed here for a few days visiting Denver, and we loved it! We spent most of our time out in the city and just needed a place to stay overnight. Jennifer was a great host and reached out early to help us with travel recommendations and transportation tips. She was super sweet and helpful in making sure our stay was as easy and fun as possible!
perfect stay
Meggans Airbnb is great, nice clean smell greets you at the door. Has a nice backyard, and the massage chair was our favorite.
There were a few issues like a plumbing issue, the microwave did not work, and the light plug by the bed on 3rd floor did not work. Other than that it was good.

good location and very good sized space for a single traveler, i work remote and it has a perfect desk set up. easy to get around, trails and shops all over. only critique is the bed was not comfortable.
Paying mostly for location

Recommend.

Excelente lugar, muy cómodo, limpio, atención fantástica. Volvería sin duda.

This was the perfect place to stay in Denver! We went to a show at the Fillmore and had a super short drive. The room was very clean and spacious, we will be staying here again next time! Ps. The beautiful art on the walls was a cool and unique touch!!
Had a great stay, very peaceful area. Felt right at home.
Friendly host and a cozy house. The garden outside is very cute. Great location and great price. I will definitely come back! 😊
nice place to stay with everything within walking distance
Great place to stay overall.
Great place to stay! Awesome vibes . Host was great as well! Definitely booking again next time I come to Denver !

This Airbnb really takes you to a relaxing place and just swaddles you there. Peaceful quiet neighborhood lots to do in the surrounding areas. We had a wonderful time the bed and the linens were absolutely perfect. In every way what a vacation.
Cool place! We had a great time. Loved the convenience of the location
Host was great and house was awesome

Kara's house was a great find. Quiet neighborhood, comfy beds, great to have a large garage to park in and a grill to BBQ on. Nice bottle of wine for our stay. Kara was great at answering any questions that we had. Thank you for the lovely stay!
I enjoy living and visiting walkable locations. Jason's place was convenient for walking to visit my family...and for grocery shopping. Thank you

Kaitlyn’s place was great and she was communicative. Her home looked exactly like the photos and had everything we needed for our stay unlike a typical Airbnb these days. Had a nice stay. Cozy and had everything I needed for my short stay. Kara communicated perfectly.
Very clean and host responsive and accommodating.

I’m writing this, just after getting back today actually. I had a great stay, the unit itself was accurate in advertisement. Communication was very positive, and helpful. Minutes before check out, I discovered my flight had been cancelled, and rescheduled for the next day. The host, were very gracious to extend my stay for one more night. The neighborhood is great, and walkable, and felt safe. I walked to city park, the zoo, and botanical gardens, it’s all within close proximity. Things about the unit that stood out were the shower, it had great water pressure, and the bed was so comfortable, with plenty of nice comfortable pillows. The unit is equipped with coffee, and kitchen appliances, however I just ate out every night, but they are there if you need them. In conclusion, I would most definitely stay here again.
Super nice and clean! Great place to stay!
Comfortable, quiet, great location. I will definitely stay here again.

Great location and large place - has everything you need for an extended stay and very comfortable. It is walkable to a lot of restaurants, shopping, and parks. I love that there was yoga right next door!
Dave and Allison were amazing hosts. The were friendly communicative and a delight to stay with !! 10/10 recommend and would stay again! The place is cozy cute and very comfy!
Great stay. Such kind hosts. Wonderful walkability. Super comfy beds, great kitchen, bathroom. Just a perfect spot!

She was so sweet and responsive and always made sure I was good and was helpful for local recommendations. Her dog is also the sweetest very calm not barky at all and very well mannered. Made my trip much greater would probably book again!!

the place was cozy ,clean ,and very nice for a basement unit !!!..we loved everything about it except the price .we paid over a thousand dollars for 7 days because the way it was advertised we thought it was for entire house .but other than that it was one of the better places on airbnb and we didn't want to leave but recommend it 100%!!!..just wish I could afford it !!
We needed a last minute start for just one night and found Peter’s place and it was perfect! Easy to access, cute and clean, and a very comfortable bed. Thank you again Peter!

This place was so cute and perfect for our group. We had 12 of us staying there for a conference and we all felt we had plenty of space. Even having to share bathrooms etc. the decor is so cute and looks just like the pictures. Also had lots of dishes, seating, towels etc to accommodate a large group.

I have stayed in many Airbnbs in Europe and the US and this is the cleanest and best-appointed one I have ever stayed in! From its very secure and private location (which is a big bonus for a woman traveling alone) to the friendly communications and great directions for entering the carriage house, it was the perfect accommodation for my short time in Denver. It's top of my list for the visit.

Tahvory's cute renovated bungalow was exactly as it was described. Close to Denver City Park and convenient to Denver attractions. We walked almost everywhere including to the nearby Sprout's Market and the Denver Botanic Gardens (2 miles one-way). Even though the house is very near busy Colorado Blvd, it was very quiet. All around, a good place to spend a few days in Denver if you want the full city experience. We will keep it in mind the next time we return to Denver.

This place was a gem. It is close to Denver Airport, but not too close. It made getting up in the morning and catching a flight stress-free. The place was clean, well stocked and had very comfortable beds. We would definitely stay here again in the future.
This was a perfect, convenient home away from home for our area conference stay and Carol was a kind host who communicated wonderfully. Thank you so much!
Brad was an excellent host. I recommend this stay for those visiting Denver for the first time!
Perfect location to Denver airport. The place was super clean, convenient and hosts were excellent. Would stay again!
Fantastic. Zero issues. Super convenient from union station (take freeride bus)

Great place for a longer stay. Prime location in Rino, close to restaurants and bars. Walkable to downtown and easily accessible to the other neighborhoods/suburbs of Denver as well. I stayed for 3 months and worked from the apartment, no issues with the Wifi. The walls are a bit thin and it can get loud on weekends, but not atypical for a city. Antoine was great, super responsive and resolved any issues I had quickly. Street parking is relatively easy to find, it gets a little trickier from Thursdays-Saturdays, you may have to park a few blocks away. Overall, great place and I enjoyed my stay.

Great spot for downtown events. We stayed here overnight to take our grand daughter to Meow Wolf. All the stadiums are close by, and it is in a very up and coming area. Place was clean and cozy. We would definitely stay here again.
Such a beautiful place. Convenience. Super responsive host. Super clean. Well stocked. Excellent location. Right down the street from good eats and walkable. We loved it.
Nice place in the middle of the city

I stayed for several weeks and loved it! Quiet neighborhood and a wonderful park just steps away. My dog and I enjoyed many long walks. The house was very clean, warm and welcoming. Great back yard! One of the best airbnb experiences. Would stay again!
Great view of Denver from the hot tub! Clean and wonderfully decorate!
The place was great and exceeded my expectations. Host was very responsive and helpful. I would stay here again.

This is such an amazing, beautiful place. So close to restaurants, Sloan lake, Broncos stadium and the lime scooters were so fun, walking trails everywhere. Kimberly was amazing. Will stay here again.
I stayed for a full week and it was a great stay! Very quiet and peaceful!
Prime location with everything you’d need for a short stay! Parking was found easily and the house is super accessible from the street. We would totally stay again!

Our stay at Michael’s Airbnb was great. The house has all of the amenities needed, the place is very well located and the house is super comfortable (with extra sheets and towels). Michael was very friendly and responsive as well. Will stay there again if we come back to Denver. Thanks !
A lovely and fun place to stay. Beautiful view of the city
Would stay there again

Really great home in the University District with easy access to the University of Denver. Space was comfortable, clean and private. Parking was easy and Hosts were responsive. I would definitely re-book on my next visit!
Fantastic stay!
Dans place was great! Quant little basement with really cozy vibes, extremely clean and quiet.
Zach was great, very attentive and quick to respond. The house was very cozy and comfortable. Nice quiet neighborhood but easy access to everything.
Great condo and location. Very spacious. Lots of amenities provided.

This was a great place to stay, centrally located, reasonably priced and thoughtfully accommodated. Anne and Peter were very responsive and made the stay very comfortable. We also loved the homemade bread and fresh eggs they left for us.
A perfect space, wonderfully clean and welcoming. :)
Wes's spot was great! We needed a last minute place to stay in Denver and this was perfect. Great neighborhood and location.
family loved the place. beautiful view as soon as you open the front door. quiet and private which is always a plus. beds sooo soft. 👌. fully recommended.
Super nice an convenient to do downtown activities will be making this our place to stay from now on !!
Great place and location. A wonderful setup for my wife and I for the weekend. Lots of great places nearby.

Thanks for hosting me. The apartment was walking distance to my conference downtown and had lots of nice amenities nearby including a small market and several restaurants. Would definitely stay again.

This place was simply perfect in Denver , nice location . Pictures are as described. Place is nice and clean , overly stocked . It’s a nice street view across from a grocery store . Daniel is so helpful and responsive you’ll never feel alone . From the nice patio , to the spacious bedroom space 10/10 the home is equipped with everything you need for a stay . My fav feature is the windows in the bedroom as they have clear patio view .
Me and my girlfriend visited Denver for a few days, and this place was exactly what we needed. Comfortable, convenient, and made our trip even better.
Very great host! Will def book again next time I visit the area.

We loved our stay at Queen Anne’s! The free on site parking is very helpful, and the area felt very safe. The breakfast was very tasty every day! This room is so spacious and having two sinks is so nice as a couple! Will definitely stay here again when in Denver.
Cool Loft! Loved the view and location!
Loved our night here. Street parking was easy outside the place. Spacious enough for two adults and a toddler. Kitchen was well equipped. Shower was hot and had great pressure! Thank you!

The time spent this weekend at Perla’s was really awesome! Her space was very comfortable, everything was super clean as well. She did have extra plates, towels and napkins; a lot of extra stuff in case we forgot something. Perla was also very responsive, if there was a question she would answer back in a timely manner. I did get a little confused with the hot tub but Perla made it very simple to use, as well as having directions for the sauna. Once we got in the hot tub it was amazing! The jets were super relaxing. We did have a little trouble with the internet during our time. No fault on her part; the wind was a little bad when we first arrived but Perla made sure there was an alternative for the mean time, as well as making sure the situation was handled. All in all, this space was truly more than expected! I would definitely come back again!
Amazing host Amazing house - historic house , very cute. Amazing location- walking distance to Larimer and tons of restaurants.
Amazing home! we could not have found a better place to stay and very convenient ! we loved it!
The house was in a great location and Andy was a very responsive host. I would recommend to anyone.

I absolutely loved my stay in Sunnyside! The community is central, walkable, and easily accessible, which made getting around a breeze. The townhome itself is beautiful and comfortable, making settling in effortless. Tyler and Katelyn were wonderful hosts- easy to coordinate with and very responsive. I truly have no complaints and feel lucky to have been able to book this spot when it became available. Highly recommend!

Enjoyed my stay at Jackie’s place. It was clean and neat - the balcony was also a plus. It’s in a convenient location and easy to get to downtown Denver. Jackie was super responsive and helpful and gave detailed instructions.

We had an incredible stay! The location is absolutely premium for exploring the Highlands and outside of downtown. ​Nicole was a fantastic host; she has clearly put so much thought into the guest experience. We especially loved the great coffee selection and light snacks she provided. It was such a welcoming touch and felt truly hospitable. ​The space was clean, stylish, and exactly as described. If you're looking for a seamless stay in a prime location, this is the spot. We’d love to come back!

I love the place very comfortable. Comfortable. Clean. Cozy. Perfect place to stay especially if flying in/out of DIA. Quick to respond & clear instructions. Support responsive & helpful when weather changes travel plans. Will definitely return.
Amazing

Great place to stay and not too far from all the fun places we went to! We loved the grocery store across the street and Odie B’s. The place is in a basement so you will occasionally hear noises from upstairs (from the dogs mostly). Otherwise, very clean and cozy space.
Tonya was a good host, responsive and flexible. The place was clean, as described, easy to get in, and in a great location. Would stay again.
Second time around and it was great— thank you so much!

My partner and I enjoyed staying at Brad's Airbnb. It was very clean, well-kept, and just enough room for two people. We also appreciated that his place was walkable to nearby destinations like the Highlands. Would highly recommend for a private getaway.

This was such a great alternative to staying at the Gaylord during the week for our convention! It was a very easy commute back and forth and the comfort of returning to a spacious clean home everyday was wonderful. Communication was clear, check in and check out was easy and flexible, and there were plenty of towels and many comforts provided including kitchen basics. The value was unbeatable for the area! I would absolutely stay here again upon a return to Denver! Thanks again!

Had a pleasant stay at Lizz’s house! She’s very nice and friendly, and the place is clean and filled with beautiful artwork which is really impressive. Also the cat is adorable and will keep you from getting bored during your stay. Definitely recommend!

A great place to stay and well equipped! We enjoyed every minute of our visit and will definitely stay here again if it is available when we are in Denver! Tim had everything you could possibly need available in a perfect space for 2!
Great host and an amazing place right by downtown. The location is perfect and close to everything you need. I would definitely stay here again.
Great night stay before an early flight

Camila’s apartment is close to the train station, the Denver Performing Arts Complex, and our favorite diner and restaurants. Although the apartment is in a busy neighborhood the it’s very quiet and the balcony door opens to fresh air. The apartment is very clean, bright, and spacious with In-unit AC/heat controls which make it a very comfortable place. We also enjoyed the pool table, shuffle board, and outdoor pool deck on a lower floor. Unfortunately, both hot tubs are out of service at this time. A great stay in downtown Denver!!
Great spot, clean, good kitchen. Easy checkin, host is responsive.
The listing was close to the main highways and local sights. Bathroom and bedroom was clean. Parking was good once I figured out the areas for street parking. Would stay again!
Very nice apartment and very well equipped for providing your own meals…….ever beer in the frig and a bottle of wine. A little bit pricey but for us it was worth it.
Stunning home, beautiful art. Warm and welcoming.

We arrived in Denver and instantly felt welcome. The home is well kept and the feeling of being wanted to have an incredible stay is unparalleled. Me and my girlfriend had the time of our lives in Denver thanks to Nick!

Wonderful one bedroom apartment in the Baker neighborhood of Denver! This was our 2nd stay in this well-appointed and exceptionally comfortable space. Every detail is clearly well thought out so you will find absolutely everything you need. The host is very responsive and gracious in her communication. We highly recommend!
Great place!!
We had a great stay and the unit was very nice. The neighborhood is quiet and close to some neat local shops.
Thanks for hosting us. Such a comfortable place
Clean, well kept and close to downtown!

The place was such a comfortable stay, fully kitted, comfy bed, heating & air conditioning both worked super well for the rapidly changing weather, and the check in was incredibly easy. Hosts were responsive. Felt very safe the whole time. Regard the check in time being 4pm because the only option to check in any earlier if you land early is only 2pm for a hefty fee. There’s no overnight parking close to the lot as well so prepare to walk a block or more but that’s typical for this area. Overall great stay for the location.
A very nice place to stay. It was very welcoming with a lot of great amenities!

We could not have been more comfortable! The space is perfectly designed, and the many windows (all with black out shades) gave options for letting in a lot of natural light. The neighborhood was quiet, yet close enough to take advantage of all the great shops and restaurants on Pearl St. A great value for the price and one of the nicest Airbnbs we've had in Denver. We'll be looking forward to our next visit.

I fell in love with this place as soon as I saw it online, but then seeing it in person, I was even more in love if that's even possible. Lisa was incredible and made herself available whenever we needed her. I felt at home, as it was my first trip away from my kids in literally years; this house made it feel like a comfort. I was so happy to arrive and so sad to leave. When I visit Denver again, we will be staying here!

The rooms were very cozy and minimalist, with an industrial-modern vibe that we really enjoyed. The customer service was very kind, and overall, it was a very pleasant experience. The area was also very walkable and beautiful.
Esta muy linda la casa y en una zona muy tranquila, Charley y Mari muy atentos todo el tiempo
nice place i recommend

We had a lovely stay for 2 nights with two kiddos. The pack and play made traveling much easier and there was enough room for it in either bedroom. The apartment is beautifully decorated and updated. Pat was a wonderful host, even letting our kiddos play in the snow. The neighborhood is quiet and walkable to some great local places, and it’s an easy drive to places like the aquarium and children’s museum. Would definitely recommend!

Our stay at Josh's place was one of the best Airbnb experiences I've ever had! Josh was friendly and communicated well before our trip. He had good recommendations for nearby amenities. His house was spotlessly clean and thoughtfully appointed (right down to the hair dryers and makeup remover wipes in each of the upstairs bathrooms), including the nicest basket of snacks on the kitchen table! I was in Denver to see family, and Josh graciously allowed me to cook for them in his kitchen (which had pretty much every pot, pan, and appliance you could need!) and store meals temporarily in his freezer. We chatted a few times in the kitchen, and Josh made sure that everything was alright and that we did not need anything. He was very respectful - hopefully we did not bother him too much with our cooking! Thank you for a wonderful stay, Josh. If I return to Denver with my family, we will definitely see if your place is available again!

Elle was very gracious in letting us check in early. After arriving we realized that there were no coverings on any of the windows and neighbors could easily see into the house. There was construction noise and dogs barking while we tried to sleep. Ended up leaving before we stayed the first of 3 nights.

What an absolute gem! I couldn’t fault anything. The bed was really comfy. The kitchen had everything I needed. The bathroom was spotless. There was no issue with parking outside. It was quiet and safe. My plans changed and I needed to stay a few days earlier than my booked dates. Soleil was not only able to accommodate the change, but was incredibly helpful and responsive and made it so easy. Next time I’m back in Denver, this is going to be top of my list.
Amazing house, close to everything we were looking to do. We will definitely book again when we come back to Denver.
He was a great host. The place is clean and quiet.
Peaceful and clean thank you so much for the quick stay!

The place was amazing! Would return to stay here again!
Cozy place, well appointed, very communicative host. Worked great for our stay in Denver. Thanks John!
seamless in and out. clean place and good location
beautiful interior decoration, loved xo
Nice place, great area near downtown, limited parking, no heating controls in room (space heater included). Overall, it was a nice stay.

Five stars all around! As hosts, Nina and Mark were hospitable and communicative. Check-in process was easy. The unit was clean, cosy, quiet and located in a nice, safe neighborhood. I had a truly restful stay. Thank you for hosting, Nina and Mark!

Nice older refurbished Denver home close to Tennyson. There were 4 of us on our annual “girls’ trip”. We had plenty of room and were quite comfortable. Three full bathrooms were very nice to have! We didn’t need it but it should be said that the house is well equipped for babies and children, with a couple of high chairs and cribs and a play area with toys in the basement.

Josh's place was excellent, I had a wonderful time staying here. The space is huge, and I was able to make good use of the outdoor patio and backyard as well. The book collection in the living room was top notch too. I would totally stay again if I were ever in the area.

Tim’s place was perfect for our stay in Denver! The guesthouse was clean upon arrival and had everything we might need during our stay. The location is very close and within walking distance to local shops and restaurants. We needed more toilet paper during our stay, and Tim responded quickly and was able to get us some more. We would stay here again!
The place was a great place to just relax. Only thing is the parking. Maybe get placards vehicle. It cost approximately$25 a day in a local parking garage. Other than that all was amazing.

Such a perfect and cozy space to spend the weekend with my closest friends! Everything in the house was better than expected - the photos truly do not do it justice! Amazing host, easy access, wonderful neighborhood. I can’t overstate how special this space is!!
Place was great and looked exactly like the pictures!
Amazing stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Host was super responsive. Would definitely stay again!

The place was possibly the cleanest airbnb i have ever stayed at. Everything was spotless! House was super charming and extrememly convenient to downtown. Parking was always easy to find and we felt safe walking around the neighborhood.
Great place! Would totally stay here again. Super walkable and close to so many great things to do.

Stayed here a second time because the host is amazing and the location is amazing. We ended the trip early due to an allergic reaction to something but the host was super accommodating and have no complaints!
We loved our stay here! Further away from town but this was exactly why we were looking for. Very understanding and helpful!

This Airbnb is amazing and especially for the value! Perfect size for me and my dog, would have also been perfect for a couple. It was exceptionally clean and ideally furnished. Not minimalist or bare bones, but exactly the items you needed and nothing getting in your way. I'll look to book here again in the future.

This was a gold mine find for me. I felt right at home the minute I walked in. The unit was spotlessly clean and very well stocked with everything you need for a wonderful stay. The private patio was sunny and bright with the beautiful art on the wall. The bedding was luxurious and the kitchen was extremely workable with everything a cook needs to create great meals. The bonus was the location being just a block from my son’s home, so this will be my number one place to stay when I am in Denver!
the place was very nice, clean,and very comfortable
WE enjoyed our say very much. Great location where we could walk to many places

Daniel and his team were super friendly and very accommodating with an early check-in. The home was spacious and comfortable. I loved the huge primary tub! The deck was lovely with a pretty view. There were several cool things to walk to but the immediate neighborhood is nice and quite. A pretty quick walk to the heart of RINO.

Loved this adorable little get away in Denver. I loved all the small details Taylor put in this spot. The small reading lights over the bed, the breakfast nook with placements, the towel rack outside for your swimsuits. He really made it so cute and functional! Would def recommend this place for a couple wanting to get away and relax. PS the hot tub is clean and gets hot!
When faced with a problem in the house (mouse), we let the owner know we'd be moving to a new Airbnb. The owner was not kind, and would not reimburse us for the rest of the stay (over a week).
I loved staying here! The location is great, the apartment is beautiful, and Brianna has great communication. I would 100% stay here again if I ever find myself in Denver.
Great place, clean and tidy. A great value. Excellent Host.
The house was very clean and felt like home. Host was very responsive and even provided recommendations of things to do while visiting Denver. I will definitely stay again my next trip to Denver.

Perfect spot & location for our stay in Denver. We especially loved the kitchen and bathroom. So clean and nice. I was thrilled to see the washer & dryer as I needed to do a load of laundry during our stay. The Airbnb is just behind the host’s beautiful home- this was perfect. Thank you!
It was a good stay since I was in town for a conference on a budget.
Very helpful with everything and the questions we had.
Wonderful host. They were nice, flexible, and understanding.

Shannon's apartment worked vey well as a comfortable and convenient place to stay while I was working in Denver. She was super-quick and helpful at answering any questions.

I stayed at the LoHi condo for 2 nights as part of a business trip. The place is as described, spotlessly clean and well maintained. The well-stocked Keurig machine is a nice touch. It's within 5-10 minute walking distance to lots of restaurants and bars in the Highland area. While I didn't have a car, there's ample street parking. Tim was a great host - responsive, detailed instructions, and great communications. Overall a wonderful stay. Five stars.
